tgm000006.label: A la poupée prints
tgm000006.scope: Color prints made by simultaneously inking separate areas of the same plate or block with different colors, before printing.

tgm000007.label: A trois crayons drawings
tgm000007.scope: Chalk drawings in three colors, usually red, white, and black.

tgm000011.label: Abandoned buildings
tgm000011.scope: For vacant, possibly dilapidated buildings. Search under RUINS for the remains of structures.

tgm000021.label: Abolition movement
tgm000021.scope: For the subject of the abolition of slavery in general.

tgm000022.label: Abolitionists
tgm000022.scope: Search under ABOLITION MOVEMENT for the subject of abolitionism in general and the activities of abolitionists.

tgm000036.label: Abstract works
tgm000036.scope: Images in which the depiction of real objects has been subordinated or entirely discarded; especially non-representational images, stressing formal relationships of line, color, and shape.

tgm000040.label: Abutments
tgm000040.scope: Masses, usually of masonry, that support and receive the thrust of arches, vaults, or trusses.

tgm000041.label: Abyss
tgm000041.scope: A bottomless pit or wide gulf.

tgm000043.label: Acanthi
tgm000043.scope: Sculptured ornamentations (as in a Corinthian capital) representing or suggesting the leaves of the acanthus.

tgm000046.label: Accidents
tgm000046.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm000047.label: Accordions
tgm000047.scope: Includes the activity of playing accordions.

tgm000050.label: Acetate negatives
tgm000050.scope: Acetate safety films were first introduced in the early 1900s. Various types include diacetate and triacetate and are often difficult to distinguish from one another.

tgm000055.label: Acoustical engineering
tgm000055.scope: For the subject of acoustical engineering in general and the activities of acoustical engineers.

tgm000060.label: Acrobats
tgm000060.scope: Individuals who engage in acts of physical agility for entertainment purposes.

tgm000063.label: Action & adventure dramas
tgm000063.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) which consist of swordplay, fighting, or other forms of combat. Can also include activities that involve danger and risk.

tgm000067.label: Actors
tgm000067.scope: For male actors alone or groups of male and female actors. Search also under subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm000068.label: Actresses
tgm000068.scope: For female actresses. For groups of males and females use ACTORS. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm000083.label: Adits
tgm000083.scope: A nearly horizontal passage from the surface in a mine.

tgm000091.label: Adoration
tgm000091.scope: Profound veneration, devotion, or love whether in a spiritual or non-spiritual context.

tgm000097.label: Adventure comics
tgm000097.scope: Comics featuring heroes and heroines involved in action-packed, danger-filled stories. Examples include Flash Gordon, Superman, and Tarzan.

tgm000098.label: Advertisements
tgm000098.scope: Public notices of the availability of goods or services through purchase or other means.

tgm000099.label: Advertising
tgm000099.scope: For the general activity of advertising (calling attention to something, usually by announcement).

tgm000101.label: Advertising cards
tgm000101.scope: Cards issued to promote goods or services. May have been distributed by merchants or enclosed as premiums with such products as bread, cigarettes, and coffee. Usually, cards bear seller or product name and a pictorial representation of the service or product. Picture may also be unrelated to the product.

tgm000104.label: Aerial bombings
tgm000104.scope: For images of military bombardment by bombs dropped from the air. Search under BOMBARDMENT for sustained military attacks on cities, military positions, and other places with bombs, shells, rockets, or other explosive missiles. Search under BOMBINGS for the use of explosive devices for the purposes of political terrorism, protest, etc. Search under ORDNANCE TESTING for test bombs.

tgm000107.label: Aerial photographs
tgm000107.scope: Photographs taken from an air-borne vehicle within the earth's atmosphere, such as an airplane, balloon, or kite; from a camera strapped to a bird; or by a person, such as a parachutist, in flight. Use SPACE PHOTOGRAPHS for images taken from beyond the earth's atmosphere.

tgm000111.label: Aerial views
tgm000111.scope: Views from a high vantage point.

tgm000116.label: Aeronautics
tgm000116.scope: Science, art, or practice of aircraft operation and/or aerial navigation.

tgm000118.label: Aesthetics
tgm000118.scope: A branch of philosophy concerned with the nature of beauty or art.

tgm000121.label: Affidavits
tgm000121.scope: Sworn statement in writing made especially under oath or on affirmation before an authorized magistrate or officer.

tgm000131.label: Agents provocateurs
tgm000131.scope: An agent employed to induce or incite a suspected person or group to commit an incriminating act.

tgm000142.label: Agricultural exhibits
tgm000142.scope: For displays of agricultural products and technology in the context of an exhibition.

tgm000152.label: Agriculture
tgm000152.scope: For the production of plants and animals for purposes of human consumption in some form.

tgm000159.label: Air bases
tgm000159.scope: Bases of operations for military aircraft.

tgm000185.label: Air warfare
tgm000185.scope: Includes all aspects of aerial combat. Search under AERIAL BOMBINGS for images that focus on military bombardment by bombs dropped from the air. Search also under the subdivision --AIR OPERATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm000209.label: Airplanes
tgm000209.scope: Includes commercial, private, and military airplanes.

tgm000212.label: Airships
tgm000212.scope: Lighter-than-air aircraft having a propelling system and a means for controlling the direction of motion.

tgm000224.label: Album cards
tgm000224.scope: Collecting cards intended for display in albums; popular from about 1850 to 1890. They usually lack a publisher's name or date and do not have advertising on them.

tgm000225.label: Album covers
tgm000225.scope: Containers for sound recordings; printed with graphic designs.

tgm000227.label: Albumen prints
tgm000227.scope: Predominant paper print photographic process in the 1800s; popular 1850s-1890s.

tgm000228.label: Albumen transparencies
tgm000228.scope: Typically, glass lantern slides or stereographs; introduced 1849; largely replaced by collodion transparencies.

tgm000229.label: Albums (Books)
tgm000229.scope: Bound or loose-leaf sets of pages. Includes handmade albums and published volumes of blank pages designed for the addition of images or keepsakes.

tgm000230.label: Alchemy
tgm000230.scope: For the subject of alchemy in general and the activities of alchemists.

tgm000234.label: Alcoholism
tgm000234.scope: Search under INTOXICATION for images of drunk persons.

tgm000235.label: Alcoves
tgm000235.scope: A small recessed section of a room.

tgm000242.label: Noncitizens
tgm000242.scope: Persons who are not citizens of the country in which they reside. Double index under ILLEGAL IMMIGRATION for images that focus on noncitizens who permanently or temporarily relocate across national borders without complying with the legal requirements of the destination country.

tgm000245.label: Allegiance
tgm000245.scope: Devotion or loyalty to a cause, group, or person.

tgm000250.label: Allegories
tgm000250.scope: Representations of truths or generalizations about human existence by means of symbolic images; often of classical derivation.

tgm000253.label: Alleys
tgm000253.scope: Narrow lanes between buildings, especially through the middle of city blocks, giving access to the rear of buildings; also, for those which are residential cul-de-sacs.

tgm000261.label: Allusions
tgm000261.scope: Representations of or references to one work in another work. Does not include routine reproductions or works made "after" other works.

tgm000267.label: Almshouses
tgm000267.scope: Privately financed homes for the poor. Includes activities and structures.

tgm000282.label: Amateur works
tgm000282.scope: Images created by people who are not full-time or professional practitioners in the medium or genre; often made for pleasure rather than money; does not refer to image quality.

tgm000284.label: Ambrotypes
tgm000284.scope: Direct-image photographs; the chemically reduced collodion glass negative packaged against a dark background appears as a positive. Commonly in a case; popular mid-1850s to mid-1860s.

tgm000299.label: Amphitheaters
tgm000299.scope: For natural or man-made oval, semicircular, or circular areas formed by slopes or rising tiers of seats around an open space used for various public events. Search under AUDITORIUMS for facilities used for public gatherings. Search under STADIUMS for large, often unroofed structures in which athletic events are held.

tgm000300.label: Amputation
tgm000300.scope: The surgical removal of a body part.

tgm000306.label: Anaglyphs
tgm000306.scope: Photomechanical images in two contrasting colors, such as red and green. Printed either as a pair of images or as one image superimposed on the other but slightly out of registry. When viewed through a pair of lenses, each in the appropriate different color, a three-dimensional effect is created. Introduced in 1891; popular during the 1920s.

tgm000308.label: Anamorphic images
tgm000308.scope: Images produced by a distorting optical system or other method that renders an image unrecognizable unless viewed by the proper restoring device. Popular for prints and drawings in the 1600s and 1700s and for photographs in the 1800s. Images are often recorded as they appear in a convex or concave cylindrical mirror.

tgm000309.label: Anarchism
tgm000309.scope: For the subject of anarchism in general.

tgm000310.label: Anarchists
tgm000310.scope: Search under ANARCHISM for the subject of anarchism in general and the activities of anarchists.

tgm000312.label: Anatomy
tgm000312.scope: For the subject of anatomy in general and the activities of anatomists.

tgm000320.label: Andirons
tgm000320.scope: Pairs of metal firewood supports used on a hearth, usually made of horizontal bars mounted on short legs.

tgm000325.label: Anglican churches
tgm000325.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm000331.label: Animal auctions
tgm000331.scope: For animal auctions of all types.

tgm000338.label: Animal feeding
tgm000338.scope: Includes feeding of pets, livestock, etc.

tgm000340.label: Animal grooming
tgm000340.scope: Human tending, cleaning, brushing, etc. of animals.

tgm000346.label: Animal shows
tgm000346.scope: Includes shows of farm animals or pets.

tgm000354.label: Animals
tgm000354.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ANIMALS & PETS used with names of persons (Appendix B). Search also under the subdivision --ANIMALS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm000358.label: Animation cels
tgm000358.scope: Images on celluloid or polyester sheets, which are used to create an animated sequence for movie, videotape, or other moving image productions; usually drawings or paintings.

tgm000360.label: Anniversaries
tgm000360.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); with names of wars (Appendix C); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm000361.label: Announcements
tgm000361.scope: Small notices of special occasions, such as weddings.

tgm000369.label: Anthemia
tgm000369.scope: Ornaments consisting of floral or foliated forms arranged in a radiating cluster but always flat.

tgm000374.label: Anthropology
tgm000374.scope: For the subject of anthropology in general and the activities of anthropologists.

tgm000381.label: Antipersonnel weapons
tgm000381.scope: Weapons designed for use against military personnel.

tgm000384.label: Antiques
tgm000384.scope: Search under ANTIQUITIES for relics of ancient times.

tgm000385.label: Antiquities
tgm000385.scope: Relics of ancient times, such as coins or statues. Search under ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES for ancient structures or remains of ancient structures. Search under ANTIQUES for objects of an earlier period, but not of ancient times. Search also under the subdivision --ANTIQUITIES & ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm000388.label: Antitoxins
tgm000388.scope: Antibody formed in the body as a result of the introduction of a toxin and able to neutralize the toxin.

tgm000392.label: Anti-communism
tgm000392.scope: For anti-communism in general as well as rhetoric or activities directed against communism.

tgm000401.label: Apartheid
tgm000401.scope: For the political, economic, and social policies of the government of South Africa designed to keep racial groups in South Africa and Namibia separated.

tgm000404.label: Apartment houses
tgm000404.scope: For apartment house structures; search under APARTMENTS for single units within apartment houses or living units not in apartment houses.

tgm000405.label: Apartments
tgm000405.scope: For single units within apartment houses or living units not in apartment houses; search under APARTMENT HOUSES for apartment house structures.

tgm000407.label: Apes
tgm000407.scope: Distinguished from the other higher primates, the monkeys, by their complete lack of external tail and by their more complex brains.

tgm000419.label: Appliances
tgm000419.scope: Instruments or devices (as electric stoves, fans, or refrigerators) operated by gas or electric current.

tgm000429.label: Aquatic animals
tgm000429.scope: For unidentified, or groups of, animals that live entirely in the water. Search also under more specific names of animals, such as FISH, MAMMALS, etc.

tgm000433.label: Aqueducts
tgm000433.scope: Structures for conveying a canal over a river or hollow.

tgm000439.label: Arbors (Bowers)
tgm000439.scope: Leafy shelters of boughs, vines, etc.

tgm000440.label: Arcades (Architectural components)
tgm000440.scope: For images that focus on series of arches. Search under ARCADES (SHOPPING FACILITIES) for covered passageways or avenues along which are located rows of shops.

tgm000441.label: Arcades (Shopping facilities)
tgm000441.scope: For covered passageways or avenues along which are located rows of shops. Search under ARCADES (ARCHITECTURAL COMPONENTS) for images that focus on series of arches.

tgm000444.label: Archaeological sites
tgm000444.scope: For ancient structures still largely intact and remains of ancient structures; also includes active excavations. Search under ANTIQUITIES for relics (coins, etc.) of ancient times. Search under RUINS for remains of structures not of ancient times and under ABANDONED BUILDINGS for vacant, possibly dilapidated buildings. Search also under the subdivision --ANTIQUITIES & ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm000445.label: Archaeology
tgm000445.scope: For the subject of archaeology in general and the activities of archaeologists.

tgm000455.label: Architectural drawings
tgm000455.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and construction (or documentation of design and construction) of sites, structures, details, fixtures, furnishings, and decorations, as well as other objects designed by an architect or architectural office.

tgm000457.label: Architectural elements
tgm000457.scope: Individual parts of a structure that play a functional or decorative role, such as, banisters, cornices, fireplaces, etc.

tgm000461.label: Architectural models
tgm000461.scope: Miniature relief or three-dimensional representations in scale of structures or parts of structures made for the purpose of showing the result of actual architectural construction plans. Search under BUILDING MODELS for miniature representations of real or imaginary buildings. Search under MODEL HOUSES for full-scale representations of houses planned to be constructed.

tgm000463.label: Architectural orders
tgm000463.scope: In classical architecture, particular styles of columns with their entablatures having standardized details.

tgm000464.label: Architectural photographs
tgm000464.scope: Photographs made to record a structure for architects, architectural historians, and others who need clear representations of such aspects as construction phases, exteriors, or interiors. Not meant for every photo of a structure.

tgm000466.label: Architectural sculpture
tgm000466.scope: Sculpture that is integral to a structure.

tgm000468.label: Architectural & site components
tgm000468.scope: Elements that, together, contribute to the make-up and appearance of structures.

tgm000469.label: Architecture
tgm000469.scope: For the subject of architecture (style, design, etc.) in general and the activities of architects. Search under FACILITIES (and NTs) and ARCHITECTURAL & SITE COMPONENTS for images that focus on structures and sites or elements thereof, under CONSTRUCTION for the process of building, and under CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY for the construction business.

tgm000470.label: Architraves
tgm000470.scope: The lowermost elements of a classical entablature and similar elements when carried around doorways and openings.

tgm000475.label: Aristotypes
tgm000475.scope: Photographic prints made on various non-albumen papers. The trade name became a general term for prints made on collodion silver chloride printing-out papers (introduced in the 1860s) and was later applied to gelatin silver chloride papers (introduced in the 1880s).

tgm000481.label: Armistices
tgm000481.scope: Temporary suspensions of hostilities by agreement between opponents. Search also under the subdivisions --ARMISTICES and --PEACE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm000483.label: Armored trains
tgm000483.scope: Trains with protective covering, usually steel plates. Includes exteriors and interiors.

tgm000485.label: Armored vehicles
tgm000485.scope: Vehicles with protective covering, usually steel plates.

tgm000486.label: Armored vessels
tgm000486.scope: For the first armored warships built during the revolution in naval architecture in the second half of the 19th century.

tgm000489.label: Armorial bookplates
tgm000489.scope: Book plates bearing such heraldic devices as coats of arms.

tgm000490.label: Armories
tgm000490.scope: Buildings used for military training or the storage and manufacture of military equipment or weapons.

tgm000491.label: Arms control
tgm000491.scope: For international action placing limitations on armed forces, armaments, and military expenditures. Includes restrictions on the use, levels, or deployment of weapons or forces.

tgm000494.label: Arms race
tgm000494.scope: For reciprocal build-up in the quality or quantity of the military power of two opponents, caused by each striving to maintain or achieve a desired military posture relative to the other.

tgm000511.label: Art
tgm000511.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ARTS & CRAFTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm000527.label: Art reproductions
tgm000527.scope: Commercially published, mechanically printed copies of individual paintings, prints, drawings, and other two-dimensional works of art.

tgm000545.label: Artillery (Weaponry)
tgm000545.scope: For missile engines and weapons, as well as mounted guns as distinct from small arms.

tgm000548.label: Artists' devices
tgm000548.scope: Designs, symbols, or mottoes used by artists to identify their creations.

tgm000552.label: Artists' proofs
tgm000552.scope: Prints which are accepted for an edition but are unnumbered or numbered separately from the edition and reserved for the artist's use.

tgm000564.label: Aspergillums
tgm000564.scope: A brush or small perforated container with a handle that is used for sprinkling holy water in a liturgical service.

tgm000565.label: Aspersoriums
tgm000565.scope: A bucket-like vessel that holds the Holy Water and into which the aspergillum is dipped.

tgm000567.label: Assassinations
tgm000567.scope: For murders of prominent persons. Search also under the subdivisions --ASSASSINATION or --ASSASSINATION ATTEMPTS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm000575.label: Assistance
tgm000575.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ECONOMIC & INDUSTRIAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm000581.label: Astrology
tgm000581.scope: For the subject of astrology in general and the activities of astrologers.

tgm000586.label: Astronomical observatories
tgm000586.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under ASTRONOMY for activities.

tgm000587.label: Astronomy
tgm000587.scope: For the subject of astronomy in general and the activities of astronomers.

tgm000588.label: Asylums
tgm000588.scope: Institutions for the protection or relief of some class of destitute, afflicted, or otherwise unfortunate persons. Includes activities and structures. Search under MENTAL INSTITUTIONS for insane asylums.

tgm000590.label: As-built drawings
tgm000590.scope: Final set of working drawings incorporating (through revisions or annotations) any changes of dimensions, materials, form, and method of construction encountered in the completion of the structure or site.

tgm000609.label: Atriums
tgm000609.scope: Includes modern atriums that are enclosed.

tgm000610.label: Atrocities
tgm000610.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MORAL & ETHICAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C). Search also under the subdivision --ATROCITIES used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm000615.label: Au pairs
tgm000615.scope: People who help a family with child care, housework, and other tasks.

tgm000622.label: Auditoriums
tgm000622.scope: For facilities used for public gatherings. Search under AMPHITHEATERS for flat or gently sloping outdoor areas surrounded by slopes on which spectators can sit.

tgm000634.label: Autochromes
tgm000634.scope: The Lumière brothers began marketing autochromes in 1907, and the color glass transparencies continued to be available into the 1930s.

tgm000638.label: Autographs
tgm000638.scope: Names of people written in their own hand; stamped or printed signatures are not included.

tgm000657.label: Automobile racing drivers
tgm000657.scope: For automobile racing drivers not engaged in the activity of racing. Search under AUTOMOBILE RACING for activities.

tgm000661.label: Automobile service stations
tgm000661.scope: Includes gasoline pumps which are part of a service station.

tgm000671.label: Auto-da-fé sermons
tgm000671.scope: Ceremonies at which judgment was pronounced on those convicted of heresy by the Spanish Inquisition.

tgm000691.label: Axonometric projections
tgm000691.scope: Parallel orthographic projections in which the object or subject is tilted in relation to the picture plane so that three faces and axes are visible although not in true shape.

tgm000694.label: A-frame buildings
tgm000694.scope: A building typically having triangular front and rear walls and a roof reaching to the ground.

tgm000712.label: Badges
tgm000712.scope: Devices indicating support of a cause, achievements, or membership in a society or group. May be printed, photographic, plastic, metal, cloth, or other fabric; usually intended to be worn on the person.

tgm000715.label: Bagpipes
tgm000715.scope: Includes the activity of playing bagpipes.

tgm000716.label: Bags
tgm000716.scope: Sacks, usually rectangular in shape and made of paper, plastic, or cloth; often printed with manufacturer's name or advertisement.

tgm000719.label: Bakeries
tgm000719.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under BAKING for activities.

tgm000721.label: Baking
tgm000721.scope: Includes both commercial and domestic activities.

tgm000723.label: Balalaikas
tgm000723.scope: Includes the activity of playing balalaikas.

tgm000725.label: Balconies
tgm000725.scope: For platforms (usually unroofed) that project from the wall of a building, enclosed by a parapet or railing.

tgm000730.label: Ball & chain
tgm000730.scope: Symbol of something that severely restricts a person's activity; usually oppressively.

tgm000734.label: Ballet
tgm000734.scope: For the subject of ballet in general and the activity of ballet dancing.

tgm000747.label: Ballots
tgm000747.scope: Sheets of paper, cards, or other devices used to cast a vote or announce a slate of candidates.

tgm000748.label: Ballroom dancing
tgm000748.scope: For dancing at balls (large and formal assemblies for social dancing).

tgm000750.label: Balls (Parties)
tgm000750.scope: For formal dances; search under DANCE PARTIES for less formal dances.

tgm000753.label: Balusters
tgm000753.scope: One of a number of short, vertical members used to support a stair handrail or coping.

tgm000768.label: Banjos
tgm000768.scope: Includes the activity of playing banjos.

tgm000770.label: Bank note vignettes
tgm000770.scope: Engraved decorations primarily designed for use on bank notes or other currency but also commonly used on stock certificates and other securities. Pictorial or ornamental images from the 1790s to the present.

tgm000771.label: Bank notes
tgm000771.scope: Promissory notes issued by banks, payable to bearer on demand without interest, and circulating as money.

tgm000774.label: Banking
tgm000774.scope: For individual or local banking activities. Search under BANKING INDUSTRY for large-scale banking or images related to the industry as a whole and under BANKS for images that focus on buildings.

tgm000775.label: Banking industry
tgm000775.scope: For large-scale banking or images related to the industry as a whole. Search under BANKING for individual or local banking activities and under BANKS for images that focus on buildings.

tgm000776.label: Banks
tgm000776.scope: For images that focus on buildings. Search under BANKING for individual or local banking activities and under BANKING INDUSTRY for large-scale banking or images related to the industry as a whole.

tgm000777.label: Banners
tgm000777.scope: Sheets of cloth, plastic, or paper intended for hanging or other public display.

tgm000778.label: Banquet camera photographs
tgm000778.scope: Photographs made from a fixed wide-angle-lens camera capable of producing a sharp image of great depth. Usually photographs of large groups of people. One camera, marketed 1913-1926, produced prints of 7 x 17 in. (18 x 43 cm.) and 12 x 20 in. (30 x 51 cm.).

tgm000781.label: Banyan trees
tgm000781.scope: East Indian trees, the branches of which send out numerous trunks that grow down to the soil so that a single tree covers a large area.

tgm000787.label: Baptist churches
tgm000787.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm000788.label: Baptisteries
tgm000788.scope: Part of church used for baptism, containing a baptismal font.

tgm000794.label: Barbecues
tgm000794.scope: A social gathering, held outdoors, at which barbecued food is eaten.

tgm000799.label: Barbering
tgm000799.scope: Hairdressing, primarily for men and boys.

tgm000800.label: Barbers
tgm000800.scope: Person whose occupation is mainly to cut and shave men's and boys' hair.

tgm000803.label: Barbershops
tgm000803.scope: Search under BARBERING for activities outside of shops.

tgm000814.label: Barrage balloons
tgm000814.scope: Small captive balloons used to support wires or nets as protection against air attacks.

tgm000823.label: Bars (Furniture)
tgm000823.scope: A counter over which liquor and other beverages are served.

tgm000829.label: Baseball cards
tgm000829.scope: Advertising or collectible cards that feature portraits of baseball players, other people, or topics associated with the game. Introduced in 1886 or 1887 by a tobacco company; also popular with bubble gum manufacturers beginning in the 1930s. Common sizes include 1.5 x 2.5 inches, 2.5 x 3.5 inches, and ca. 5 x 8 inches. The cards may be actual photographs mounted on card stock or photomechanically printed.

tgm000847.label: Bassoons
tgm000847.scope: Includes the activity of playing bassoons.

tgm000849.label: Bas-reliefs
tgm000849.scope: Works of sculpture in which the projection of figures, ornaments, etc., from the background is slight, no part being entirely detached.

tgm000852.label: Bathhouses
tgm000852.scope: Public facilities containing dressing rooms. Includes activities and structures. Search under PUBLIC BATHS for public buildings for bathing.

tgm000859.label: Bathing suits
tgm000859.scope: For images in which swimming attire is prominent.

tgm000864.label: Bathyspheres
tgm000864.scope: Strongly built diving spheres used for deep-sea observation and study.

tgm000876.label: Battlefields
tgm000876.scope: Battle sites after the time of fighting. Search under CAMPAIGNS & BATTLES and under the names of conflicts for images at the time of battles. Search also under the subdivision --BATTLEFIELDS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm000877.label: Battlements
tgm000877.scope: Parapets consisting of alternate solid parts and open spaces that surmount a wall.

tgm000880.label: Baxter prints
tgm000880.scope: Color prints that use a combination printing process that involves intaglio plates (or occasionally lithographic stones/plates) to produce a print to which color is subsequently applied using up to 20 wood blocks. The process was invented by George Baxter in 1835 and widely used until the 1870s. The term is used to refer to prints made by Baxter himself. For Baxter prints made by other printers, search under BAXTER-PROCESS PRINTS.

tgm000885.label: Bayous
tgm000885.scope: Distributaries of streams, bounded by natural levees, through which water is channeled by repeated divisions into swamps, then marshes of a delta, and ultimately into the ocean.

tgm000888.label: Bazaars
tgm000888.scope: Markets consisting of rows of shops or stalls often found in Middle Eastern or Islamic countries.

tgm000907.label: Beauty
tgm000907.scope: A pleasing quality associated with harmony of form or color, excellence of craftsmanship, truthfulness, originality, or another, often unspecified, quality.

tgm000930.label: Beer gardens
tgm000930.scope: Eating and drinking establishments serving food and drink to individuals and families, and often serving as social centers. Originated in Germany and brought to the U.S. by German and East European immigrants.

tgm000934.label: Bees (Cooperative gatherings)
tgm000934.scope: Social gatherings where people combine work, competition, and amusement.

tgm000954.label: Bellows
tgm000954.scope: Instruments or machines that by alternate expansion and contraction or by rise and fall of the top draws in air through a valve or orifice and expels it more or less forcibly through a tube.

tgm000955.label: Bells
tgm000955.scope: Includes the activity of ringing bells.

tgm000958.label: Belt industry
tgm000958.scope: The manufacture and trade of conveyor belt systems, including activities and structures.

tgm000964.label: Benedictions
tgm000964.scope: For the blessing of objects and persons and the act of blessing as a liturgical function.

tgm000983.label: Bible cards
tgm000983.scope: Cards with a scriptural picture or quotation, or both. Sometimes issued in sets and often used as rewards of merit in Sunday schools.

tgm000984.label: Bible societies
tgm000984.scope: Societies concerned with the publication and distribution of the Bible. Includes activities and structures.

tgm000994.label: Big business
tgm000994.scope: Conduct of commercial activities involving economic groups consisting of large profit-making corporations, especially with regard to their influence on social and political policy.

tgm000998.label: Bigamy
tgm000998.scope: Multiple marriage as a criminal offense. Search under POLYGAMY for the practice of having more than one spouse.

tgm001004.label: Billboard posters
tgm001004.scope: Large multi-sheet posters; intended for posting on billboards, fences, or similar surfaces.

tgm001006.label: Billheads
tgm001006.scope: Documents for itemized accounts of the separate cost of goods sold or shipped, or services performed; pictorial or typographically decorated.

tgm001009.label: Billiard parlors
tgm001009.scope: Search under BILLIARDS for images that focus on the game.

tgm001010.label: Billiard rooms
tgm001010.scope: Search under BILLIARDS for images that focus on the game.

tgm001016.label: Bimetallism
tgm001016.scope: Use of two metals (such as gold and silver) jointly as a monetary standard with both constituting legal tender at a predetermined ratio.

tgm001022.label: Biological pest control
tgm001022.scope: Use of natural predators or parasites to control insects and related pests.

tgm001025.label: Biology
tgm001025.scope: For the subject of biology in general and the activities of biologists.

tgm001026.label: Biomechanics
tgm001026.scope: For the study of the mechanics of biological and especially muscular activity.

tgm001046.label: Bird's-eye view prints
tgm001046.scope: Bird's-eye views of cities and towns that are lithographs, engravings, or other types of prints including photomechanical ones. Popular in the United States 1870-1910s, but also made earlier.

tgm001047.label: Bird's-eye views
tgm001047.scope: Graphic representations of scenes portrayed as if viewed from above at an oblique angle. If of a city or town, not generally drawn strictly to scale, they show street patterns, individual buildings, and major landscape features in perspective.

tgm001054.label: Birthdays
tgm001054.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm001055.label: Birthplaces
tgm001055.scope: Search also under the subdivision --BIRTHPLACE used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm001058.label: Bishops
tgm001058.scope: High ranking prelates in the Christian church; usually administers a diocese.

tgm001059.label: Bison
tgm001059.scope: For the American buffalo. Search under BUFFALOES for buffaloes of the eastern hemisphere.

tgm001069.label: Black lung
tgm001069.scope: Lung disease caused by coal dust inhalation.

tgm001071.label: Black power
tgm001071.scope: Movement of Africans Americans to gain control of the political, social, economic, and cultural institutions that effect them. Term especially used in the 1960s and 1970s.

tgm001072.label: Black sheep
tgm001072.scope: Member of a group who stands in conspicuous and unfavorable contrast to the other members, especially by reason of socially undesirable characteristics.

tgm001095.label: Blind stamps
tgm001095.scope: Symbols or other devices embossed or impressed without ink onto paper or other material. Often used to identify the creator, printer, publisher, or owner.

tgm001097.label: Blindness
tgm001097.scope: For the physical condition of being without sight.

tgm001098.label: Blinds (Shelters)
tgm001098.scope: A concealing enclosure from which a person may shoot birds or observe wildlife.

tgm001099.label: Blizzards
tgm001099.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm001102.label: Blockades
tgm001102.scope: Barriers set up by troops or ships to prevent ingress or egress; also restrictive measures to obstruct communication and cut off commerce with an enemy.

tgm001116.label: Bloody shirt
tgm001116.scope: Means employed to stir up or revive party or sectional animosity.

tgm001125.label: Blueprints
tgm001125.scope: Cyanotypes that reproduce designs as white lines against a blue background. Introduced in the United States ca. 1876; predominant method for reproducing architectural and engineering drawings by the 1950s; largely discontinued by 1980.

tgm001137.label: Boards of trade
tgm001137.scope: Organizations of persons engaged in similar lines of business, that promote, protect, and regulate common economic interests. Includes activities and structures.

tgm001151.label: Boathouses
tgm001151.scope: A building usually built partly in the water for the housing or storing of boats.

tgm001182.label: Bombardment
tgm001182.scope: Sustained military attacks on cities, military positions, and other places with bombs, shells, rockets, or other explosive missiles. Search under AERIAL BOMBING for images of military bombardment by bombs dropped from the air and under BOMBINGS for the use of explosive devices for the purposes of political terrrorism, protest, etc.

tgm001184.label: Bombings
tgm001184.scope: For the use of explosive devices for the purposes of political terrorism, protest, etc. Search under AERIAL BOMBINGS for images of military bombardment by bombs dropped from the air and under BOMBARDMENT for sustained military attacks on cities, military positions, and other places with bombs, shells, rockets, or other explosive missiles.

tgm001190.label: Bonds (Negotiable instruments)
tgm001190.scope: Interest-bearing certificates indicating public or private indebtedness.

tgm001194.label: Bonnets
tgm001194.scope: Head coverings for women or small children made of cloth or straw usually tied under the chin with ribbons or strings and made with or without a brim.

tgm001197.label: Book & magazine posters
tgm001197.scope: Posters issued to advertise books, magazines, and newspapers, especially artist-designed posters issued in the United States starting ca. 1890.

tgm001202.label: Book covers
tgm001202.scope: Covers forming the binding or outer enclosure of a hardback or paperback book. Includes detached covers.

tgm001208.label: Book illustrations
tgm001208.scope: Illustrations in books or pamphlets, whether photographs, photomechanical prints, or other media; whether still part of or detached from the volume. Also, drawings, photographs, prints, and other pictures made to be reproduced as illustrations, whether or not they were ever published.

tgm001209.label: Book jackets
tgm001209.scope: Detachable flexible covers, usually paper, designed for or published with a book.

tgm001218.label: Bookmarks
tgm001218.scope: Paper, cardboard, cloth, or other markers used to hold a place in a book.

tgm001220.label: Bookplates
tgm001220.scope: Book owners' identification labels; usually intended for pasting inside a book.

tgm001221.label: Books
tgm001221.scope: Form: Published non-periodical volumes in bound codex form, usually with 49 or more pages. Search also under terms beginning with BOOK. SUBJECT: For images that focus on books. Search under READING for activities.

tgm001224.label: Bookstacks
tgm001224.scope: For sets of shelves or bookcases usually separated by narrow aisles, used for compactly storing books.

tgm001232.label: Boots
tgm001232.scope: Footwear usually of leather or rubber that covers the foot and part or all of the legs.

tgm001238.label: Boring
tgm001238.scope: For cutting of holes in earth or rocks to determine the nature of the strata penetrated or to create an outlet for oil, water, or gas. Search under DRILLING for drilling of holes in metal or wood for construction and manufacturing purposes.

tgm001241.label: Bosses (Architecture)
tgm001241.scope: Raised ornaments used in architectural elements.

tgm001244.label: Botanical illustrations
tgm001244.scope: Illustrations of plants or plant life; or illustrations made to document botanical specimens.

tgm001245.label: Botany
tgm001245.scope: For the subject of botany in general and the activities of botanists.

tgm001247.label: Bottle industry
tgm001247.scope: The manufacture and trade of bottles, including activities and structures.

tgm001250.label: Bottling industry
tgm001250.scope: The production and packaging of beverages, including activities and structures.

tgm001251.label: Boudoir card photographs
tgm001251.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 8.5 x 5.5 in. (22 x 14 cm.). Introduced in the United States ca. 1890.

tgm001253.label: Boudoirs
tgm001253.scope: Women's bedrooms, dressing rooms, or private sitting rooms.

tgm001254.label: Boulders
tgm001254.scope: Detached and rounded or much-worn masses of rock.

tgm001259.label: Bow windows
tgm001259.scope: Bay windows that are curved in plan.

tgm001296.label: Brass instruments
tgm001296.scope: Includes the activity of playing brass instruments.

tgm001313.label: Breechcloths
tgm001313.scope: Garment worn by Native American men and boys that consisted of a piece of material fastened around the waist with a belt.

tgm001316.label: Brethren churches
tgm001316.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm001329.label: Brides
tgm001329.scope: For images which focus on persons, search under WEDDINGS for activities.

tgm001333.label: Bridges
tgm001333.scope: Structures erected over a depression or obstacle, as over a river, gorge, roadway, etc., carrying a roadway and/or walkway for vehicles or persons. Search under SWING BRIDGES for bridges that move horizontally and under VERTICAL LIFT BRIDGES for bridges that lift vertically.

tgm001340.label: Broadcasting
tgm001340.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMUNICATIONS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm001343.label: Broadsides
tgm001343.scope: Single-sheet public notices that are usually printed on only one side. They provide information, commentary, proclamation, or other announcement or advertisement. Primarily posted but also distributed by hand. They are usually less pictorial than posters and have more extensive text than signs.

tgm001350.label: Bromoil prints
tgm001350.scope: Bromide prints that are developed and then bleached and colored. Oil base pigment(s) is applied with a soft brush or a brayer, usually in repeated applications. Introduced in 1907.

tgm001355.label: Brooms & brushes
tgm001355.scope: For brooms and brushes not in the process of being used. Search under SWEEPING & DUSTING for activities.

tgm001371.label: Bucket brigades
tgm001371.scope: A group of people in a line, transporting items by passing them hand to hand.

tgm001385.label: Buffaloes
tgm001385.scope: For buffaloes of the eastern hemisphere. Search under BISON for the American buffalo.

tgm001389.label: Bugles
tgm001389.scope: Valveless brass instruments that resemble trumpets and are used especially for military calls. Includes the activity of playing bugles.

tgm001402.label: Building models
tgm001402.scope: Miniature relief or three-dimensional representations of real or imaginary buildings. Search under ARCHITECTURAL MODELS for miniature representations in scale of structures or parts of structures made for the purpose of showing the result of actual architectural construction plans. Search under MODEL HOUSES for full-scale representations of houses planned to be constructed.

tgm001404.label: Building systems
tgm001404.scope: Assemblies of integrated building subsystems satisfying the functional requirements of a building.

tgm001405.label: Buildings
tgm001405.scope: For buildings in general; includes buildings with indeterminate functions and buildings distinguished by attributes other than function. Search under other FACILITIES NTs for buildings that serve particular functions (e.g., AGRICULTURAL FACILITIES). Search also under the subdivision -- STRUCTURES used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --BUILDINGS used with names of corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm001420.label: Bullhorns
tgm001420.scope: A hand-held combined microphone and loudspeaker.

tgm001424.label: Bull's eye windows
tgm001424.scope: Round or oval windows, usually with glazing bars radiating from a circular center.

tgm001429.label: Bumper stickers
tgm001429.scope: Stickers bearing printed messages and intended for display on automobile bumpers, although used in many other places. The self-adhesive stickers were introduced in the mid-1900s and are often ca. 3 x 13 inches.

tgm001430.label: Bundling (Packing)
tgm001430.scope: The activity of assembling or binding material in a group.

tgm001431.label: Bungalows
tgm001431.scope: One-story frame houses or summer cottages, often surrounded by covered verandas.

tgm001432.label: Bunkers
tgm001432.scope: Fortified chambers, mostly below ground, often built of reinforced concrete and provided with openings for guns.

tgm001446.label: Burlesque shows
tgm001446.scope: For theatrical entertainments characterized by broad humor, consisting of comic skits, slapstick, striptease acts, and songs and dances performed by soloists or a chorus.

tgm001460.label: Bus persons
tgm001460.scope: People who work in restaurants, usually by clearing and setting up tables.

tgm001469.label: Business cards
tgm001469.scope: Small cards that bear name and often address of a business or organization. Usually lack illustration except for a logo or emblem. More an information card than an advertisement.

tgm001470.label: Business districts
tgm001470.scope: Areas in towns or cities used for commerical purposes; usually defined and limited by zoning ordinances.

tgm001472.label: Business enterprises
tgm001472.scope: For organizations and undertakings concerned with the supply and distribution of goods and services. Search under COMMERCIAL FACILITIES (and NTs) for facilities where goods and services are bought and sold.

tgm001491.label: Butter making
tgm001491.scope: For domestic activities. Search under DAIRYING for large scale or commercial activities.

tgm001503.label: Buttons (Information artifacts)
tgm001503.scope: Ornaments or badges for wearing, as on a lapel; stamped or printed with designs or slogans. Often disc-shaped.

tgm001504.label: Buttresses
tgm001504.scope: Structures of wood, stone, or brick built against a wall or building in order to provide strength and/or support.

tgm001509.label: Cabanas
tgm001509.scope: Shelters resembling cabins usually with an open side facing a beach.

tgm001515.label: Cabinet officers
tgm001515.scope: For the subject of the office in general and for incumbents.

tgm001517.label: Cabinet photographs
tgm001517.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 6.5 x 4.25 in. (16.5 x 10.5 cm.). Introduced in the United States in 1866; popular until ca. 1900.

tgm001518.label: Cabinetmaking
tgm001518.scope: Skilled work of cutting, shaping, and assembling high-grade articles of furniture requiring fine finish.

tgm001520.label: Cabinets (Case furniture)
tgm001520.scope: Furniture with a set of drawers or pigeon holes and doors, used for storing and displaying items.

tgm001521.label: Cabins
tgm001521.scope: A simple one-story house or hut, often of logs.

tgm001525.label: Cable railroads
tgm001525.scope: For railroads using cables or belts to pull trains, either on level ground or up steep grade.

tgm001538.label: Cafes
tgm001538.scope: Usually small and informal establishments serving various refreshments, often partly outdoors.

tgm001540.label: Cages
tgm001540.scope: Includes enclosures resembling a cage in form or purpose.

tgm001541.label: Cairns
tgm001541.scope: For heaps of stones piled up as monuments or landmarks.

tgm001545.label: Cakewalks
tgm001545.scope: Afro-American entertainment having a cake as a prize for the most accomplished walking steps; also, a stage dance involving a high prance with backward tilt.

tgm001549.label: Calculators
tgm001549.scope: For present-day calculators, as well as calculators and mechanical computers of pre-1945 vintage. Search under COMPUTERS for modern electronic computers first developed after 1945.

tgm001550.label: Calendars
tgm001550.scope: Tabular registers of days according to a system, usually covering one year and referring the days of each month to the days of the week.

tgm001554.label: Calisthenics
tgm001554.scope: Exercise without apparatus or with light hand apparatus to promote strength and gracefulness.

tgm001559.label: Calliopes
tgm001559.scope: Includes the activity of playing calliopes.

tgm001562.label: Calotypes
tgm001562.scope: Paper negatives made using William Henry Fox Talbot's patented (1841) calotype process, a developing-out process. More popular in England, Scotland and France than in the United States. May or may not be waxed. After 1850, superceded by Gustave Le Gray's waxed paper process.

tgm001567.label: Cameos (Stamps)
tgm001567.scope: Small metal-engraved emblems, produced ca. 1850-1880; usually printed in color and often embossed. Typical designs include medallions or shields with views of merchandise or business establishments. Found chiefly on commercial envelopes; also used on billheads, business cards, and as advertisements in publications. Considered a type of corner card by envelope collectors.

tgm001569.label: Camera lucida works
tgm001569.scope: Drawings (and paintings or other works made from them) produced by tracing the image of an object or scene as it appears when projected through the prism of a camera lucida. The device, which aids accuracy and enlargement or reduction, was not widely used until the early 1800s; replaced the camera obscura.

tgm001570.label: Camera obscura works
tgm001570.scope: Drawings (and paintings or other works made from them) produced by tracing the image of an object or scene as it appears when projected through the aperture of a camera obscura, which is used to aid accuracy. This device, available by the 1500s, may be a portable box with lens and mirror, or a room; supplanted by the camera lucida.

tgm001573.label: Camouflage (Military science)
tgm001573.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CAMOUFLAGE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm001576.label: Camp meetings
tgm001576.scope: Religious gatherings held, usually by Methodists, for conducting a series of religious services in the open air or in some removed spot. Includes activities and sites.

tgm001586.label: Campaigns & battles
tgm001586.scope: For images at the time of fighting. Search under BATTLEFIELDS for sites of previously fought battles. Search also under the subdivision --CAMPAIGNS & BATTLES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm001593.label: Camping
tgm001593.scope: For camping outside of organized camps and without permanent shelters. Search under CAMPS for organized camps and camping within permanent structures.

tgm001595.label: Camps
tgm001595.scope: Includes activities and sites. Search under PRIVATE CAMPS for retreats, complexes of cabins, boathouses, etc., for families and friends. Search under CAMPING for camping outside of organized camps and without permanent shelters.

tgm001614.label: Candlemaking
tgm001614.scope: For small businesses and domestic activities.

tgm001638.label: Canteens (Facilities)
tgm001638.scope: Temporary establishments which provide members of the armed forces and, in emergencies, civilians with food and recreation.

tgm001639.label: Cantilever construction
tgm001639.scope: Construction using horizontal projecting members which are supported at only one end.

tgm001641.label: Cantors (Judaism)
tgm001641.scope: Synagogue officials who sing or chant liturgical music.

tgm001644.label: Canyons
tgm001644.scope: For valleys between precipitous walls. Search under CLIFFS for very steep, perpendicular, or overhanging faces of rock, earth, or glacial ice of considerable height.

tgm001649.label: Capitalism
tgm001649.scope: For the subject of capitalism in general.

tgm001651.label: Capitals (Columns)
tgm001651.scope: Molded or carved tops of columns, piers, or pillars.

tgm001668.label: Caravans
tgm001668.scope: Companies of travelers with their animals, wagons, and equipment on a journey.

tgm001672.label: Carbon prints
tgm001672.scope: Photographic prints made by a relatively permanent, non-silver process involving bichromated gelatin. Popular ca. 1870-1900; more common in Europe than United States; often used to reproduce art works. Typically carbon black, but a wide range of other pigments may also be used.

tgm001673.label: Carbon transparencies
tgm001673.scope: Transparencies made with a carbon process on glass.

tgm001675.label: Carborundum prints
tgm001675.scope: For prints produced from printing plates that have been coated with carborundum, an abrasive powder of silicon carbide, mixed with a resin or liquid that hardens on the surface of the plate to catch and hold ink, or under pressure, scores the plate creating pits which retain ink. The plate can be worked in the same manner as a mezzotint to create an image by burnishing the surface to produce the tonal ranges of an image.

tgm001677.label: Carbro prints
tgm001677.scope: Photographic prints made by pressing a specially sensitized carbon tissue against a wet bromide print and subsequently developing the tissue. Introduced in 1905 as Ozobrome; popular 1920s-1930s as a way to make carbon prints larger than the original negative since the bromide print intermediary could be an enlargement of the negative.

tgm001679.label: Card games
tgm001679.scope: For the activity of playing cards.

tgm001680.label: Card photograph albums
tgm001680.scope: Albums designed to hold card photographs.

tgm001681.label: Card photographs
tgm001681.scope: Paper photographic prints made by a variety of processes on commercially produced cardboard mounts of standard sizes (with some variation). Introduced in the 1850s. This term includes negatives and unmounted photographic prints intended for such standard mounts. Often portraits.

tgm001684.label: Cardinals
tgm001684.scope: Chief officials of Roman Catholic papal bureaucracy.

tgm001686.label: Cards
tgm001686.scope: Pieces of thin paperboard or stiff paper, which are flat, usually small and rectangular, and designed to convey messages or other information.

tgm001698.label: Caricatures
tgm001698.scope: Images that portray in a critical or facetious way a real individual or group, or a figure representing a social, political, ethnic, or racial type. The effect is usually achieved through distortion or exaggeration of the features or form. Search also under the subdivision --CARICATURES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A) and with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm001702.label: Carnival
tgm001702.scope: Festivals, merrymaking, and revelry which takes place before Lent.

tgm001705.label: Carnivals
tgm001705.scope: A traveling collection of shows, rides, foods, and/or games.

tgm001711.label: Carpenter shops
tgm001711.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under CARPENTRY for activities.

tgm001714.label: Carpentry
tgm001714.scope: Building with wood, especially in the construction of buildings and other structures.

tgm001720.label: Carriages & coaches
tgm001720.scope: Vehicles, drawn by animals, used primarily for the transport of people.

tgm001729.label: Cartes de visite
tgm001729.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 4 x 2.5 in. (10 x 6 cm.). Introduced in the United States in 1859; made into the 1900s.

tgm001739.label: Cartoons (Commentary)
tgm001739.scope: Pictorial images using wit to comment on such things as contemporary events, social habits, or political trends; usually executed in a broad or abbreviated manner.

tgm001740.label: Cartoons (Working drawings)
tgm001740.scope: Full-size preparatory drawings made to transfer a design to the working surface of a painting, tapestry, or other large work. [AAT]

tgm001741.label: Cartouches (Graphic)
tgm001741.scope: Graphic delineations that are ornamental frames intended to contain an inscription, such as a map title, or a decoration, such as a coat of arms.

tgm001742.label: Cartouches (Architecture)
tgm001742.scope: An ornamental tablet often inscribed or decorated, and framed with elaborate scroll-like carving.

tgm001743.label: Carts & wagons
tgm001743.scope: Vehicles, drawn by animal or man or pushed, primarily for the transportation of goods. Search under CARRIAGES & COACHES for vehicles used primarily to transport people.

tgm001751.label: Casement windows
tgm001751.scope: Windows having a sash that opens on hinges attached to the upright side of the frame.

tgm001764.label: Cast paper prints
tgm001764.scope: Paper works made since the 1970s by pouring wet, often colored, pulp into a mold. Such prints may be difficult to distinguish from embossed prints.

tgm001771.label: Catacombs
tgm001771.scope: Subterranean cemeteries consisting of galleries or passages with side recesses for tombs.

tgm001772.label: Catafalques
tgm001772.scope: Draped or canopied raised structure on which a coffin is placed.

tgm001774.label: Catalogs
tgm001774.scope: Enumerations of items arranged systematically with descriptive details. May have prices.

tgm001782.label: Cathedrals
tgm001782.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm001783.label: Catholic churches
tgm001783.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm001788.label: Cattle
tgm001788.scope: Includes domesticated calves, heifers, and steers. Also includes mixed groups of cattle and cows and bulls, if their sex cannot be determined.

tgm001798.label: Cauldrons
tgm001798.scope: Large, open vessel sometimes used over a fire.

tgm001801.label: Causeways
tgm001801.scope: Raised ways across wet ground or water.

tgm001803.label: Cave churches
tgm001803.scope: For images that focus on structures, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm001809.label: Caves
tgm001809.scope: Includes the activity of exploring caves.

tgm001817.label: Celebrations
tgm001817.scope: Includes festivities associated with major events and holidays, as well as smaller festivities such as birthday parties. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with the names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); with names of wars (Appendix C); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm001818.label: Celebrities
tgm001818.scope: Search also under types of celebrities, e.g. Actors, Musicians, Writers, etc.

tgm001820.label: Celebrity touring
tgm001820.scope: For performance or publicity tours by celebrities. Search also under the subdivision --JOURNEYS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm001825.label: Cellocuts
tgm001825.scope: Prints made from blocks on which the surface has been built up with liquid plastics. May be printed in intaglio or relief. They look much like linocuts.

tgm001828.label: Cells (Rooms & spaces)
tgm001828.scope: Single room for one person within a building such as a monastery, hermitage, convent, or prison.

tgm001839.label: Cemeteries
tgm001839.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CEMETERIES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm001841.label: Censored works
tgm001841.scope: Materials altered or prohibited because they are considered unsuitable for the general public.

tgm001842.label: Censorship
tgm001842.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMUNICATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm001850.label: Centrists
tgm001850.scope: Member of a center or moderate party.

tgm001853.label: Ceramic photographs
tgm001853.scope: Photographs produced by any of a variety of processes on a porcelain, earthenware, or other ceramic support.

tgm001857.label: Ceremonial dancers
tgm001857.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DANCE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm001863.label: Cerographs
tgm001863.scope: Relief prints from a line block produced by cerography, a wax-engraving technique used to create an electrotyped plate with raised surface that is attached to a printing block.

tgm001864.label: Certificates
tgm001864.scope: Documents containing certified statements of, for example, ownership, membership, fulfilled requirements, or legal status.

tgm001872.label: Chair rails
tgm001872.scope: Horizontal wood strips on plaster walls which prevent chair backs from harming the wall.

tgm001874.label: Chalets
tgm001874.scope: A timber house often found in the Alps, distinguished by the exposed and decorative use of structural members, balconies, and stairs. Upper floors usually project beyond the stories below.

tgm001879.label: Chambers of commerce
tgm001879.scope: Associations of merchants and traders who promote commercial and industrial interests in a geographic area. Includes activities and structures.

tgm001881.label: Chancels
tgm001881.scope: Area of a church consisting of an altar and seats reserved for clergy and choir.

tgm001888.label: Chapels
tgm001888.scope: For chapels within churches or other buildings or for small, separate houses of worship sometimes associated with a church.

tgm001889.label: Chaplains
tgm001889.scope: Clergy who are officially attached to the Armed Forces, legislative bodies, institutions, courts, etc.

tgm001890.label: Chaps
tgm001890.scope: Leather leg coverings held together at the top by a belt or lacings, worn over trousers when horseback riding.

tgm001894.label: Charcoal making
tgm001894.scope: The activity of making charcoal in small-scale operations.

tgm001906.label: Charters
tgm001906.scope: Instruments in writing, creating and defining the franchises of a city, educational institution, or corporation.

tgm001907.label: Charts
tgm001907.scope: Delineations of information in tabular form.

tgm001929.label: Chemistry
tgm001929.scope: For the subject of chemistry in general and the activities of chemists.

tgm001938.label: Chevaux-de-frise
tgm001938.scope: Defensive obstacle composed of spikes or barbed wire attached to a wooden frame.

tgm001942.label: Chiaroscuro woodcuts
tgm001942.scope: Woodcuts printed from two or more blocks, one of which is usually cut to print the design in black and the others to print neutral or background colors to show differences in value. Technique developed in Europe in the 1500s; often used to reproduce drawings and paintings.

tgm001957.label: Child labor
tgm001957.scope: For images about or depicting child labor.

tgm001962.label: Child rearing
tgm001962.scope: Images related to the principles and techniques of raising children.

tgm001966.label: Children
tgm001966.scope: Includes ages 0-18. This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --CHILDREN used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups (Appendix A), and with names of wars (Appendix C). Search also under other headings beginning with CHILDREN.

tgm001972.label: Children's art
tgm001972.scope: Images produced by children. See JUVENILIA for works produced during an artist's childhood or youth.

tgm001974.label: Children's comics
tgm001974.scope: For comics intended for young children which may include such activities as puzzles, coloring, and cut-outs.

tgm001989.label: Chimneypieces
tgm001989.scope: Ornamental constructions over and around fireplaces that include the mantel.

tgm001995.label: Chine collé prints
tgm001995.scope: Prints made by laying down a thin sheet of paper on a heavier backing. The thin sheet adheres permanently to the backing sheet during printing. Lithographic or intaglio method.

tgm002016.label: Chops
tgm002016.scope: Identifying marks stamped or embossed on prints by artists, printers, or publishers.

tgm002027.label: Christian Science churches
tgm002027.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm002041.label: Chromolithographs
tgm002041.scope: Lithographs of the mid- to late 1800s printed in colors; often made to look like an oil painting or watercolor.

tgm002049.label: Church schools
tgm002049.scope: For elementary and secondary schools operated under church auspices, control, or support. Includes activities and structures.

tgm002052.label: Church & state
tgm002052.scope: For images that focus on the relationship between government and Christian denominations.

tgm002053.label: Churches
tgm002053.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm002056.label: Churns
tgm002056.scope: Machine which agitates cream or whole milk, turning it into butter.

tgm002061.label: Cigarette cards
tgm002061.scope: Cards enclosed with cigarettes. Flourished in the United States 1885-1895 and 1909-1917; printed or photographic.

tgm002068.label: Cinematography
tgm002068.scope: For the subject of cinematography in general and the activities of cinematographers.

tgm002073.label: Circulars
tgm002073.scope: Printed promotional pieces, frequently announcing sales; may be several pages in length; distributed widely through the mail, door to door, as newspaper inserts, or at commercial establishments.

tgm002075.label: Circulation (Architecture)
tgm002075.scope: Traffic patterns through parts of buildings, including the methods of travel such as corridors or elevators.

tgm002082.label: Circus posters
tgm002082.scope: Includes posters for circuses as well as carnivals, and wild west shows.

tgm002083.label: Circus spectacles
tgm002083.scope: A feature of early circuses, spectacles were large scale, lavish dramas or pageants based on imaginative or historical themes. Today refers to the grand-opening parade before the performance or the parade just after the conclusion of the first half of the program. Not to be confused with circus street parades.

tgm002088.label: Cities & towns
tgm002088.scope: For images that focus on structures and sites. Search under CITY & TOWN LIFE for images that focus on activities.

tgm002106.label: City & town life
tgm002106.scope: For images that focus on activities. Search under CITIES & TOWNS for images that focus on structures and sites. Search under STREETS for thoroughfares in cities, towns, and villages.

tgm002111.label: Cityscapes
tgm002111.scope: General or broad views of cities and towns or sections of them. Usually made from an elevated or distant vantage point, such as a view from a roof or a view of a skyline.

tgm002114.label: Civil defense
tgm002114.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CIVIL DEFENSE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm002117.label: Civil engineering
tgm002117.scope: For the subject of civil engineering in general and the activities of civil engineers.

tgm002119.label: Civil rights
tgm002119.scope: For the constitutional and legal status of members of a particular country or community. Search also under the subdivision --CIVIL RIGHTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm002121.label: Civil rights leaders
tgm002121.scope: For officials and other individuals involved in organizing to promote civil rights.

tgm002124.label: Civil service
tgm002124.scope: For the subject of employment in branches of the public service which are not military, naval, legislative, or judicial.

tgm002131.label: Civilization
tgm002131.scope: For the subject of and symbolic representations of civilization.

tgm002137.label: Clapper boards
tgm002137.scope: Hinged boards attached to a slate used in motion picture production to indicate take and synchronize sound and picture.

tgm002150.label: Clearing of land
tgm002150.scope: Removal of timber and bushes from land. Search under RECLAMATION OF LAND for bringing wild, waste, or marshy land into a condition for cultivation or other use.

tgm002160.label: Clichés-verre
tgm002160.scope: Salted paper, albumen, silver gelatin, or other photographic prints made by exposure to a coating on a glass or film support, through which lines have been drawn or areas scraped away. Alternatively, inks can be applied to a transparent matrix in varying thicknesses to alter the amount of light reaching the sensitized paper. May resemble drawings or prints.

tgm002162.label: Cliffs
tgm002162.scope: Very steep, perpendicular, or overhanging faces of rock, earth, or glacial ice of considerable height. Search under CANYONS for images that focus on valleys between cliffs.

tgm002166.label: Clinics
tgm002166.scope: Health care facilities for treatment of non-resident patients.

tgm002167.label: Clipper ship cards
tgm002167.scope: Printed cards made to attract freight consignments or passengers to clipper ships preparing to depart; chiefly 1850s-1860s; commonly 4 x 6.5 in. (10 x 16 cm.).

tgm002169.label: Clippings
tgm002169.scope: Illustrations, pages, articles, or columns of text removed from books, newspapers, periodicals, or other publications.

tgm002173.label: Clock & watch industry
tgm002173.scope: Includes activities and structures. Search under CLOCK & WATCH MAKING for small businesses.

tgm002174.label: Clock & watch making
tgm002174.scope: For small businesses. Search under CLOCK & WATCH INDUSTRY for factory work.

tgm002177.label: Cloisters
tgm002177.scope: Enclosed spaces, usually in religious buildings, consisting of a courtyard surrounded by an arcaded walkway.

tgm002183.label: Cloth photographs
tgm002183.scope: Photographs produced by any of a variety of processes on cotton, silk, or other cloth support.

tgm002184.label: Cloth prints
tgm002184.scope: Prints produced by any of a variety of processes on cotton, silk, or other cloth support. This term does not include printed textile design fabrics.

tgm002196.label: Clothing relief
tgm002196.scope: Subdivide by nationality only when relief provided to another country.

tgm002198.label: Clothing & dress
tgm002198.scope: Search also under groups of people associated with particular types of clothing, e.g., FLAPPERS and COWBOYS. Search also under the subdivision --CLOTHING & DRESS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm002204.label: Clubs
tgm002204.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ORGANIZATIONS used with names of racial, ethnic, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm002205.label: Clubwomen
tgm002205.scope: For women identified as being active in formally established societies or clubs.

tgm002217.label: Coalholes
tgm002217.scope: An opening in a sidewalk leading to a coal bin or a compartment for storing coal.

tgm002223.label: Coats of arms
tgm002223.scope: Heraldic bearings, usually depicted on an escutcheon often with a crest, motto, or other adjuncts.

tgm002239.label: Coffee
tgm002239.scope: Includes the activity of coffee drinking.

tgm002247.label: Coffeehouses
tgm002247.scope: Enterprises serving coffee and other refreshments, and that commonly serve as an informal club or forum for political discussion.

tgm002249.label: Coffers (Ceilings)
tgm002249.scope: For recessed panels, especially forming with other panels a continuous pattern in a vault, ceiling, or soffit.

tgm002257.label: Coin counting machines
tgm002257.scope: Device used in banks, mints, and financial institutions for counting coins.

tgm002266.label: Cold storage
tgm002266.scope: Process of preserving perishables by storing them at low temperatures.

tgm002267.label: Cold-frames
tgm002267.scope: An outdoor shallow rectangular frame of boards or concrete with a usually glass cover to protect small plants from wind and low temperature especially early in the growing season.

tgm002269.label: Collages
tgm002269.scope: Mixed media constructions in which bits of relatively flat materials, such as newspaper or cloth, or three-dimensional objects, are fixed to a support for symbolic or suggestive effect.

tgm002270.label: Collagraphs
tgm002270.scope: Prints made from blocks or plates on which the image has been built up with a collage of various materials and objects. May be printed in intaglio or relief.

tgm002275.label: Collecting cards
tgm002275.scope: Cards issued to be sold singly, in strips, or in other sets for collecting and trading. Not available as premiums; not intended to be advertisements. Examples include cards illustrating movie stars, or wild flowers. Use TRADE CARDS for advertising cards enclosed with products.

tgm002278.label: Collective settlements
tgm002278.scope: For formally organized communal ventures, usually based on ideological, political, or religious affiliation.

tgm002296.label: Collodion silver printing-out paper prints
tgm002296.scope: Available in the 1860s but not popular until late 1880s; chief commercial portrait medium 1895-1910. Glossy version has warm image hues while the matte version, which dominated from the mid-1890s, has near-neutral image hues. Usually toned with gold or platinum so that images show little or no fading. They do not exhibit silver mirroring.

tgm002297.label: Collodion transparencies
tgm002297.scope: Typically, glass stereographs or lantern slides; used 1850s-1890s.

tgm002301.label: Collotypes
tgm002301.scope: Photomechanical prints introduced commercially in the 1860s; commonly used in book illustration; can be difficult to distinguish from actual photographs.

tgm002303.label: Colonies
tgm002303.scope: For the subject of colonies and colonialism.

tgm002306.label: Colonnades
tgm002306.scope: Rows of columns supporting an entablature.

tgm002312.label: Color separation positives
tgm002312.scope: Transparencies, usually in sets of three films. Each is used to make a plate for printing one color, in register with the others, to form a full-color photomechanical print. [AAT]

tgm002314.label: Color wheels
tgm002314.scope: Vertical wheels on which colored paper disks are mounted to illustrate the arrangement of the hues of the spectrum in the order in which they appear in nature; frequently found with architectural drawings and other design work.

tgm002319.label: Columns
tgm002319.scope: Includes both supporting pillars and free-standing shafts.

tgm002325.label: Comedies
tgm002325.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) which have humorous or amusing intent.

tgm002329.label: Comic books
tgm002329.scope: Cartoon strips in pamphlet form; usually periodicals.

tgm002330.label: Comic cards
tgm002330.scope: Cards, issued individually or in sets, that bear a caricature or cartoon. Popular 1850s-1900. This term does not include postcards.

tgm002334.label: Comics
tgm002334.scope: Sequences of cartoons with a story line laid out in a series of pictorial panels across a page or sheet and concerning a continuous character or set of characters.

tgm002337.label: Commemorations
tgm002337.scope: Acts in honor or remembrance of an individual, a category of persons, or an event. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); with names of wars (Appendix C); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm002338.label: Commemorative prints
tgm002338.scope: Prints bearing an allegorical or narrative image commemorating an important event or occasion, such as a decisive battle or the founding of an institution. Usually text on the print indicates its commemorative nature, e.g., in honor of, in memory of. Use MEMORIAL WORKS for death memorials.

tgm002340.label: Commerce
tgm002340.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMERCE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm002346.label: Commercial facilities
tgm002346.scope: For facilities associated with the various activities involved in conducting business or trade.

tgm002351.label: Commercialism
tgm002351.scope: Excessive emphasis on profit or financial success.

tgm002356.label: Committees
tgm002356.scope: Body of persons appointed for a special function.

tgm002364.label: Communicable diseases
tgm002364.scope: Illnesses caused by living beings (both microscopic or submicroscopic, such as viruses, bacteria, and protozoa, and visible, such as certain disease-producing mites and worms) that invade the body.

tgm002365.label: Communication
tgm002365.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMUNICATION used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --COMMUNICATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm002368.label: Communication facilities
tgm002368.scope: For structures housing communication devices and/or activities.

tgm002373.label: Communism
tgm002373.scope: For the subject of communism in general.

tgm002374.label: Communists
tgm002374.scope: Search under COMMUNISM for the subject of communism in general and the activities of communists.

tgm002380.label: Commuters
tgm002380.scope: For persons who travel regularly between one place and another. Search under PASSENGERS for general travelers.

tgm002389.label: Competition drawings
tgm002389.scope: Graphic delineations produced for a design contest or to win a construction or design contract. Customarily prepared according to a prescribed program. In architecture, often a set of elevations, plans, sections, and renderings; often rendered or in perspective.

tgm002395.label: Composite drawings
tgm002395.scope: Drawings in which two or more drawings are displayed together or fused into one.

tgm002396.label: Composite photographs
tgm002396.scope: Photographs made through multiple exposure of negatives, sandwiching negatives, or other means of combining negatives. Examples include: a print made by combining cloud and landscape negatives and works by Henry Peach Robinson or Jerry Uelsmann.

tgm002403.label: Computer graphics
tgm002403.scope: Images created within or altered with a computer system; may simulate photographs, pictorial or ornamental drawings, or other images.

tgm002404.label: Computers
tgm002404.scope: For modern electronic computers first developed after 1945. Search under CALCULATORS for present-day calculators, as well as calculators and mechanical computers of pre-1945 vintage.

tgm002405.label: Computer-aided designs
tgm002405.scope: Graphic delineations, usually design drawings, created with a computer drafting system.

tgm002412.label: Concert posters
tgm002412.scope: Includes posters for orchestra, solo instrument, ensemble, vocalist, and other musical performances.

tgm002414.label: Concourses
tgm002414.scope: For large open spaces or halls in buildings where crowds come together and circulate, as in a railroad station or airport.

tgm002421.label: Conducting
tgm002421.scope: For the activity of orchestral or choral conducting.

tgm002423.label: Conductors
tgm002423.scope: For images that focus on conductors and for conductors away from the context of their work.

tgm002429.label: Confections
tgm002429.scope: Sweet edibles, including candies, cakes, pastries, and other mixtures of sugar, fruit, or nuts.

tgm002435.label: Confessions
tgm002435.scope: Statements of guilt given to law enforcement or religious officials.

tgm002438.label: Confiscations
tgm002438.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DESTRUCTION & PILLAGE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm002441.label: Confrontations
tgm002441.scope: The act of facing down or challenging; may or may not include quarreling and physical fighting.

tgm002444.label: Congregational churches
tgm002444.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm002453.label: Conjectural works
tgm002453.scope: Images showing how something in the past might have appeared, such as historical events, places, objects, or people. Also, pictures of the imagined future appearance of real people, places, and objects.

tgm002463.label: Conservation & restoration
tgm002463.scope: For restoration work on structures, as well as conservation of objects, e.g., books.

tgm002468.label: Consoles
tgm002468.scope: Projecting, scroll-shaped members serving as brackets or corbels.

tgm002471.label: Constituents
