tgm002471.scope: People entitled to elect a representative to a legislative body.

tgm002475.label: Construction
tgm002475.scope: For the process of building and types of construction. Search under CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY for the construction business. Search also under the subdivision --ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm002478.label: Construction industry
tgm002478.scope: For the construction business, including finance, planning, management, and skills. Search under CONSTRUCTION or its NTs for the process of building and types of construction.

tgm002490.label: Contact prints
tgm002490.scope: Photographic prints made by interfacing one negative and a sheet of photographic paper and exposing the paper with light.

tgm002491.label: Contact sheets
tgm002491.scope: Proof sheets containing contact prints from more than one negative; often used to select images for individual printing.

tgm002503.label: Contract drawings
tgm002503.scope: Graphic delineations which constitute part of a legal contract between a client and craftsman, builder, architect, engineer, contractor, or other service provider. Signed or accepted by one or more parties, or otherwise identified as part of a contract agreement or set of specifications. Used especially from the mid- to late-1800s.

tgm002522.label: Convents
tgm002522.scope: For local communities or houses of nuns.

tgm002523.label: Conversation
tgm002523.scope: For images of persons engaged in casual talk.

tgm002528.label: Convertiplanes
tgm002528.scope: Airplanes that take off and land vertically.

tgm002533.label: Convoys
tgm002533.scope: Organized groups of ships or motor vehicles traveling together with or without escort.

tgm002542.label: Cooperation
tgm002542.scope: For the association of persons or living things for their common good.

tgm002543.label: Cooperatives
tgm002543.scope: Enterprises or organizations owned by and operated for the benefit of those using their services. Includes activities and structures.

tgm002548.label: Copings
tgm002548.scope: Stone, terra-cotta, or metal protective caps for walls or other structures.

tgm002551.label: Copper miners
tgm002551.scope: For persons not actually engaged in mining work. Search under COPPER MINING for activities.

tgm002555.label: Copy art
tgm002555.scope: Images made with photocopy machines, such as Xerox machines, that are original works rather than reproductions of other documents. Examples include multiple copy, personal use invitations as well as artists' works.

tgm002559.label: Coracles
tgm002559.scope: Small, round or broad boats covered with skin or cloth used in the Near East and Great Britain.

tgm002564.label: Corduroy roads
tgm002564.scope: Roads built of logs laid side by side transversely.

tgm002572.label: Corn shocks
tgm002572.scope: Stalks of corn set up in a field with the butt ends down.

tgm002575.label: Corner cards
tgm002575.scope: Designs printed as advertising on business envelopes during the 1840s and 1850s; usually in the top left corner. Earliest designs consisted of pre-printed return addresses. Later designs became more elaborate and incorporated embossing. The design was often the same one used on a business card showing the establishment.

tgm002578.label: Cornerstones
tgm002578.scope: Stones forming part of corners or angles in walls, especially lying at the foundation of a principal angle.

tgm002579.label: Cornets
tgm002579.scope: Includes the activity of playing cornets.

tgm002580.label: Cornices
tgm002580.scope: Molded projections that can either serve as uppermost division of an entablature, run around the walls of a room just below the ceiling, or serve as exterior trim at the meeting of wall and roof.

tgm002582.label: Coronations
tgm002582.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CORONATION used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm002607.label: Costume design drawings
tgm002607.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and production (or documentation of design and production) of costumes for theatrical and other performing arts productions and for special events, such as costume balls or Halloween.

tgm002609.label: Costume prints
tgm002609.scope: Prints made for the documentation or study of clothing, such as national dress or military uniforms; often in series.

tgm002610.label: Costumes
tgm002610.scope: For clothing or accessories used to disguise or to take on another identity, including clothing of another time or place. Search also under THEATRICAL PRODUCTIONS, as well as ACTORS and ACTRESSES for people in costume. For people in traditional dress search under the subdivision CLOTHING & DRESS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix B).

tgm002614.label: Cotton
tgm002614.scope: For images that focus on the usually white downy substance produced by various plants.

tgm002616.label: Cotton industry
tgm002616.scope: Includes activities of processing raw cotton and weaving cotton into cloth, and associated structures.

tgm002620.label: Couches
tgm002620.scope: Long seating furniture with a back support and one end, generally used for reclining, not sitting.

tgm002628.label: Counterproofs
tgm002628.scope: In printmaking, impressions taken from a print or drawing by passing it through a press against a sheet of damp paper. The image appears in reverse.

tgm002631.label: Counterrevolutions
tgm002631.scope: For the subject of counterrevolutions in general. Search under COUNTERREVOLUTIONISTS for images that focus on real persons.

tgm002632.label: Counters
tgm002632.scope: A long horizontal surface used in stores, shops, and banks, of a height convenient to persons standing or sitting on stools.

tgm002642.label: Coup sticks
tgm002642.scope: A ceremonial wand, stick, or rattle with which a Native American warrior taps an enemy as a way to prove bravery.

tgm002643.label: Couples
tgm002643.scope: For couples not known to be husband and wife.

tgm002645.label: Coupons
tgm002645.scope: Printed slips of paper redeemable for goods or services.

tgm002647.label: Courses (Wall components)
tgm002647.scope: Layers of masonry units running horizontally in a wall or over an arch.

tgm002653.label: Courthouses
tgm002653.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under JUDICIAL PROCEEDINGS for activities.

tgm002657.label: Courtroom sketches
tgm002657.scope: Graphic delineations made during courtroom proceedings to illustrate newspaper, television, or other trial accounts.

tgm002666.label: Cove lighting
tgm002666.scope: Lighting from sources which are out of sight.

tgm002670.label: Covers (Illustration)
tgm002670.scope: Illustrations and original designs for the covers of books, periodicals, pamphlets, and other graphic design works.

tgm002677.label: Covert operations
tgm002677.scope: For activities, subversive or otherwise, performed surreptitiously, usually for political or military purposes. Search also under the subdivision --COVERT OPERATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm002708.label: Crayon enlargements
tgm002708.scope: Photographic portraits, usually oval in shape, often life-size enlargements, made from the 1860s to 1920s by drawing extensively in charcoal or pastel over a faint photographic print.

tgm002709.label: Crayon manner prints
tgm002709.scope: Etchings, engravings, or drypoints in which dots placed close together, usually by a roulette wheel, create lines which approximate crayon strokes. In vogue in France in the 1700s; chiefly used to reproduce drawings.

tgm002715.label: Credences
tgm002715.scope: Small table or shelves in a church where the bread and wine rest before consecration.

tgm002717.label: Credit
tgm002717.scope: Amount or limit to which a person or body may receive goods or money on trust of future repayment.

tgm002721.label: Cremation
tgm002721.scope: Search under CREMATORIUMS for images that focus on facilities.

tgm002722.label: Crematoriums
tgm002722.scope: For images that focus on buildings and other facilities, including ovens in concentration camps. Search under CREMATION for activities.

tgm002723.label: Cretinism
tgm002723.scope: A medical condition due to congenital lack of thyroid hormone, marked by arrested physical and mental development.

tgm002736.label: Cries
tgm002736.scope: Genre works featuring peddlers hawking their wares with, usually, the text of the rhyme they cried. Introduced by the 1500s; prints, paintings, or drawings.

tgm002746.label: Crises
tgm002746.scope: The condition of economic or political instability which leads to change.

tgm002756.label: Croplands
tgm002756.scope: Land that is suited to or used for crops.

tgm002759.label: Crosiers
tgm002759.scope: Staffs resembling shepherds crooks borne by bishops, abbots, or abbesses as a symbol of office.

tgm002761.label: Cross dressing
tgm002761.scope: For persons dressing as if they were members of the opposite sex, regardless of purpose.

tgm002768.label: Crossroads
tgm002768.scope: Place where two or more roads intersect.

tgm002781.label: Crucifixes
tgm002781.scope: A representation of Christ on the cross.

tgm002800.label: Cultural policy
tgm002800.scope: Official government policy toward cultural artifacts or activities; includes protection and restoration of cultural property.

tgm002807.label: Cupolas
tgm002807.scope: Rounded vaults raised on a circular or other base and forming a roof or ceiling.

tgm002818.label: Cursing
tgm002818.scope: For calling upon supernatural powers to send injury upon someone. Use SWEARING for use of profane language.

tgm002832.label: Cutaway drawings
tgm002832.scope: Drawings in which part of an object or structure is removed to show the interior.

tgm002835.label: Cutouts
tgm002835.scope: Shapes, forms, or figures cut from, or intended to be cut from, larger pieces of material such as paper, cardboard, wood, or cloth. Often used as decoration, exhibit material, displays, or in miniatures or scale models.

tgm002836.label: Cutover lands
tgm002836.scope: Land on which most of the salable timber has been cut.

tgm002838.label: Cut-paper works
tgm002838.scope: Images produced by cutting interior areas and sometimes outline shapes to form a design. Examples include hollow cut silhouettes, cobweb valentines, paper snowflakes.

tgm002839.label: Cyanotypes
tgm002839.scope: Blue photographic prints employing light-sensitive iron salts, most commonly on paper; introduced in the 1840s but not in general use until after 1880; often used as proofs.

tgm002842.label: Cyclones
tgm002842.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm002852.label: Daguerreotypes
tgm002852.scope: Direct-image photographs on silver-coated copper; introduced in 1839 and in general use until ca. 1860; distinctive mirror-like surface; commonly in a case.

tgm002853.label: Dairy farming
tgm002853.scope: For the care, breeding, feeding, and milking of dairy cattle. Search under MILKING for the milking of cows away from the context of dairy farms. Search under DAIRYING for the production, processing, and manufacture of milk and its products.

tgm002858.label: Dairying
tgm002858.scope: For the production, processing, and manufacture of milk and its products. Includes activities and structures.

tgm002865.label: Dance
tgm002865.scope: For the subject of dance in general and the activity of dancing. Search also under the subdivision --Dance used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm002867.label: Dance cards
tgm002867.scope: Cards on which names of dances and dance partners may be written.

tgm002869.label: Dance halls
tgm002869.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under DANCE for activities.

tgm002871.label: Dance parties
tgm002871.scope: For less formal dances; search under BALLS (PARTIES) for formal dances.

tgm002872.label: Dance posters
tgm002872.scope: Posters for dance performances; also, posters commemorating dancers or dance companies.

tgm002873.label: Dancers
tgm002873.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DANCE used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm002891.label: Day care
tgm002891.scope: For child or adult care outside of the home during the day.

tgm002897.label: Deadly sins
tgm002897.scope: The seven capital sins (pride, covetousness, lust, anger, gluttony, envy, and sloth), considered fatal to spiritual progress.

tgm002900.label: Dealers' marks
tgm002900.scope: Marks of dealers, auction houses, or other sellers.

tgm002904.label: Death
tgm002904.scope: Search also under the subdivisions --DEATH & BURIAL, --DEATH MASK used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm002912.label: Deathbeds
tgm002912.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DEATH & BURIAL used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm002914.label: Debates
tgm002914.scope: Includes the activity of engaging in formal debate.

tgm002916.label: Debris
tgm002916.scope: The remains of something broken down or destroyed.

tgm002921.label: Decals
tgm002921.scope: Images made on paper specially treated so the image can be transferred to another surface, usually by wetting the paper, laying it face down against the other surface, then stripping away the backing sheet.

tgm002928.label: Deckhouses
tgm002928.scope: A superstructure on a ship's upper deck.

tgm002964.label: Delegations
tgm002964.scope: Groups of persons chosen to represent others.

tgm002968.label: Delivering
tgm002968.scope: Includes the activity of transmitting goods or services.

tgm002975.label: Democracy
tgm002975.scope: For the subject of democracy in general.

tgm002979.label: Demons
tgm002979.scope: An evil spirit; a malignant being of superhuman nature.

tgm002982.label: Demonstrations
tgm002982.scope: Public displays, usually by a crowd, either in sympathy with or antagonism toward a cause, event, product, etc. Search also under the subdivision --RIOTS & DEMONSTRATIONS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm002985.label: Dens
tgm002985.scope: Comfortable, usually secluded rooms in dwellings for study, reading, or leisure.

tgm002993.label: Dentistry
tgm002993.scope: For the subject of dentistry in general and the activities of dentists.

tgm002999.label: Deportations
tgm002999.scope: Acts to remove, from a country, aliens not lawfully there or considered inimical to the public welfare.

tgm003022.label: Design drawings
tgm003022.scope: Graphic delineations in any medium prepared to plan, direct, or document the design and production of a wide range of works in various trades, professions, and artistic pursuits. May be sketches, diagrams, mechanical drawings, or other formats.

tgm003035.label: Details
tgm003035.scope: Small specific parts of a structure, object, or image; usually at an enlarged scale showing more information than in the entire work. Often done in preparation for a larger finished work, as a subject for study or training, or as a guide for workmen or artisans. This term includes photographic prints made from a portion of a negative and design drawings at a larger scale.

tgm003038.label: Detective camera photographs
tgm003038.scope: Photographs made by cameras designed to take pictures inconspicuously. The cameras often have special shapes for concealment under a vest or elsewhere or are disguised as other objects, such as revolvers, hats, books, watches, or binoculars.

tgm003040.label: Detectives
tgm003040.scope: For persons who investigate private, especially illegal or illicit affairs; includes private law enforcement agents as well as police investigators.

tgm003041.label: Détente
tgm003041.scope: A relaxing of strained relations between nations.

tgm003042.label: Detention facilities
tgm003042.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DETENTION FACILITIES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm003049.label: Devil
tgm003049.scope: In Jewish and Christian theology, the proper appellation of the of the supreme spirit of evil, the tempter and spiritual enemy of mankind, the foe of God and holiness, otherwise called Satan.

tgm003051.label: Devotional images
tgm003051.scope: Pictures intended as aids to prayer or worship. Examples include the small lace paper embossed pictures common in Europe during the 1880s that featured saints or scenes from the life of Jesus Christ. Sometimes issued in sets or used in religious school. May have a brief religious text.

tgm003055.label: Diagrams
tgm003055.scope: Delineations whose principal purpose is to explain rather than represent pictorially. May provide directions or schematic outline for construction, assembly, repair, or operation, as for electrical circuits or traffic flow.

tgm003062.label: Diazotypes
tgm003062.scope: Photographic prints made with material containing diazonium compounds; sensitive to blue and ultraviolet light; commonly developed with ammonia. Several processes; first introduced in 1890, chiefly for reproducing high contrast line drawings, such as architectural drawings, on paper, cloth, or other fabric. Lines are commonly blue or black, but may be many other colors.

tgm003071.label: Diesel donkeys
tgm003071.scope: For usually portable, auxiliary diesel engines used in logging, to load at landings, move equipment, etc.

tgm003074.label: Dietary laws
tgm003074.scope: Religious laws that permit and prohibit certain foods, or specify methods of food preparation.

tgm003078.label: Digital images
tgm003078.scope: Images composed of encoded picture elements (pixels). Includes scans made without a camera.

tgm003079.label: Digital photographs
tgm003079.scope: Direct-positive images produced electronically through the use of a digital camera when light from a subject strikes charge-coupled sensors (or similar devices). The images are electronic files that can be transferred to computers for editing and storage. They often have file headers with such information as capture date, caption text, photographer name, and technical image characteristics. The photographs are typically viewed on computer screens or printed using inkjet or laser devices or light-sensitive photographic papers.

tgm003083.label: Dikkas
tgm003083.scope: In mosques, a wood or stone raised platform from which the prayer leader's Koran readings and gestures are repeated for worshippers.

tgm003096.label: Diplomas
tgm003096.scope: Documents awarded to students or honorees to certify degree conferred by an educational institution.

tgm003100.label: Diptychs
tgm003100.scope: Two separate images connected side by side (hinged or mounted) to form a single work. Often are paintings of devotional images used as altarpieces.

tgm003101.label: Direct mail
tgm003101.scope: Advertisements intended for distribution by mail.

tgm003113.label: Disasters
tgm003113.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage. Search also under the subdivision --DISASTERS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm003117.label: Disciplines
tgm003117.scope: Fields of study or areas of specialization.

tgm003126.label: Discrimination
tgm003126.scope: For overt discrimination. Search under PREJUDICE for the subject of prejudiced attitudes in general.

tgm003129.label: Discussion
tgm003129.scope: Search under CONVERSATION for casual talking.

tgm003131.label: Diseases
tgm003131.scope: Search under SICK PERSONS for images of persons affected with unspecified ailments. Search also under the subdivision --HEALTH & WELFARE used with names of ethnic, racial and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm003145.label: Display cards
tgm003145.scope: Advertisements on cards made for use on a counter, in a window, or other commercial setting; larger than advertising cards.

tgm003155.label: Dissenters
tgm003155.scope: For those who express nonconcurrence with reigning opinion, beliefs, or decisions.

tgm003161.label: Distress
tgm003161.scope: Search under PAIN for physical distress.

tgm003166.label: Divination
tgm003166.scope: Art or practice that seeks to foresee or foretell future events or discover hidden knowledge usually by the interpretation of omens or by the aid of supernatural powers.

tgm003167.label: Diving
tgm003167.scope: For diving into water, as from a diving board.

tgm003208.label: Dollies (Moving equipment)
tgm003208.scope: An L-shaped piece of equipment used to transport heavy objects with handles at one end, two wheels at the base, and a small ledge; it is tilted backward until balanced over the wheels when moving an object.

tgm003216.label: Domestic life
tgm003216.scope: People at home; also includes activities in the home or a home-like setting. Search also under the subdivision --DOMESTIC LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm003221.label: Donkey engines
tgm003221.scope: For usually portable, auxilliary engines used in logging, to load at landings, move equipment, etc.

tgm003234.label: Dories (Boats)
tgm003234.scope: For small, narrow, flat-bottomed fishing boats with high sides and sharp prows.

tgm003235.label: Dormers
tgm003235.scope: Gabled extensions of attic rooms through a sloping roof to allow for vertical window openings.

tgm003237.label: Dotted prints
tgm003237.scope: Metal relief prints in which white dots or stars, produced by punching a metal plate, punctuate otherwise dark background areas.

tgm003249.label: Dowry
tgm003249.scope: Money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage or a gift of money or property given by a man for his bride.

tgm003262.label: Drag racing
tgm003262.scope: Vehicles racing on a straight track, in which the objective is to cover the distance as quickly as possible.

tgm003275.label: Drawbridges
tgm003275.scope: Search under SWING BRIDGES for bridges that move horizontally and under VERTICAL LIFT BRIDGES for bridges that move vertically.

tgm003323.label: Drill halls
tgm003323.scope: Spacious halls used for drill by military or other drill teams.

tgm003326.label: Drill teams
tgm003326.scope: An exhibition marching team that engages in precision drill.

tgm003327.label: Drilling
tgm003327.scope: For drilling of holes in metal, wood, and other materials, as carried out for construction and manufacturing purposes. Search under BORING for the cutting of holes in earth or rocks to determine the nature of the strata penetrated or to create an outlet for oil, water, or gas.

tgm003330.label: Drills (Equipment)
tgm003330.scope: Hand-held tools for making holes in firm objects.

tgm003346.label: Driveways
tgm003346.scope: Private roads giving access from a public way to a building on abutting grounds.

tgm003356.label: Drug abuse
tgm003356.scope: For abuse or misuse of drugs in a broad sense, such as aspirin, bromides, caffeine, sedatives, alcohol, LSD, marijuana, and narcotics.

tgm003365.label: Drugstores
tgm003365.scope: Retail stores where medicines are compounded and dispensed and miscellaneous articles, e.g. food, cosmetics, and film, are sold. Includes activities and structures.

tgm003366.label: Drum majorettes
tgm003366.scope: Search under DRUM MAJORING or BATON TWIRLING for images that focus on activities.

tgm003368.label: Drum majors
tgm003368.scope: Search under DRUM MAJORING or BATON TWIRLING for images that focus on activities.

tgm003369.label: Drums (Musical instruments)
tgm003369.scope: Includes the activity of playing drums.

tgm003370.label: Drums (Domes)
tgm003370.scope: Vertical walls that are circular or polygonal and carry a cupola or dome.

tgm003375.label: Dry collodion negatives
tgm003375.scope: Negatives coated with a dry collodion solution were introduced in the 1850s. Although convenient because they could be stored until ready to be exposed, they were little used because they required long exposure times. Hand-coated emulsions made these negatives look like wet plates.

tgm003377.label: Dry goods stores
tgm003377.scope: Stores in which textiles, ready to wear clothing, and notions are sold. Includes activities and structures.

tgm003379.label: Dry plate negatives
tgm003379.scope: Silver gelatin dry plate negatives were the dominant glass negative ca. 1880-1920. Dry plate negatives were made as early as the 1850s with collodion, honey, and other solutions, but they were not commercially successful and are difficult to distinguish from collodion wet plate negatives.

tgm003383.label: Drying sheds
tgm003383.scope: For structures used to dry material (e.g., paper, textiles) by means of air flow.

tgm003391.label: Dueling
tgm003391.scope: Search under DUELING GROUNDS for images that focus on sites.

tgm003392.label: Dueling grounds
tgm003392.scope: For images that focus on sites. Search under DUELING for activities.

tgm003394.label: Dugout houses
tgm003394.scope: Dwellings wholly or partly constructed in the ground, usually in a bank or slope.

tgm003405.label: Durbars
tgm003405.scope: Courts held by native Indian princes; festive receptions given by maharajahs.

tgm003408.label: Dust storms
tgm003408.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm003413.label: Dwellings
tgm003413.scope: Structures designed or used as the living quarters for one or more families. Search under BIRTHPLACES for dwellings that were a place of birth and under ESTATES for grounds and outbuildings associated with dwellings. Search also under the subdivision --STRUCTURES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --HOMES & HAUNTS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm003415.label: Dye coupler negatives
tgm003415.scope: Trade names include Kodacolor (launched in 1942 as the first commercial color negative process in the United States), and Ektacolor (1947). A chromogenic development process.

tgm003417.label: Dye coupler prints
tgm003417.scope: Includes most color photographic prints (except instant camera) made since 1941. Commonly referred to as Type C if made from a negative and Type R if made from a transparency. A chromogenic development process.

tgm003419.label: Dye destruction prints
tgm003419.scope: Color photographic prints made under various trade names including Utocolor in the early 1900s and Gasparcolor in the 1930s. Cibachrome, introduced in 1963, is the modern representative of the process. Valued in part for the relative stability of the color dyes.

tgm003421.label: Dye diffusion transfer prints
tgm003421.scope: Color instant camera photographic prints. Polaroid was introduced commercially in 1965; Kodak followed in 1976, and Fuji in 1981. Commonly 3.12 x 3.12 in. (8 x 8 cm.).

tgm003423.label: Dye transfer prints
tgm003423.scope: Color photographic prints made by the imbibition process and techniques that begin with three color separation negatives, then dyed matrices, and a final print. Among the many trade names are Pinatype (introduced in 1903) and Eastman Wash-off Relief (1935-1946). Kodak Dye Transfer process (introduced in 1946) is still in use.

tgm003438.label: Earthquakes
tgm003438.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm003449.label: Ecology
tgm003449.scope: For the subject of the interrelationship of organisms and their environments and the activities of ecologists.

tgm003450.label: Economic aspects of war
tgm003450.scope: For economic causes of war, cost of war, and effect of war and preparation for war on industrial and commercial activity. Search also under the subdivision --ECONOMIC & INDUSTRIAL ASPECTS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm003460.label: Economics
tgm003460.scope: For the subject of economics in general and the activities of economists.

tgm003467.label: Editorial cartoons
tgm003467.scope: Cartoons offering political or social commentary and made for publication on an editorial page of a print or online newspaper or periodical.

tgm003468.label: Education
tgm003468.scope: Includes activities and structures. Search also under the subdivision --EDUCATION used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm003479.label: Effigies
tgm003479.scope: An image or representation of a person. Search also under the subdivision --PORTRAYALS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm003503.label: Electric donkeys
tgm003503.scope: For usually portable, auxilliary electric engines used in logging, to load at landings, move equipment, etc.

tgm003508.label: Electric lines
tgm003508.scope: Power lines used for transmission and distribution of electricity.

tgm003515.label: Electrical apparatus
tgm003515.scope: For apparatus that generates electric power.

tgm003517.label: Electrical systems drawings
tgm003517.scope: Graphic delineations for design, layout, installation, and at times operation of electrical systems. Examples include lighting, telecommunications, power, alarm, and detection systems.

tgm003522.label: Electron tubes
tgm003522.scope: Electronic device in which conduction by electrons occurs through a vacuum or a gaseous medium within a sealed glass or metal container.

tgm003527.label: Electronic images
tgm003527.scope: Images recorded and stored in computer and video systems.

tgm003539.label: Elevations
tgm003539.scope: Graphic delineations of a vertical exterior or interior face of a building, structure, or object viewed straight on. Images usually seem flat but may include some sense of depth through shading and variations in line thickness.

tgm003553.label: Embankments
tgm003553.scope: A long natural or manmade bank or mound, esp. one raised for the purpose of carrying a road or a railway.

tgm003558.label: Emblem pictures
tgm003558.scope: Images that combine a picture with a motto or set of verses intended as a moral or philosophical lesson; usually prints or drawings.

tgm003559.label: Emblems
tgm003559.scope: Devices or images used as identifying symbols.

tgm003560.label: Embossed prints
tgm003560.scope: Prints in which the image is formed largely by the paper being forced into relief by pressing it into the hollows of the printing plate or block, usually without ink.

tgm003565.label: Embryology
tgm003565.scope: For the subject of embryology in general and the activities of embryologists.

tgm003572.label: Emigration & immigration
tgm003572.scope: For the process of resettling in a new country, including the administration of the emigration/immigration process, the reasons why persons leave their native land, their transportation and trip to another country, their arrival, etc.

tgm003582.label: Employees
tgm003582.scope: For persons identified as working for another, but where the nature of the activity, occupation, business or industry is not known. Search also under --STAFF used with names of persons (Appendix B) and --PEOPLE used with names of corporate bodies (Appendix D).

tgm003584.label: Employment
tgm003584.scope: For the subject of employment in general. Search also under headings such as BUSINESS ENTERPRISES, INDUSTRY, and MINING for images of people working. Search also under the subdivision --EMPLOYMENT used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search under CHILD LABOR for employment of children.

tgm003594.label: End of the world
tgm003594.scope: Includes Judgment Day, as well as preceding events, signs, fulfillments of prophecies, etc.

tgm003601.label: Engineering
tgm003601.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm003602.label: Engineering drawings
tgm003602.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and construction (or documentation of design and construction) of civil, hydraulic, mechanical, and other engineering works or structural components. Distinguished from architectural drawings chiefly by the designation 'engineer' for the creator.

tgm003605.label: Engineers
tgm003605.scope: A person who practices the science of engineering.

tgm003613.label: Enkolpia
tgm003613.scope: Pectoral medallions, bearing a sacred picture, worn by bishops of the Orthodox Eastern Church.

tgm003617.label: Entablatures
tgm003617.scope: Architecturally-treated walls. In classical architecture, the arrangement of three horizontal members (architrave, frieze, and cornice) above the supporting columns in any of the classical orders.

tgm003621.label: Entertainment
tgm003621.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm003627.label: Envelopes
tgm003627.scope: Flat, usually paper containers, as for mailing a letter. Typical illustrations include patriotic themes or business advertisements; introduced for common use in the 1840s.

tgm003634.label: Ephemera
tgm003634.scope: Transient everyday items, usually printed and on paper, that are manufactured for a specific limited use, then often discarded. Includes everyday items that are meant to be saved, at least for a while, such as KEEPSAKES and STOCK CERTIFICATES.

tgm003636.label: Epigonation
tgm003636.scope: Diamond-shaped garment used in Eastern Orthodox liturgical dress.

tgm003645.label: Equipment
tgm003645.scope: Devices or tools used in an activity or operation. Search also under the subdivision --EQUIPMENT & SUPPLIES used with names of wars (Appendix C), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm003653.label: Erotica
tgm003653.scope: Images intended to evoke sexual responses in the viewer.

tgm003664.label: Estates
tgm003664.scope: For the grounds and outbuildings on estates. Search under DWELLINGS for dwellings on estates.

tgm003668.label: Ethics
tgm003668.scope: For the discipline dealing with good and bad, and with moral duty and obligation, as well as for immoral/moral behavior and unethical/ethical practices. Search also under the subdivision --ETHICS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm003670.label: Ethnic groups
tgm003670.scope: For races or large groups of people classed according to common traits and customs. See also Library of Congress Subject Headings for names of individual groups.

tgm003671.label: Ethnic neighborhoods
tgm003671.scope: Quarters of cities in which members of a minority racial or cultural group live, including those which develop because of social, legal, or economic pressure.

tgm003672.label: Ethnic stereotypes
tgm003672.scope: Images that depict stereotypical traits of people classed according to shared racial, national, tribal, religious, linguistic, or cultural background.

tgm003673.label: Ethnographic photographs
tgm003673.scope: Photographs made for or by anthropologists and others involved in the systematic recording of human cultures.

tgm003675.label: Etiquette
tgm003675.scope: For the subject of good breeding in general and actions of good breeding observed in social and official life.

tgm003695.label: Examinations
tgm003695.scope: For the testing of persons. Search under TESTING for the testing of things.

tgm003708.label: Executions in effigy
tgm003708.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PORTRAYALS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm003720.label: Exhibition buildings
tgm003720.scope: For images that focus on structures depicted at the time of the exhibition. Search also under the subdivision --BUILDINGS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search under EXHIBITIONS for activities and general views.

tgm003721.label: Exhibition catalogs
tgm003721.scope: Catalogs of items in art or other exhibits.

tgm003723.label: Exhibition posters
tgm003723.scope: Posters for organized displays, including art exhibitions, trade shows, and world's fairs.

tgm003724.label: Exhibitions
tgm003724.scope: Includes activities and general views. Search under EXHIBITION BUILDINGS for images that focus on structures. Search also under the subdivision --EXHIBITIONS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A); names of persons (Appendix B); and names of wars (Appendix C). Search also under the subdivision --EXHIBITIONS & DISPLAYS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm003726.label: Exiles
tgm003726.scope: Persons banished from their home or country by vested authority as a punitive measure.

tgm003733.label: Expedition photographs
tgm003733.scope: Photographs intended to gather data or to document the activities of geological, geographical, anthropological, archaeological, or other scientific discovery expeditions.

tgm003739.label: Exploded drawings
tgm003739.scope: Graphic delineations showing the individual disassembled components of a structure or object. The parts are shown in their proper relationships with respect to their assembled positions.

tgm003745.label: Explosions
tgm003745.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm003753.label: Express highways
tgm003753.scope: Major high speed, high capacity roads.

tgm003790.label: Facilities
tgm003790.scope: Something that is built, installed, or established to serve a particular purpose; often combines structure(s) and developed terrain; may include activities.

tgm003792.label: Facsimile transmissions
tgm003792.scope: For facsimile machines and the concept of facsimile transmission.

tgm003793.label: Facsimiles
tgm003793.scope: Copies made by someone other than the creator of an original image; intended to look the same as the original but not intended as forgeries.

tgm003794.label: Factories
tgm003794.scope: Facilities devoted primarily to manufacturing of products or processing of materials. Search under INDUSTRY (or NTs) for activities.

tgm003823.label: Families
tgm003823.scope: Groups of people identified by family relationship. Search also under the subdivision --FAMILY used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm003828.label: Family trees
tgm003828.scope: Charts or other representations of family relationships. Includes decorated or pictorial charts with blank spaces for names or portraits.

tgm003836.label: Fanlights
tgm003836.scope: Semicircular windows made with radiating sash bars like the ribs of a fan and placed over a door or window.

tgm003837.label: Fans (Ephemera)
tgm003837.scope: Flat or folding fans with advertisements, souvenir or commemorative messages, or pictures.

tgm003838.label: Fans (Accessories)
tgm003838.scope: Hand-held, flat or folding implements, often with decorative illustrations, carried as costume accessories or to produce a refreshing current of air.

tgm003842.label: Fantasy
tgm003842.scope: A creation of the imagination, especially an unrealistic or improbable mental image.

tgm003849.label: Farm life
tgm003849.scope: For home life, leisure, and non-work activities. Search under FARMING for activities.

tgm003860.label: Farming
tgm003860.scope: For work activities on farms. Search under PLANTS and NTs for specific farm crops. Search also under the subdivision --SUBSISTENCE ACTIVITIES used with indigenous people (Appendix A).

tgm003862.label: Farms
tgm003862.scope: For tracts of land or water devoted to agricultural purposes.

tgm003867.label: Fascism
tgm003867.scope: For the subject of fascism in general.

tgm003868.label: Fascists
tgm003868.scope: Search under FASCISM for the subject of fascism in general and the activities of fascists.

tgm003870.label: Fashion design drawings
tgm003870.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and production (or documentation of design and production) of apparel and accessories.

tgm003873.label: Fashion industry
tgm003873.scope: For high fashion design, including activities and marketing.

tgm003875.label: Fashion photographs
tgm003875.scope: Photographs made to sell clothing and accessories or show them to advantage. These photographs differ from GLAMOUR PHOTOGRAPHS, which emphasize the physical attractiveness of the subject, and PUBLICITY PHOTOGRAPHS, which are made for publicity or promotion purposes.

tgm003876.label: Fashion plates
tgm003876.scope: Periodical illustrations made to advertise current fashion designs. Earliest date from the late 1700s; popular in the 1830s and later.

tgm003877.label: Fashion prints
tgm003877.scope: Separate prints issued by clothing manufacturers or haberdashers depicting or advertising their current designs.

tgm003879.label: Fast food restaurants
tgm003879.scope: For establishments where already prepared or readily prepared food that can be packaged for take-out is served; often run as part of chains or franchises.

tgm003914.label: Female figure drawings
tgm003914.scope: Drawings of the human female body, other than portraits.

tgm003917.label: Feminism
tgm003917.scope: For the subject of feminism beyond a reaction against sexism or advocacy of women's rights. For example, consciousness raising, women's solidarity, etc.

tgm003918.label: Feminists
tgm003918.scope: Search under FEMINISM for the subject of feminism in general and the activities of feminists.

tgm003933.label: Festoons
tgm003933.scope: A festive decoration of pendant semiloops with attachments and loose ends, especially a swag of fabric, or representations of such decorations.

tgm003960.label: Fighting
tgm003960.scope: For fistfights and other spontaneous fighting. Search under QUARRELING for verbal fighting.

tgm003961.label: Figure drawings
tgm003961.scope: Drawings of the human body, or any of its parts, other than portraits.

tgm003966.label: Figurines
tgm003966.scope: Small sculptures of humans or animals.

tgm003973.label: Film negatives
tgm003973.scope: Negatives on a flexible base, such as celluloid or polyester. Introduced commercially in the 1880s.

tgm003975.label: Film stills
tgm003975.scope: Still images made during the production of a motion picture that show scenes from the movie; usually for publicity purposes.

tgm003977.label: Film transparencies
tgm003977.scope: Transparencies on a flexible base, such as celluloid or polyester.

tgm003982.label: Financial disclosure
tgm003982.scope: For the disclosure of personal finances of public officials and of candidates and appointees for public office.

tgm003993.label: Fire
tgm003993.scope: For the subject of fire in general and non-destructive fires. Search under FIRES for destructive fires.

tgm004004.label: Fire fighting
tgm004004.scope: For general views in which fire engines and equipment are in use.

tgm004010.label: Fire insurance maps
tgm004010.scope: Maps intended for use in calculating fire insurance risks. They include data on size and construction materials of structures and on property boundaries, street widths, water supplies, and other features.

tgm004017.label: Firearms
tgm004017.scope: For weapons from which missiles, as bullets, balls, or shells, are hurled by the action of explosives.

tgm004023.label: Firebreaks
tgm004023.scope: A strip of land cleared to stop the spread of fire, as in a forest or prairie.

tgm004026.label: Firefighting equipment
tgm004026.scope: Search under FIRE FIGHTING for general views in which fire engines and equipment are in use.

tgm004031.label: Fires
tgm004031.scope: For destructive fires. Includes the event and any resulting damage. Search under FIRE for the general subject of fire and for non-destructive fires.

tgm004035.label: Fire-resistive construction
tgm004035.scope: Method of construction that prevents or retards the passage of hot gases or flames.

tgm004043.label: Firsts
tgm004043.scope: For figurative milestones. Search under MILESTONES for milestones that measure distance.

tgm004045.label: Fish
tgm004045.scope: For images of fish. Search under FISHING for activities.

tgm004059.label: Fisheye photographs
tgm004059.scope: For photographs taken with a fisheye lense to produce a circular image having a strongly curved component that distorts the image as it radiates from the center.

tgm004061.label: Fisheye views
tgm004061.scope: For circular images that have a strongly curved component that distorts the image as it radiates from the center.

tgm004063.label: Fishing
tgm004063.scope: For the subject of fishing in general and fishing as a local livelihood. Includes portraits of fishermen with their catch. Search under FISHING INDUSTRY for large-scale fishing. Search also under the subdivision --SUBSISTENCE ACTIVITIES used with indigenous peoples (Appendix A).

tgm004065.label: Fishing industry
tgm004065.scope: For large-scale fishing and processing of fish. Search under FISHING for fishing in general or as a local livelihood.

tgm004071.label: Fishing & hunting gear
tgm004071.scope: For images that focus on the equipment. Search under FISHING and under HUNTING for activities using the equipment.

tgm004080.label: Fjords
tgm004080.scope: Narrow deep inlets of the sea between cliffs or steep slopes.

tgm004091.label: Flash photographs
tgm004091.scope: Photographs made with the aid of magnesium, electronic, or other flash lighting mechanisms.

tgm004102.label: Flaying
tgm004102.scope: Punishment or torture by stripping or pulling off the skin of a live person.

tgm004107.label: Fliers (Printed matter)
tgm004107.scope: Inexpensively produced single sheet announcements or advertisements for distribution among the general public.

tgm004116.label: Flip books
tgm004116.scope: Illustrations bound together that create an animated scene when the pages are flipped in rapid succession.

tgm004124.label: Floats (Parades)
tgm004124.scope: Decorated platforms used in parades on land or sea.

tgm004129.label: Floods
tgm004129.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm004131.label: Floor plans
tgm004131.scope: Plans that represent horizontal sections cut through the walls and other vertical elements of a building at one or more levels. They demonstrate the shape and disposition of spaces, chambers, and structural components. They include information on placement and dimensions of features, such as doors, walls, built-in equipment, and room names.

tgm004143.label: Flues
tgm004143.scope: Heat-resistant enclosed passageways used in buildings to control drafts and carry away products of combustion from fireplaces, furnaces, or boilers to the outside air.

tgm004146.label: Flutes
tgm004146.scope: Includes the activity of playing flutes.

tgm004150.label: Flying
tgm004150.scope: For images of people or animals in flight, unaided by mechanisms.

tgm004157.label: Flypaper
tgm004157.scope: Paper poisoned or coated with sticky substance for killing flies.

tgm004164.label: Folk dancing
tgm004164.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DANCE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm004181.label: Food processing
tgm004181.scope: For all processing that takes place to convert raw food for later consumption.

tgm004183.label: Food relief
tgm004183.scope: Subdivide by nationality only when relief provided to another country.

tgm004189.label: Fools' caps
tgm004189.scope: Caps or hoods, usually with bells, worn by fools or jesters; also, conical caps for slow or lazy students.

tgm004208.label: Forced labor
tgm004208.scope: Work performed under compulsion or without pay.

tgm004210.label: Forecasting
tgm004210.scope: Predicting future events or developments by means other than supernatural practices or interpretation of omens.

tgm004222.label: Forensic photographs
tgm004222.scope: Photographs that document physical facts and serve as evidence, especially in litigation.

tgm004225.label: Forestry
tgm004225.scope: For the subject of forestry in general and the activities of foresters.

tgm004228.label: Forgeries
tgm004228.scope: Illegal imitations or counterfeits; fakes offered as genuine works; may be reproductions or merely in the style of a specific type of work and presented as genuine.

tgm004230.label: Forging
tgm004230.scope: Forming a metal into a particular shape by heating and hammering.

tgm004234.label: Formation photographs
tgm004234.scope: Photographs taken from an elevated vantage point of a large group of people assembled to form a particular design, such as an eagle or the United States flag.

tgm004238.label: Forms (Documents)
tgm004238.scope: Printed or typed documents with blank spaces for insertion of requested information. Examples include report cards, telegrams, tax forms, checks, and summonses.

tgm004239.label: Forts & fortifications
tgm004239.scope: Fortified places occupied by troops or permanent army posts. Includes activities & structures.

tgm004242.label: Fortune telling cards
tgm004242.scope: Playing cards made specifically for forecasting the future.

tgm004245.label: Forums
tgm004245.scope: Roman public squares surrounded by monumental buildings.

tgm004251.label: Founders' Day commemorations
tgm004251.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with names of corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm004252.label: Founding
tgm004252.scope: Forming a metal by melting and pouring in a mold; casting.

tgm004253.label: Foundries
tgm004253.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under FOUNDING for activities.

tgm004264.label: Foxholes
tgm004264.scope: A pit dug for individual cover from enemy fire.

tgm004269.label: Frakturs (Illuminations)
tgm004269.scope: Illuminations typically made by the Pennsylvania Dutch, in which flowers, birds and other motifs decorate a text, such as a household motto or marriage certificate; drawn or printed.

tgm004272.label: Framing drawings
tgm004272.scope: Designs for the construction and assembly of a skeletal structural system for a floor, wall, roof, or entire building.

tgm004278.label: Fraternities & sororities
tgm004278.scope: For fraternal organizations associated with colleges and universities, including their professional fraternities, honor societies, and social societies. Includes activities and structures.

tgm004279.label: Fraternization
tgm004279.scope: To engage in comradely exchange or associate on intimate terms, especially with enemy soldiers or with civilians of an occupied country and often contrary to military orders.

tgm004321.label: Frescoes
tgm004321.scope: Mural painting in which pigments are applied on freshly laid lime plaster.

tgm004322.label: Fresson prints
tgm004322.scope: Photographic prints developed and printed on fiber-based paper using a four-color process invented by Theodore-Henri Fresson. The process is a laborious and tightly controlled family secret which uses pigment rather than dye, and the print is therefore unusually stable.

tgm004329.label: Friends' meeting houses
tgm004329.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm004331.label: Friezes (Entablature components)
tgm004331.scope: For middle horizontal members of classical entablatures above the architrave and below the cornice. Search under FRIEZES (ORNAMENTAL BANDS) for horizontal bands decorating architecture, furniture, or other objects and containing figures, scenes, or ornamental motifs.

tgm004332.label: Friezes (Ornamental bands)
tgm004332.scope: For horizontal bands decorating architecture, furniture, or other objects and containing figures, scenes, or ornamental motifs. Search under FRIEZES (ENTABLATURE COMPONENTS) for specific parts of classical entablatures.

tgm004338.label: Frontispieces
tgm004338.scope: Illustrations placed next to the title page.

tgm004341.label: Fruit
tgm004341.scope: For the subject of edible fruit in general and images that focus on fruit.

tgm004343.label: Fruit crate labels
tgm004343.scope: Slips of paper for identification, description, or decoration of fruit crates.

tgm004352.label: Fuel tanks
tgm004352.scope: Large containers for holding liquids or gases.

tgm004353.label: Fuel trade
tgm004353.scope: Manufacture and trade of fuel. Includes activities and structures.

tgm004355.label: Fuelwood
tgm004355.scope: For images that focus on segments of small trees and branches to be used for fires, including woodpiles. Search under WOODCUTTING for activities.

tgm004365.label: Fund raising
tgm004365.scope: Entertainments, events, etc., to raise money for persons or causes. Search under MEMBERSHIP CAMPAIGNS for the raising of money for organizations through membership drives.

tgm004372.label: Funeral rites & ceremonies
tgm004372.scope: For rites and ceremonies in memory of persons, with the deceased present; also for customs associated with mourning. Search under MEMORIAL RITES & CEREMONIES for rites and ceremonies without the presence of the deceased. Search also under the subdivision --DEATH & BURIAL used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm004376.label: Funnels
tgm004376.scope: Cone-shaped utensil with a tube for directing a downward flow of liquid or other fluid.

tgm004380.label: Fur trade
tgm004380.scope: Search under TRADING POSTS for images that focus on facilities.

tgm004391.label: Gadgets
tgm004391.scope: Small mechanical or electronic devices with a practical use but often thought of as novelties.

tgm004393.label: Galleries (Display spaces)
tgm004393.scope: Rooms or spaces in museums, homes, or other buildings used for displaying artworks and other objects in a collection.

tgm004394.label: Galleries (Upper level spaces)
tgm004394.scope: Platforms or spaces which project from interior walls and overlook the level below.

tgm004395.label: Galleries & museums
tgm004395.scope: Includes activities, structures, and objects displayed.

tgm004400.label: Gambling
tgm004400.scope: Betting of money or valuables on, and often participating in, games of chance or skill.

tgm004401.label: Gambrel roofs
tgm004401.scope: Roofs with lower part sloping more steeply than upper.

tgm004404.label: Game cards
tgm004404.scope: Cards designed for use with specific games and lacking standard suit systems. Examples include Old Maid and Game of Authors.

tgm004407.label: Game pieces
tgm004407.scope: Objects manipulated by participants during the play of table and boardgames.

tgm004412.label: Gameboards
tgm004412.scope: Board or boardlike game accessories marked such that the progress of play can be tracked.

tgm004416.label: Gangplanks
tgm004416.scope: A movable bridge used in boarding or leaving a ship at a pier.

tgm004461.label: Gasoline
tgm004461.scope: For the fuel. Search under AUTOMOBILE SERVICE STATIONS and GASOLINE PUMPS for gas pumps.

tgm004464.label: Gasoline pumps
tgm004464.scope: For gas pumps not associated with service stations. Search under AUTOMOBILE SERVICE STATIONS for those that are part of the station.; AAT: identical

tgm004469.label: Gatehouses
tgm004469.scope: Buildings enclosing or accompanying gateways for castles, manor houses, or similar buildings of importance. Includes security gatehouses.

tgm004477.label: Gavels
tgm004477.scope: Mallets used (as by presiding officers or auctioneers) for commanding attention or confirming actions (as votes or sales).

tgm004495.label: Gelatin silver film negatives
tgm004495.scope: Film negatives having gelatin as the binder, holding silver as the final image material.

tgm004496.label: Gelatin silver film transparencies
tgm004496.scope: Film transparencies having gelatin as the binder, holding silver as the final image material.

tgm004497.label: Gelatin silver glass transparencies
tgm004497.scope: Glass transparencies having gelatin as the binder, holding silver as the final image material.

tgm004498.label: Gelatin silver printing-out paper prints
tgm004498.scope: Prints having gelatin as the binder, holding silver as the final image material. Introduced in the 1880s; still marketed as studio proof paper.

tgm004499.label: Gelatin silver prints
tgm004499.scope: Photographic prints made by several formulas; introduced in the 1880s; dominant black-and-white photographic print process since the 1890s. Includes various common developing-out papers that are very difficult to distinguish by visual inspection (e.g., bromide, chloride or gaslight, and chloro-bromide) and one printing-out process.

tgm004501.label: Gem photographs
tgm004501.scope: Very small tintypes that were usually mounted in a paper folder or in jewlery. Popular mid-1860s to 1880.

tgm004511.label: Genocide
tgm004511.scope: Deliberate and systematic destruction of a racial, political, or cultural group.

tgm004516.label: Genre works
tgm004516.scope: Scenes or incidents of everyday life, such as domestic interiors or rural and village scenes; tableaux; chiefly pre-1900.

tgm004517.label: Geodesic domes
tgm004517.scope: A domed or vaulted structure of lightweight, straight elements that form interlocking polygons.

tgm004518.label: Geography
tgm004518.scope: For the subject of geography in general and the activities of geographers.

tgm004519.label: Geology
tgm004519.scope: For the subject of geology in general and the activities of geologists.

tgm004520.label: Geometry
tgm004520.scope: For the subject of geometry in general and the activities of geometers.

tgm004524.label: Gerontology
tgm004524.scope: For the subject of gerontology in general and the activities of gerontologists.

tgm004525.label: Gerrymandering
tgm004525.scope: Dividing (a state, country, etc.) into election districts or other civil divisions in an unnatural or unfair way, especially to give a political party an advantage over its opponent.

tgm004527.label: Gestures
tgm004527.scope: Used for images of "giving the finger" or "thumbing the nose."

tgm004528.label: Geysers
tgm004528.scope: Eruptive springs from which hot water, steam, and/or mud are periodically spurted.

tgm004530.label: Ghats
tgm004530.scope: Flights of steps, in India, which lead down to rivers or other bodies of water.

tgm004534.label: Ghost towns
tgm004534.scope: Towns, especially boom towns of the West, that have been completely abandoned.

tgm004553.label: Gladiators
tgm004553.scope: Persons engaged in fights to the death as public entertainment for ancient Romans or persons engaged in public fights or controversies.

tgm004555.label: Glamour photographs
tgm004555.scope: Photographs portraying women or men and emphasizing their physical attractiveness. Subjects may be scantily clad, but desirability is conveyed, not erotica. Similar to FASHION PHOTOGRAPHS, which emphasize the product being modeled, and PUBLICITY PHOTOGRAPHS, which are made for publicity or promotion purposes.

tgm004577.label: Gloating
tgm004577.scope: Observing or thinking about something with great or malicious satisfaction.

tgm004586.label: Goat carts
tgm004586.scope: Small carts used to convey people, especially children.

tgm004602.label: Gold standard
tgm004602.scope: A monetary standard which establishes the basic unit of currency by a set amount of gold.

tgm004607.label: Golf
tgm004607.scope: Includes golf activities, golf courses, and structures.

tgm004629.label: Gouaches
tgm004629.scope: Opaque watercolor drawings or paintings, commonly combined with pastels, India ink, and transparent watercolors.

tgm004635.label: Government employees
tgm004635.scope: Search also under the subdivision --STAFF used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm004641.label: Government officials
tgm004641.scope: Search also under the subdivision --STAFF used with names of PERSONS (Appendix B).

tgm004652.label: Government shutdowns
tgm004652.scope: For temporary closures due to fiscal crisis or weather-related reasons.

tgm004658.label: Governmental investigations
tgm004658.scope: Investigations initiated by legislative, executive, or judicial branches of government and usually conducted by ad hoc or permanent bodies for the purpose of investigating some particular problem of public interest.

tgm004660.label: Governors
tgm004660.scope: For the subject of the governship in general and for incumbents.

tgm004674.label: Grain elevators
tgm004674.scope: Buildings for elevating, storing, discharging, and sometimes processing grain.

tgm004675.label: Grain industry
tgm004675.scope: Includes activities and structures involved in grain processing and trade.

tgm004682.label: Granaries
tgm004682.scope: Storehouses or repositories for grain, especially after it has been threshed or husked.

tgm004688.label: Grandpa's hat
tgm004688.scope: Symbol for Benjamin Harrison, whose grandfather, William H. Harrison, was President before him.

tgm004689.label: Grandstands
tgm004689.scope: A usually roofed stand for spectators at a race course or stadium.

tgm004698.label: Graphic design
tgm004698.scope: To plan and create typography and images for commercial purposes such as book production, posters, advertising, packaging, signage, and logos.

tgm004699.label: Graphic design drawings
tgm004699.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and production of printed or typographical works such as book jackets, labels, logos, posters, and advertisements.

tgm004702.label: Graphs
tgm004702.scope: A geometric representation consisting of coordinates that show a relationship between numbers.

tgm004713.label: Graves
tgm004713.scope: For excavations in the earth used for burials. Search under TOMBS & SEPULCHRAL MONUMENTS for constructions over or around burial sites.

tgm004728.label: Greeting cards
tgm004728.scope: Cards sent or given on special occasions; usually bearing messages of good will.

tgm004733.label: Griffins
tgm004733.scope: Fabulous animals typically having head, forepart, and wings like those of an eagle but with visible usually erect ears, forelegs like the legs of an eagle, and body, hind legs, and tail like those of a lion.

tgm004734.label: Grilles
tgm004734.scope: Gratings forming openwork barriers, screens, or covers (as to doors, windows, or other openings).

tgm004736.label: Grinding machines
tgm004736.scope: Machines that reduce material to small fragments or powder by friction; also includes polishing machinery.

tgm004744.label: Grocery stores
tgm004744.scope: A small retail market selling food and other merchandise, run by a grocer. Includes activities and structures.

tgm004745.label: Grooming
tgm004745.scope: Process of making neat or attractive either by oneself or by commercial services.

tgm004748.label: Grooms (Weddings)
tgm004748.scope: For images which focus on persons. Search under WEDDINGS for activities.

tgm004750.label: Grotesques
tgm004750.scope: Ornamental motifs including fanciful human and animal forms, and floral ornament.

tgm004756.label: Ground-effect machines
tgm004756.scope: Vehicle for short-distance travel which is supported above land or water by air cushions created by downwardly directed fans.

tgm004759.label: Group portraits
tgm004759.scope: Portraits in which two or more people are shown. Includes groups assembled through photomontage, combination printing techniques, or an artist's imagination.

tgm004771.label: Guerrillas
tgm004771.scope: Persons who engage in irregular warfare, especially predatory excursions, in wartime. Search also under the subdivision --GUERRILLAS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm004776.label: Guides & scouts
tgm004776.scope: Includes those who act as guides or scouts in non-military contexts, e.g. expeditions, exploration, and travel. Search under MILITARY SCOUTS for scouts operating in military contexts.

tgm004778.label: Guilds
tgm004778.scope: Medieval associations, as of merchants and tradesmen, formed to protect the interests of their members.

tgm004780.label: Guitars
tgm004780.scope: Includes the activity of playing guitars.

tgm004786.label: Gum bichromate prints
tgm004786.scope: Non-silver photographic prints made by coating white or color paper with a light-sensitive gum arabic solution and any desired pigment color. The print hardens selectively during exposure to a negative. Additional coatings and exposures are possible. Developed in the 1850s but little used until the 1890s.

tgm004794.label: Gun turrets
tgm004794.scope: Towers or tower-like structures, usually revolving, on which heavy guns are mounted; used on vessels and, sometimes land fortifications.

tgm004795.label: Gunboats
tgm004795.scope: Armed ships of shallow draft used primarily in rivers and harbors.

tgm004808.label: Gynaecea
tgm004808.scope: Women's apartments in Greek or Roman houses, or the women's gallery in a Byzantine church.

tgm004823.label: Hair ornaments
tgm004823.scope: Various types of ornaments, such as hairpins, decorative combs, beadwork, and ribbons worn by men or women.

tgm004827.label: Hairdressing
tgm004827.scope: Action or process of washing, cutting, curling, or arranging hair.

tgm004831.label: Halftone negatives
tgm004831.scope: Negatives in which the image appears as exposed through a line screen as a pattern of dots or squares of varying sizes. Used to make printing plates for halftone photomechanical prints.

tgm004832.label: Halftone photomechanical prints
tgm004832.scope: Prints distinguished by patterns of dots or circular lines, or other indication of the screen interposed between the original image and the camera. Usually used to reproduce continuous tone originals, such as photographs, in books, newspapers, or other publications. First commercially available in the 1880s.

tgm004835.label: Halls
tgm004835.scope: Large rooms for sleeping and family use; also the main rooms of a medieval house and large, central rooms in some 19th and 20th century English and American homes.

tgm004857.label: Handbills
tgm004857.scope: Small single-sheet notices, usually unfolded; may be printed on both sides; intended for wide distribution by hand, mailing, or other means.

tgm004861.label: Handguns
tgm004861.scope: For firearms that are held and fired with one hand.

tgm004863.label: Handicraft
tgm004863.scope: Activities requiring skill with the hands. Search also under the subdivision --ARTS & CRAFTS used with the names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm004864.label: Handkerchiefs
tgm004864.scope: Pieces of cloth, usually square, and intended for wearing; printed with commemorative designs for use as souvenirs, or with political slogans for use as promotional material, especially during the mid- to late-1800s.

tgm004872.label: Hangings (Textiles)
tgm004872.scope: Textiles hung to cover interior spaces, surfaces, or furniture, for protection, warmth, or decoration.

tgm004878.label: Harbors
tgm004878.scope: Small bays or other sheltered parts of a considerable body of water, usually protected either naturally or artificially, for mooring vessels.

tgm004880.label: Hardware
tgm004880.scope: Ware (as fittings, trimmings, cutlery, tools, utensils, or parts of machines) made of metal.

tgm004882.label: Harems
tgm004882.scope: A group of women in a Muslim household, including wives and concubines.

tgm004889.label: Harps
tgm004889.scope: Includes the activity of playing harps.

tgm004890.label: Harpsichords
tgm004890.scope: Includes the activity of playing harpsichords.

tgm004898.label: Hate crimes
tgm004898.scope: Crimes motivated by hostility towards a group such as a racial, ethnic, gender, or religious group.

tgm004920.label: Headframes (Mining)
tgm004920.scope: Structure at the top of a mine shaft containing hoisting equipment.

tgm004931.label: Healers
tgm004931.scope: Persons who engage in the practice of treating illness or relieving suffering by calling for divine help or by asserting that the mind or spirit can control the body.

tgm004932.label: Healing
tgm004932.scope: For practices directed at curing or restoring to health and for the process of getting well. Search under HEALERS for images that focus on persons rather than activities. Search under HEALTH CARE for activities or systems for maintaining or improving health.

tgm004933.label: Health
tgm004933.scope: For the state of optimal physical and mental well-being, free of pain or disease. Search under HEALTH CARE for activities or systems directed at maintaining or improving health. Search under HYGIENE for personal body care and cleanliness. Search also under the subdivision --HEALTH & WELFARE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --HEALTH used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm004934.label: Health care
tgm004934.scope: Activities or systems directed at maintaining or improving health. Search under HEALING for specific curing practices and for the process of getting well.

tgm004962.label: Heliographs (Apparatus)
tgm004962.scope: Signalling apparatus that reflects sunlight with a movable mirror to flash coded messages.

tgm004968.label: Helmets
tgm004968.scope: For various protective head coverings usually made of a hard material to resist impact.

tgm004969.label: Helms
tgm004969.scope: Lever or wheel for controlling the rudder of a ship.

tgm004984.label: Herms
tgm004984.scope: Rectangular post, usually of stone and tapering downward, surmounted by bust of Hermes or other divinity, or by a human head.

tgm004990.label: Hidden image works
tgm004990.scope: Works in which images or text are hidden until revealed by an action, such as holding them to the light, heating them, or rubbing away a covering surface.

tgm005015.label: Historic buildings
tgm005015.scope: Buildings generally or formally recognized as historically significant for their associations, materials, methods of construction, or other factors.

tgm005017.label: Historic sites
tgm005017.scope: Search also under the subdivision --HISTORIC SITES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm005019.label: Historical dramas
tgm005019.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) of historical events or with historical settings that emphasize the dramatic. Search under HISTORICAL REENACTMENTS for enactments of specific historical events, such as battles, etc.

tgm005021.label: Historical pageants
tgm005021.scope: Elaborate, usually open-air, exhibitions or spectacles that are marked by colorful costumes and scenery, and consist of a series of tableaux as representations of important events in the history of a community.

tgm005022.label: Historical reenactments
tgm005022.scope: For images representing enactments of specific historical events, such as battles, etc. Search under HISTORICAL DRAMAS for images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) of historical events or with historical settings that emphasize the dramatic. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm005025.label: History
tgm005025.scope: For the subject of history in general and the activities of historians. Search also under the subdivision --HISTORY used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A) and corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm005027.label: Hitching posts
tgm005027.scope: Fixed posts to which horses can be fastened.

tgm005033.label: Hobbyists
tgm005033.scope: For people identified as hobbyists, including those engaged in hobbies or displaying the results of their work.

tgm005041.label: Hogans
tgm005041.scope: Low dome-shaped Navajo homes made of logs and stick frames covered with mud, sod, or adobe.

tgm005049.label: Hold-to-light works
tgm005049.scope: Cards or sheets of paper with portions cut out and backed with tissue or other transparent material. When held up to a light source, a hidden picture is revealed or the cut-out portions (generally windows, lights, or the sun) appear brightly illuminated.

tgm005056.label: Holograms
tgm005056.scope: Photographs that present a three-dimensional image of a subject which changes as the viewing angle changes. Produced with laser technology; after 1960.

tgm005064.label: Home economics
tgm005064.scope: For theory and instruction about how to run the home, including budgeting and the proper performance of household tasks. Search under HOUSEWORK for the work involved in housekeeping.

tgm005067.label: Home labor
tgm005067.scope: For the production of goods in urban homes for an outside employer.

tgm005073.label: Homecomings
tgm005073.scope: For occasions when people return to their families or homeland after a long absence. Search under REUNIONS for the coming together of people to mark a former or ongoing association.

tgm005104.label: Hormones
tgm005104.scope: Naturally occuring or synthetic organic compounds which regulate growth and other physiological activities in animals.

tgm005111.label: Horror dramas
tgm005111.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) which intend to frighten or terrify the audience.

tgm005134.label: Horticulture
tgm005134.scope: For the subject of the cultivation of gardens or orchards, the art of growing fruit, vegetables, and ornamental plants, and the activities of horticulturalists.

tgm005158.label: Hot rods
tgm005158.scope: An automobile modified for high speed.

tgm005165.label: Hotels
tgm005165.scope: Includes structures and activities. Search under HOTEL EMPLOYEES for images where the focus is on employees. Search under RESORTS for resort complexes.

tgm005188.label: Household soap
tgm005188.scope: Soap used in household cleaning tasks.

tgm005198.label: Housework
tgm005198.scope: For work involved in housekeeping. Search under HOME ECONOMICS for theory and instruction about how to run the home.

tgm005200.label: Housing developments
tgm005200.scope: Groups of individual dwellings or apartment houses typically of similar design that are usually built and sold or leased by one management.

tgm005203.label: Howdahs
tgm005203.scope: Seats or covered pavilions on the back of an elephant or camel.

tgm005209.label: Human curiosities
tgm005209.scope: For real persons who are being represented as curiosities or freaks, which may be caused by birth defects or accidents or faked. Search under MONSTERS for animals of strange or terrifying shape.

tgm005213.label: Human rights
tgm005213.scope: For the birthright of all human beings to life, liberty and security of person. Search under CIVIL RIGHTS for the constitutional and legal status and treatment of minority groups that are distinguished from the majority by race, religion, sex, national origin, etc.

tgm005220.label: Hunting
tgm005220.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SUBSISTENCE ACTIVITIES used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). For portraits and images of hunters and their quarry use HUNTERS.

tgm005229.label: Hurricanes
tgm005229.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm005233.label: Huts
tgm005233.scope: Simple shelters often roughly built using available raw materials. Often temporary in nature.

tgm005234.label: HVAC drawings
tgm005234.scope: Drawings of heating, ventilating, and air conditioning systems.

tgm005235.label: HVAC systems
alt: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems

tgm005244.label: Hydroplanes
tgm005244.scope: Boats that skim over the surface of the water but do not become airborne.

tgm005247.label: Hygiene
tgm005247.scope: For personal body care and cleanliness.

tgm005249.label: Hymn boards
tgm005249.scope: A board hung in a church to display hymn numbers and readings for services.

tgm005280.label: Icebergs
tgm005280.scope: Huge, floating masses of ice, detached from glaciers.

tgm005281.label: Iceboats
tgm005281.scope: Includes images that focus on people and activity.

tgm005283.label: Icebreakers
tgm005283.scope: A structure that protects a bridge or pier from floating ice.

tgm005284.label: Icehouses
tgm005284.scope: Buildings in which ice is made or stored.

tgm005288.label: Iconostases
tgm005288.scope: Screens in Eastern Orthodox churches that separate the sactuary from the nave, usually covered with icons.

tgm005292.label: Identification photographs
tgm005292.scope: Photographs made to provide identification of people, animals, and plants for various government, legal, or commercial purposes.

tgm005294.label: Igloos
tgm005294.scope: Dome shaped houses built of blocks of snow.

tgm005307.label: Illuminations
tgm005307.scope: Book leaves or single sheets of text embellished with hand-drawn ornamental letters, scrolls, paintings, and other designs; usually gold and color; may be decorations or illustrations.

tgm005314.label: Illustrations
tgm005314.scope: Images that explain or elaborate a written or spoken text; may be issued separately from the text. Published and unpublished illustrations are included, as are pictures made in one medium to be published as illustrations in a different medium.

tgm005323.label: Immigrants
tgm005323.scope: Persons who leave their native land and settle in another country in order to become permanent residents or citizens. For emigrants as well as immigrants.

tgm005326.label: Immigration stations
tgm005326.scope: Search under EMIGRATION & IMMIGRATION for activities.

tgm005330.label: Impeachments
tgm005330.scope: Search also under the subdivision --IMPEACHMENT used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm005331.label: Imperial card photographs
tgm005331.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 10 x 7 in. (26 x 18 cm.). Introduced in the United States ca. 1890.

tgm005332.label: Imperialism
tgm005332.scope: For the subject of imperialism in general.

tgm005333.label: Impersonation
tgm005333.scope: For the activity of pretending to be another person or type of person. Search also under ENTERTAINERS (and NTs) for portraits in costume. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivisions --PERFORMANCES and --PORTRAYALS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm005339.label: Inaugurations
tgm005339.scope: Search also under the subdivision --INAUGURATION used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm005343.label: Inclined planes
tgm005343.scope: Inclined tracks on which vehicles such as trains, boats, and cars, are raised or lowered from one level to another.

tgm005344.label: Inclined railroads
tgm005344.scope: Used only if the railroad is described as being inclined.

tgm005351.label: Indian encampments
tgm005351.scope: Search also under --STRUCTURES used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups (Appendix A).

tgm005356.label: Indigenous peoples
tgm005356.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). See also Library of Congress Subject Headings for names of specific groups.

tgm005365.label: Industrial design drawings
tgm005365.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and production (or documentation of design and production) of utilitarian or machine-made objects, usually for a mass market. Primarily a development of the 1900s related to products as various as automobiles, lighting fixtures, furniture, and dinnerware.

tgm005367.label: Industrial facilities
tgm005367.scope: Search under INDUSTRY (or NTs) for activities.

tgm005371.label: Industrial trusts
tgm005371.scope: Combinations of firms or corporations formed by legal agreement, especially ones that reduce or threaten to reduce competition.

tgm005373.label: Industry
tgm005373.scope: Manufacture, trade, and the processing of materials and products. Includes activities and structures. Search also under the subdivision --INDUSTRIES used with names of indigenous peoples (Appendix A).

tgm005383.label: Infirmaries
tgm005383.scope: For health care units which provide uncomplicated medical and nursing care for residents or members of an institution or other facility.

tgm005389.label: Infrared photographs
tgm005389.scope: Photographs made with film that is sensitive to infrared light. Chiefly 1930s or later.

tgm005395.label: Initiation rites
