tgm005395.scope: For the rites, ceremonies, and associated ordeals and instructions, with which one is made a member of or gains particular status in a sect or society; includes ceremonies in which a youth is formally invested with adult status.

tgm005402.label: Inkjet prints
tgm005402.scope: Prints made with computer-controlled devices by forcing droplets of ink onto paper or other surfaces. The appearance of the drops ranges from a halftone to continuous tone effect. The technology became widespread in the 1990s.

tgm005403.label: Inkless intaglio prints
tgm005403.scope: Prints made without ink; portions of the paper forced into relief create the image.

tgm005416.label: Insignia
tgm005416.scope: Devices that indicate authority, rank, office, or honor in association with an organization such as a military corps.

tgm005421.label: Instant camera photographs
tgm005421.scope: Photographs made from film packets that contain their own developing chemicals. Polaroid introduced the process in 1947. Chiefly photographic prints; also, negatives and transparencies.

tgm005423.label: Institutional care
tgm005423.scope: Includes activities and structures. Search also under the subdivision --HEALTH & WELFARE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm005430.label: Insurance certificates
tgm005430.scope: Documents issued to certify coverage against loss.

tgm005451.label: Intergovernmental relations
tgm005451.scope: Use for relations between different and equivalent levels of government within one country.

tgm005453.label: Interior decoration
tgm005453.scope: Selecting and arranging the surface ornamentation and furnishings of an interior.

tgm005455.label: Interior design
tgm005455.scope: Design specializing in interiors, including space planning, construction, building systems, acoustics, lighting, heating, and air conditioning.

tgm005456.label: Interior design drawings
tgm005456.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design or construction (or documentation of design and construction) of residential and non- residential interiors. They include physical layout, support systems, furnishings, finishes, and fixtures.

tgm005459.label: Interlocking directorates
tgm005459.scope: The holding of one individual of directorates in two or more separate corporations.

tgm005461.label: Internal migration
tgm005461.scope: Process of moving within a country.

tgm005463.label: International agricultural assistance
tgm005463.scope: International aid to agriculture given to underdeveloped areas in the form of technical assistance. Search under FARM RELIEF for economic assistance to agriculture.

tgm005466.label: International economic assistance
tgm005466.scope: For international aid given in the form of technical assistance, loans, or relief grants.

tgm005469.label: International organization
tgm005469.scope: For the theories and efforts leading toward world-wide or regional political organization of nations.

tgm005470.label: International organizations
tgm005470.scope: Includes governmental and nongovernmental bodies, whether established on a permanent or temporary basis, where the focus is on the international character of the body.

tgm005471.label: International police
tgm005471.scope: United Nations and non-United Nations armed forces which assist in maintaining peace between warring factions.

tgm005472.label: International relations
tgm005472.scope: Search also under the subdivision --Diplomacy used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm005473.label: International security
tgm005473.scope: Policies by associations of nations to maintain international peace by collective action against violators of the peace by aggressors.

tgm005476.label: Internationalism
tgm005476.scope: Political activity focusing on the universal human condition rather than the narrow interests of a nation.

tgm005478.label: Interpersonal relations
tgm005478.scope: Includes relations among individuals and groups of people. Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm005489.label: Intervention (International law)
tgm005489.scope: For governmental interference in the political affairs of another country.

tgm005501.label: Investigation
tgm005501.scope: An official inquiry or systematic examination.

tgm005508.label: Invitations
tgm005508.scope: Requests to be present or to participate.

tgm005540.label: Isometric projections
tgm005540.scope: Axonometric projections in which all three faces of a three-dimensional subject are drawn at equally oblique angles to the picture plane. Horizontal projectors are drawn at an angle of 30 degrees, and their dimensions as well as those of the vertical axes are drawn to true scale. Plan and elevations are given equal prominence.

tgm005558.label: Jangadas
tgm005558.scope: A catamaran-like sailing raft made of balsa logs, used off the coast of northeast Brazil.

tgm005562.label: Japanese gardens
tgm005562.scope: For gardens in Japanese style outside of Japan.

tgm005607.label: Joinery
tgm005607.scope: For construction of articles by joining pieces of wood and for the results of that activity.

tgm005622.label: Judicial proceedings
tgm005622.scope: Search also under the subdivision --TRIALS, LITIGATION, ETC. used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm005651.label: Juvenilia
tgm005651.scope: Works produced by artists in their childhood or youth. See CHILDREN'S ART for works produced by children in general.

tgm005654.label: Kallitypes
tgm005654.scope: Introduced in 1899; commonly brown, sepia, or black; on paper or cloth.

tgm005662.label: Kazoos
tgm005662.scope: Includes the activity of playing kazoos.

tgm005664.label: Keepsakes
tgm005664.scope: Two-dimensional works produced to mark the occasion of a gathering or event; given or sold to those in attendance and not usually otherwise available.

tgm005671.label: Keyboard instruments
tgm005671.scope: Includes the activity of playing keyboard instruments.

tgm005677.label: Keys (Legends)
tgm005677.scope: Texts or diagrams that identify specific features or people in a picture; may be on a separate sheet from the picture; commonly on or accompanying prints.

tgm005678.label: Keystones
tgm005678.scope: The wedge-shaped piece at the crown of an arch, especially such a piece inserted last and locking the other pieces in place.

tgm005691.label: Kiosks
tgm005691.scope: For small light structures with one or more open sides, especially as a newsstand or telephone booth. Also for free-standing columns on which announcements of concerts, plays, etc., are glued.

tgm005705.label: Kivas
tgm005705.scope: Pueblo ceremonial structure that is usually round and partly underground.

tgm005708.label: Knighting
tgm005708.scope: For images in which knighthood is conferred.

tgm005718.label: Kodak card photographs
tgm005718.scope: Card photographs made from a Kodak no. 1 or no. 2 camera; mounts measure approximately 4.25 x 5.25 in. (11 x 13 cm.). Produced 1888-1890s; images are circular; mounts marked Kodak.

tgm005720.label: Koran stands
tgm005720.scope: Stands usually made of wood or stone for holding the Koran in a mosque.

tgm005723.label: Kremlins
tgm005723.scope: The citadel of a Russian city.

tgm005726.label: Labels
tgm005726.scope: Slips of paper, cloth, or other material affixed, or meant to be attached to something for identification, description, or decoration.

tgm005732.label: Labor leaders
tgm005732.scope: For labor union officials and other individuals involved in organizing labor unions or promoting the interests of the working class.

tgm005740.label: Laborers
tgm005740.scope: Includes persons who engage in general or unspecified physical labor.

tgm005743.label: Labrets
tgm005743.scope: Decorative items such as plugs, discs or hooks, worn inserted into a hole in or near the lip.

tgm005760.label: Laminated wood
tgm005760.scope: Board built up of plies which are joined together by glue.

tgm005763.label: Lampposts
tgm005763.scope: Posts usually supporting outdoor lamps or lanterns.

tgm005765.label: Lancers
tgm005765.scope: For persons who fight with a spear or spear-like weapon, often while mounted on horseback. Includes activities.

tgm005775.label: Land subdivision
tgm005775.scope: Includes process of dividing tracts of land into lots for purposes of sale as well as the resulting lots.

tgm005777.label: Land tenure
tgm005777.scope: Rights or terms relating to ownership or occupation of land.

tgm005781.label: Landing craft
tgm005781.scope: Search also under the subdivision --AMPHIBIOUS OPERATIONS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm005788.label: Landscape architecture drawings
tgm005788.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and construction (or documentation of design and construction) of landscapes, parks, gardens, estate grounds, planting beds, outdoor fountains, and other planned elements of scenery or building sites. Includes any drawings produced by landscape architects or firms in the course of their business.

tgm005797.label: Landscapes (Representations)
tgm005797.scope: General or broad views of natural scenery, including inland bodies of water; may also include figures or man-made objects, but these are of secondary importance to the composition. Usually made from an elevated or distant vantage point, such as a view from a hill; not ground level close-up view of, for example, a tree.

tgm005798.label: Landscaping plans
tgm005798.scope: Design drawings that are plans showing the boundaries, outlines, dimensions, contours, positions, and other characteristics of a defined area and its structures, remaining natural vegetation, and plantings.

tgm005799.label: Landslides
tgm005799.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm005803.label: Lantern slides
tgm005803.scope: Hand-drawn, painted, or photographic images on glass, intended for viewing by projection; often made in sets. Photographic lantern slides were introduced in the United States by 1850 and popular through World War I; commonly 3.25 x 4 in. (9 x 10 cm.) with a black paper mask, a cover glass, and taped edges.

tgm005804.label: Lanterns
tgm005804.scope: For portable lighting that consists of a protective enclosure with transparent openings and often supporting frames or carrying handles.

tgm005805.label: Lanterns (Architecture)
tgm005805.scope: Windowed superstructures crowning a roof or dome, often serving to give light or air to the space below.

tgm005807.label: Lapidary work
tgm005807.scope: Cutting, carving, or polishing precious stones.

tgm005822.label: Laths
tgm005822.scope: Narrow, thin strips of wood or metal, used in making a supporting structure for plaster, shingles, slates, or tiles.

tgm005831.label: Laundries (Rooms & spaces)
tgm005831.scope: For non-commercial structures and spaces. Search under CLEANING ESTABLISHMENTS for commercial activities and structures.

tgm005832.label: Laundry
tgm005832.scope: For domestic and non-commercial activities, e.g., washing and ironing. Includes laundry work in institutions such as hospitals. Search under CLEANING ESTABLISHMENTS for activities in commercial laundries.

tgm005839.label: Law enforcement
tgm005839.scope: Includes law enforcement at the international level. Search also under the subdivision --CAPTURE & IMPRISONMENT used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and classes of persons (Appendix A) and with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm005845.label: Law & legal affairs
tgm005845.scope: Search also under the subdivision --TRIALS, LITIGATION, ETC., used with names of persons (Appendix B) and corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm005863.label: Leaflets
tgm005863.scope: Single printed sheets of paper that are folded and unbound, usually for free distribution.

tgm005865.label: Lean-tos
tgm005865.scope: Shack or shed with a single pitched roof with higher end abutting a wall or larger building.

tgm005875.label: Leather photographs
tgm005875.scope: Photographs on leather, such as collodion positives on japanned leather or carbon transfers on white or light-colored leather.

tgm005882.label: Lecture halls
tgm005882.scope: Large rooms with fixed seating for lectures.

tgm005913.label: Lenticular photographs
tgm005913.scope: Photographs formed and viewed through lenticular screens (transparent sheets, usually plastic, embossed with a pattern of tiny lens segments). Applications include additive color processes (introduced 1909) and stereoscopic systems in which an image appears to be three-dimensional.

tgm005918.label: Letter pictures
tgm005918.scope: Designs in which words or the letters of a word are arranged to form a picture or decorative pattern or figure.

tgm005920.label: Letterheads
tgm005920.scope: Printed headings on business or personal stationery; may include a name, address, or small illustration. Also, sheets of paper with such a heading.

tgm005921.label: Lettering (Layout features)
tgm005921.scope: Overall arrangement of type elements (e.g., typeface, type size) in graphic design.

tgm005922.label: Letterpress works
tgm005922.scope: Sheets or pages of text printed from metal, wood, or other material. May include woodcut or photomechanical line or halftone illustrations. Superseded for commercial use in the mid-1900s by offset photomechanical processes.

tgm005931.label: Levees
tgm005931.scope: Natural or manmade embankments flanking rivers or streams.

tgm005939.label: Liberty cap
tgm005939.scope: Soft, close-fitting, visorless cap, adopted by the French and American Revolutionists as a symbol of liberty.

tgm005941.label: Liberty ships
tgm005941.scope: Mass produced vessels built for the U.S. merchant marine during World War II to carry general cargo and military supplies and having a capacity of about 11,000 dead weight tons.

tgm005961.label: Lifesaving
tgm005961.scope: For activities involved in saving or protecting lives, especially those of drowning persons and shipwrecked persons.

tgm005974.label: Light courts
tgm005974.scope: Courts or recesses which provide light or ventilation to windows along walls.

tgm005988.label: Lightships
tgm005988.scope: Ships moored in places dangerous to navigation and equipped with warning lights.

tgm005996.label: Limited editions
tgm005996.scope: Prints, photographs, and other works produced in a stated number of copies after which no more are made. Usually numbered consecutively, e.g., 5/100 (the fifth print in an edition of 100).

tgm006000.label: Line photoengravings
tgm006000.scope: Prints produced from photographically prepared relief plates of engravings, drawings, and other works that consist of just two tones: the background and the image. The image may be composed of solid dark areas as well as lines, but it lacks tonal gradations. No screen markings.

tgm006002.label: Linemen
tgm006002.scope: Person who sets up or repairs electric, telephone, or telegraph lines.

tgm006010.label: Linocuts
tgm006010.scope: Prints made from linoleum blocks. Can be difficult to distinguish from cellocuts.

tgm006013.label: Lintels
tgm006013.scope: Horizontal architectural members spanning and usually carrying the load above an opening.

tgm006030.label: Lithotints
tgm006030.scope: Lithographs made to look like wash drawings by diluting tusche (ink) with turpentine while creating the image on the stone or plate. Introduced in the 1840s. Do not confuse with lithographs that have a background tint produced from a second stone.

tgm006033.label: Litters
tgm006033.scope: Stretchers, usually of canvas stretched on a frame, for carrying disabled or dead persons. Also, a covered or curtained couch with shafts used for carrying passengers.

tgm006036.label: Livestock
tgm006036.scope: Farm animals raised for use and profit.

tgm006045.label: Lobbies
tgm006045.scope: For large halls serving as foyers or anterooms in public buildings.

tgm006046.label: Lobby cards
tgm006046.scope: Motion picture advertisements intended for display in a theater lobby or showcase window. Often small versions of movie posters. The standard size established by the Motion Pictures Patent Company in 1909 is 11 x 14 inches.

tgm006058.label: Locomotion
tgm006058.scope: For the subject of locomotion in general.

tgm006063.label: Lodges
tgm006063.scope: Small houses in parks, forests, or domains; temporary habitations.

tgm006067.label: Lodging houses
tgm006067.scope: Houses in which sleeping accommodations are provided.

tgm006075.label: Loggias
tgm006075.scope: For roofed galleries open on one or more sides, sometimes pillared, especially at an upper story overlooking an open court; may also be separate structures, usually in a garden.

tgm006080.label: Logs
tgm006080.scope: For images that focus on bulky and long segments of tree trunks. Search under FUELWOOD for pieces of smaller trunks and branches to be used for fires. Search under WOODCUTTING for activities.

tgm006088.label: Loofahs
tgm006088.scope: Tropical squash that may be eaten or dried to use as a sponge.

tgm006092.label: Looms
tgm006092.scope: Frames or machines for interlacing at right angles two or more sets of threads or yarns to form a cloth.

tgm006101.label: Lost persons
tgm006101.scope: For people who have lost their way.

tgm006104.label: Lottery tickets
tgm006104.scope: Slips of paper, cardboard, or other material that represent chances for winning a prize in a lottery.

tgm006127.label: Luminescent works
tgm006127.scope: Works that glow in the dark, including those that glow only when activated by ultraviolet light.

tgm006135.label: Lunettes
tgm006135.scope: Surfaces at the upper part of a wall partly surrounded by a vault which the wall intersects, often filled by a window, by several windows, or by mural painting.

tgm006137.label: Lutes
tgm006137.scope: Includes the activity of playing lutes.

tgm006138.label: Lutheran churches
tgm006138.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm006141.label: Lying in state
tgm006141.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DEATH & BURIAL used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm006144.label: Lynchings
tgm006144.scope: Killings by mob action without legal sanction.

tgm006147.label: Lyres
tgm006147.scope: Includes the activity of playing lyres.

tgm006155.label: Machinery industry
tgm006155.scope: Manufacture and trade of machinery. Includes activities and structures.

tgm006158.label: Machismo
tgm006158.scope: A strong sense of masculine pride; an exaggerated awareness and assertion of masculinity.

tgm006159.label: Macrophotographs
tgm006159.scope: Unusually large photographs; objects shown are life-size or larger.

tgm006161.label: Madonnas
tgm006161.scope: An artistic depiction (as a painting or statue), usually of a mother and child, often of the Virgin Mary and Jesus.

tgm006164.label: Magazine covers
tgm006164.scope: Illustrations and original designs for the covers of periodicals.

tgm006170.label: Magazines (Military buildings)
tgm006170.scope: For buildings in which ammunition and explosives are kept at military installations.

tgm006172.label: Magic
tgm006172.scope: Use of spells, charms, etc., believed to have supernatural power to produce or prevent a particular result considered unobtainable by natural means, as well as the type of entertainment in which a performer does tricks or so-called magic or conjuring.

tgm006199.label: Mail wagons
tgm006199.scope: Horse-drawn vehicles used to carry mail.

tgm006213.label: Male figure drawings
tgm006213.scope: Drawings of the human male body, other than portraits.

tgm006225.label: Mammoth plates
tgm006225.scope: Large photographs taken during the second half of the 1800s; various sizes, including 18 x 22 in. and 20 x 24 in. Includes both the wet collodion negatives and the prints made from them.

tgm006229.label: Mandolins
tgm006229.scope: Includes the activity of playing mandolins.

tgm006241.label: Manners & customs
tgm006241.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), with names of persons (Appendix B), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006243.label: Mansard roofs
tgm006243.scope: Roof having two slopes on all sides with the lower slope steeper than the upper one.

tgm006245.label: Mansions
tgm006245.scope: Large, imposing, expensive, and often elegant, houses.

tgm006248.label: Mantels
tgm006248.scope: Beams, stones, or arches serving as lintels to support the masonry above fireplaces.

tgm006251.label: Manufacturers' catalogs
tgm006251.scope: Catalogs issued by the manufacturer of the products being sold. When made available to both general public and the trade, wholesale prices may be coded or in a separate list.

tgm006261.label: Maps
tgm006261.scope: Graphic delineations at a set scale, of all or part of the earth or another celestial sphere indicating the relative position of selected artificial and natural features.

tgm006262.label: Maquettes
tgm006262.scope: Preliminary three dimensional studies for sculpture.

tgm006285.label: Marine hospitals
tgm006285.scope: Hospitals built for the care of merchant seamen.

tgm006290.label: Marine terminals
tgm006290.scope: Includes both freight and passenger terminals.

tgm006294.label: Marines (Visual works)
tgm006294.scope: Works depicting scenes having to do with ships, shipbuilding, or harbors. For works depicting the ocean or other large body of water where the water itself dominates the scene, use SEASCAPES.

tgm006299.label: Marker works
tgm006299.scope: Drawings and other works made by either water-based or petroleum-based ink from a felt, nylon, or ceramic tip pen.

tgm006305.label: Markets
tgm006305.scope: Includes both indoor and outdoor markets where many buyers and sellers are brought into contact.

tgm006308.label: Marks (Symbols)
tgm006308.scope: Marks in, on, or applied to works; not usually considered part of the visual imagery; often an aid to dating or establishing provenance.

tgm006313.label: Marquees
tgm006313.scope: Permanent canopy, usually of metal and glass projecting over the entrance to a building; on theaters it may display the name of current feature.

tgm006315.label: Marriage
tgm006315.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MARRIAGE used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm006321.label: Martial arts
tgm006321.scope: Group of diverse activities that have evolved from ancient fighting skills developed in Asian countries.

tgm006326.label: Mascots
tgm006326.scope: Persons, animals, or objects adopted by a group as a symbolic figure, especially to bring them good luck.

tgm006327.label: Masks
tgm006327.scope: Search also under the subdivision --DEATH MASK used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm006331.label: Masonry
tgm006331.scope: Construction activity with materials such as stone, brick, concrete block, and tile.

tgm006343.label: Matchcovers
tgm006343.scope: Covers to contain packs of matches; usually paper. Introduced in 1892. Matches may or may not be present.

tgm006345.label: Materials
tgm006345.scope: Natural and synthetic physical substances of which something can be made.

tgm006351.label: Mathematics
tgm006351.scope: For the subject of mathematics in general and the activities of mathematicians.

tgm006358.label: Mayors
tgm006358.scope: For the subject of the office in general and for incumbents.

tgm006360.label: McCarthyism
tgm006360.scope: A mid-20th century political attitude characterized chiefly by opposition to elements held to be subversive and by the use of tactics involving personal attacks on individuals by means of widely publicized indiscriminate allegations.

tgm006365.label: Measured drawings
tgm006365.scope: Drawings of an existing site or structure made to scale and dimensioned from site notes, measurements, or photogrammetric analysis. Often comprise a set of plans, elevations, sections, and details. Examples include the work of the Historic American Buildings Survey.

tgm006375.label: Mechanical drawings
tgm006375.scope: Drawings prepared with mechanical devices, such as compasses, ruling pens, and other drafting tools, according to strict scales, conventions, proportions, and projection methods.

tgm006379.label: Mechanical systems drawings
tgm006379.scope: Graphic delineations for design, layout, installation, and operation and maintenance of the mechanical systems in a structure. They include plumbing (water supply and sanitary waste) heating, cooling, and transport (elevator, escalator, dumb waiter) systems.

tgm006381.label: Mechanical works
tgm006381.scope: Works with moving parts, such as pop-out or sliding sections, turning wheels, or flaps that unfold to reveal new aspects of a picture. Also, works that require an action, such as turning them, to reveal the whole image or another image.

tgm006385.label: Medallions (Ornament areas)
tgm006385.scope: An ornamental plaque (usually oval or square) on which is represented an object in relief, such as a figure, head, flower, etc. applied to a wall frieze, or other architectural member.

tgm006386.label: Medals
tgm006386.scope: Pieces of metal often resembling coins and having a stamped design that is issued to commemorate a person or event or awarded for excellence or achievement.

tgm006389.label: Medical aspects of war
tgm006389.scope: For relief and medical care of casualties. Search under WAR CASUALTIES for images that focus on dead and wounded persons. Search also under the subdivision --MEDICAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006395.label: Medical equipment & supplies
tgm006395.scope: Search also under the subdivision --EQUIPMENT & SUPPLIES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006396.label: Medical illustrations
tgm006396.scope: Illustrations made to document medical conditions or procedures; primarily used as instructional aids in the identification and treatment of disease.

tgm006402.label: Medical screening
tgm006402.scope: Mass examination of the population to determine the existence of a specific disease such as tuberculosis.

tgm006408.label: Medicine shows
tgm006408.scope: Travelling shows using entertainers to attract crowds among which remedies and secret nostrums are sold.

tgm006410.label: Meditation
tgm006410.scope: For the act or process of meditating.

tgm006417.label: Meetings
tgm006417.scope: For planned gatherings. Search also under the subdivision --MEETINGS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm006419.label: Megalethoscope prints
tgm006419.scope: Photographic prints on thin paper specially mounted on a curved frame for viewing in a megalethoscope, a large device with a magnifying lens designed for daylight or artificial light use. Introduced in the 1860s; often used for parlor entertainment; usually 12 in. (30 cm.) wide.

tgm006423.label: Melodramas
tgm006423.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) which feature passive protagonists who are victimized by situations related to society, family, or sexuality, frequently characterized by extreme emotion.

tgm006425.label: Membership campaigns
tgm006425.scope: Search also under the subdivision --RECRUITING & ENLISTMENT used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm006429.label: Memorabilia
tgm006429.scope: Collected objects of historical or personal interest. Examples include political campaign pencils and souvenir paperweights.

tgm006432.label: Memorial photographs
tgm006432.scope: Photographs that commemorate a deceased person or pet who is represented in the photograph while still alive. Photographs may be accompanied by vital statistics or verse, and may be framed by a black border; sometimes mounted on tombstones. Includes the rare cases of morteotypes, which are daguerreotypes attached to gravestones.

tgm006433.label: Memorial rites & ceremonies
tgm006433.scope: For rites and ceremonies in memory of individuals or groups, without the presence of the deceased. Search under FUNERAL RITES & CEREMONIES for rites and ceremonies in the presence of the deceased. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A); with names of persons (Appendix B); and with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006435.label: Memorial works
tgm006435.scope: Prints, cards, black-edged stationery, and other items produced in memory of a deceased person. Prints marking the anniversary of the death of a public figure are included.

tgm006438.label: Men
tgm006438.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --MEN used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups (Appendix A).

tgm006441.label: Mennonite churches
tgm006441.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm006454.label: Mentally ill persons
tgm006454.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MENTAL HEALTH used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm006456.label: Menus
tgm006456.scope: Lists of the dishes that may be ordered in an eating establishment or that are to be served at a banquet or other occasion.

tgm006460.label: Merchandise displays
tgm006460.scope: Search also under the subdivisions --EXHIBITIONS & DISPLAYS and --PRODUCTS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm006464.label: Merchants
tgm006464.scope: For-profit commodity traders or retail business operators.

tgm006471.label: Meshrebeeyehs
tgm006471.scope: In Islamic architecture, windows screened by wood lattices to conceal the interior.

tgm006473.label: Messengers
tgm006473.scope: Double index as appropriate with vehicle used.

tgm006475.label: Metal cuts
tgm006475.scope: Prints printed in relief from metal plates usually attached to wood blocks; chiefly ca. 1450-1500.

tgm006480.label: Metalwork
tgm006480.scope: Search under METALWORKING for the activity of metalworking.

tgm006481.label: Metalworking
tgm006481.scope: Process of shaping things out of metal.

tgm006482.label: Metamorphic pictures
tgm006482.scope: Pictures that can be transformed into one or more other pictures by turning, folding, or sliding a section. Also, pictures with interchangeable parts, such as sets of heads, torsos, and legs, which can be combined to make different figures.

tgm006485.label: Meteorology
tgm006485.scope: A science that deals with the atmosphere and its phenomena, and especially with the weather.

tgm006486.label: Methodist churches
tgm006486.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm006487.label: Methodist Episcopal churches
tgm006487.scope: For images that focus on buildings as well as associated grounds.

tgm006493.label: Mezzanines
tgm006493.scope: Low-ceilinged stories between the two main stories of a building, especially intermediate or fractional stories that project in the form of a balcony over the ground story.

tgm006503.label: Microopaques
tgm006503.scope: Microform images on opaque, white cards.

tgm006505.label: Microphotographs
tgm006505.scope: Photographs of objects shown at greatly reduced size; require magnifying glass or other magnification device to view.

tgm006515.label: Midways
tgm006515.scope: A central avenue at a fair or exposition, for exhibition of curiosities, fantastic amusements, concessions, etc.

tgm006518.label: Migrant laborers
tgm006518.scope: For laborers who regularly migrate within the same country for work. Search under FOREIGN LABORERS for those who seek work outside their own country.

tgm006521.label: Mihrabs
tgm006521.scope: Niches, chambers, or slabs in mosques, indicating the direction of Mecca.

tgm006522.label: Milestones
tgm006522.scope: For stones that serve as mileposts. Search under FIRSTS for figurative milestones.

tgm006524.label: Militarism
tgm006524.scope: Subordination of the civil ideals or policies of a government to the military; policy of aggressive military preparedness.

tgm006525.label: Military academies
tgm006525.scope: Schools that train people for careers in the military and private schools that specialize in military discipline.

tgm006529.label: Military art & science
tgm006529.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY TACTICS used with names of wars (Appendix C). Search also under other terms beginning with MILITARY.

tgm006533.label: Military camps
tgm006533.scope: For images that focus on sites and facilities. Search under MILITARY LIFE for activities.

tgm006538.label: Military decorations
tgm006538.scope: Includes the ceremonies during which military decorations are given.

tgm006539.label: Military demobilizations
tgm006539.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY DEMOBILIZATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006540.label: Military depots
tgm006540.scope: Places for the storage of military supplies and the reception and forwarding of military replacements.

tgm006543.label: Military education
tgm006543.scope: Use for activities (classroom and teaching situations). Search under MILITARY TRAINING for physical activities.

tgm006546.label: Military facilities
tgm006546.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY FACILITIES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006555.label: Military life
tgm006555.scope: Includes all aspects of military life, e.g., training, reviews, camp life, etc. Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY LIFE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006557.label: Military medicine
tgm006557.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MEDICAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006558.label: Military mobilizations
tgm006558.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY MOBILIZATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006559.label: Military occupations
tgm006559.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY OCCUPATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006562.label: Military parades & ceremonies
tgm006562.scope: Parades, rites, and ceremonies for, by, and of the military.

tgm006563.label: Military personnel
tgm006563.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY SERVICE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with names of persons (Appendix B). Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY PERSONNEL used with names of wars (Appendix C) and the subdivision --PEOPLE used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm006565.label: Military policy
tgm006565.scope: For military, naval, and general defense policy.

tgm006570.label: Military retreats
tgm006570.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY RETREATS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006574.label: Military service
tgm006574.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MILITARY SERVICE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm006581.label: Military training
tgm006581.scope: For physical activities. Search under MILITARY EDUCATION for classroom and teaching situations.

tgm006583.label: Military vehicles
tgm006583.scope: Search also under AIRCRAFT or VESSELS and their NTs for specific types of vehicles used in a military context.

tgm006586.label: Militias
tgm006586.scope: Part of the organized armed forces of a nation, usually called up only in an emergency.

tgm006591.label: Milking
tgm006591.scope: For the milking of cows and other animals away from the context of dairy farming. Search under DAIRY FARMING for the milking of dairy cattle.

tgm006602.label: Millraces
tgm006602.scope: Canals in which water flows to and from mill wheels.

tgm006603.label: Mills
tgm006603.scope: A facility devoted to processing of materials, e.g. grain to flour, trees to lumber.

tgm006604.label: Millwork
tgm006604.scope: Woodwork (e.g., doors, sashes, trim) that has been machined at a planing mill.

tgm006609.label: Minbars
tgm006609.scope: Wood or stone pulpits in a mosque usually consisting of steps, a platform and a canopy.

tgm006632.label: Miniature railroads
tgm006632.scope: Small trains on which people can ride.

tgm006634.label: Miniature works
tgm006634.scope: Graphic materials that are very small in comparison to the usual size of their genre or physical type.

tgm006636.label: Miniatures (Illuminations)
tgm006636.scope: Pictures in an illuminated manuscript; distinct from the initials and borders.

tgm006637.label: Miniatures (Paintings)
tgm006637.scope: Paintings on a very small scale (usually five inches or less), especially the portraits on vellum or ivory popular in England and America from the Renaissance into the 1800s. For miniatures in manuscripts, search under MINIATURES (ILLUMINATIONS).

tgm006639.label: Mining
tgm006639.scope: Includes activities and sites where mining is taking place. Search also under the subdivision --INDUSTRIES used with names of indigenous peoples (Appendix A).

tgm006647.label: Minorities
tgm006647.scope: For the subject of the condition, protection, rights, etc., of racial, religious, and other minorities.

tgm006650.label: Minstrel shows
tgm006650.scope: Performances of melodies, jokes, and impersonations focused on black people, often by whites wearing blackface.

tgm006666.label: Missing persons
tgm006666.scope: For people who are absent without explanation.

tgm006673.label: Miters
tgm006673.scope: Term applied to several types of tall pieces of headgear such as headbands worn by women of ancient Greece, the turbanlike official headdresses of ancient Jewish high priests, or the liturgical headdresses worn by bishops and abbots.

tgm006675.label: Mixed media works
tgm006675.scope: Works combining techniques and materials from two or more graphic or fine art processes no one of which clearly predominates. Examples include prints with large amounts of drawing, and photographs with heavy over-painting.

tgm006679.label: Mizriha'ot
tgm006679.scope: Pictures hung on the house or synagogue wall in the direction of Jersualem toward which Jews face while praying.

tgm006680.label: Moats
tgm006680.scope: Deep, wide trenches usually filled with water, found around the ramparts of fortified places such as castles.

tgm006689.label: Mock-ups
tgm006689.scope: A structural model built to scale and usually full-sized for the purpose of study, testing, or display.

tgm006692.label: Model houses
tgm006692.scope: Full-scale representations of houses planned to be constructed. Search under ARCHITECTURAL MODELS for miniature representations of structures made for the purpose of showing the result of architectural construction plans.

tgm006693.label: Model railroads
tgm006693.scope: Search under MINIATURE RAILROADS for small trains that people can ride.

tgm006705.label: Modular construction
tgm006705.scope: Construction based on regular large units, usually fabricated elsewhere and assembled at the building site.

tgm006710.label: Molds (Shaping tools)
tgm006710.scope: Hollow forms in which castings or pressings are made.

tgm006714.label: Molotov cocktails
tgm006714.scope: Crude hand grenades made of a bottle filled with flammable liquid.

tgm006717.label: Monarchy
tgm006717.scope: For the subject of monarchy in general. Search under RULERS for images that focus on real persons.

tgm006725.label: Money
tgm006725.scope: Paper money designed to circulate as medium of exchange. Examples include national and colonial government notes; bank notes; and merchant, military, and local government scrip.

tgm006734.label: Monochrome works
tgm006734.scope: Graphic delineations which are purely white, or light and dark values of a single color.

tgm006736.label: Monograms
tgm006736.scope: Characters or ciphers usually composed of two or more combined or interwoven letters; usually represent a name or part of a name.

tgm006737.label: Monoplanes
tgm006737.scope: Airplane with only one main supporting surface.

tgm006742.label: Monotypes
tgm006742.scope: Prints made by painting an image on glass, metal, or other sheet, or by applying ink and wiping parts away, then transferring the image to paper. Usually no more than one or two impressions are made.

tgm006743.label: Monsters
tgm006743.scope: For imaginary persons or animals of frightening size or appearance. Search under HUMAN CURIOSITIES for real persons being represented as freaks.

tgm006744.label: Monstrances
tgm006744.scope: Religious vessels holding consecrated Host or sacred relic.

tgm006745.label: Montages
tgm006745.scope: Compositions made by juxtaposing or superimposing multiple pictures to create a single image. May be produced by pasting together whole or partial pictures or by recopying multiple images through photography or scanning. Includes photomontages in both the commercial graphic arts and fine art contexts.

tgm006749.label: Monuments & memorials
tgm006749.scope: Structures erected to commemorate persons, events, or causes. Search also under the subdivision --COMMEMORATION used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search also under the subdivision --MONUMENTS used with names of persons (Appendix B) and with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006752.label: Moonlight
tgm006752.scope: For geographic location on which moonlight falls.

tgm006755.label: Mooring
tgm006755.scope: Making fast vessels or aircraft by means of chains, lines, anchors, or other devices.

tgm006756.label: Mooring masts
tgm006756.scope: A mast to which an airship is secured when not in use.

tgm006760.label: Moral aspects of war
tgm006760.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MORAL & ETHICAL ASPECTS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006764.label: Moravian churches
tgm006764.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm006766.label: Mormon churches
tgm006766.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm006769.label: Mortars (Ordnance)
tgm006769.scope: Cannons with a tube short in relation to their caliber, used to throw projectiles with low muzzle velocities at high angles. Also, any of various contrivances for throwing pyrotechnic bombs.

tgm006778.label: Mosques
tgm006778.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm006781.label: Motels
tgm006781.scope: Establishments which provide lodging and parking and in which the rooms are usually accessible from an outdoor parking area.

tgm006791.label: Motion picture devices
tgm006791.scope: Devices for making or viewing motion pictures.

tgm006806.label: Motion study photographs
tgm006806.scope: Photographs, either single images or sets, made to record successive phases of a motion. For example, exposures made by separate cameras set up along the path of a moving subject; successive exposures by one camera that result in separate images; exposures that result in a single image through intermittent illumination of the subject.

tgm006830.label: Mountain railroads
tgm006830.scope: Railroads employing devices, such as cables, central rails, racks and pinions, to hold the cars on a steep mountain track.

tgm006838.label: Mourning clothing & dress
tgm006838.scope: Includes arm bands and mourning bands on police badges or uniforms.

tgm006843.label: Mouth organs
tgm006843.scope: Includes the activity of playing mouth organs.

tgm006846.label: Movable feasts
tgm006846.scope: An annual observance or religious feast that does not occur on the same day each year.

tgm006867.label: Muckraking
tgm006867.scope: Searching for and either charging or exposing (in newspapers, etc.) corruption by public officials, businessmen, etc.

tgm006881.label: Mullahs
tgm006881.scope: A Muslim of a quasi-clerical class trained in traditional law and doctrine; a religious teacher.

tgm006891.label: Multiscreen presentations
tgm006891.scope: For productions which include moving or still images projected simultaneously on more than two screens.

tgm006899.label: Murals
tgm006899.scope: Paintings that dominate a wall or ceiling surface.

tgm006906.label: Music
tgm006906.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MUSIC used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --SONGS & MUSIC used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm006911.label: Music halls
tgm006911.scope: Auditoriums for musical, variety, or theatrical productions.

tgm006925.label: Musical instruments
tgm006925.scope: Includes the activity of playing instruments. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm006929.label: Musicians
tgm006929.scope: Includes portraits of musicians with instruments.

tgm006935.label: Musketeers
tgm006935.scope: A soldier armed with a musket.

tgm006948.label: Myths
tgm006948.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SPIRITUAL LIFE used with ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm006952.label: Names
tgm006952.scope: For the subject of people's names.

tgm006971.label: National liberation movements
tgm006971.scope: For minority or other groups in armed rebellion against a colonial government, or against a national government charged with corruption or foreign domination. In general, this heading is applicable only to the post-World War II period.

tgm006973.label: National security
tgm006973.scope: Policies and preparations for securing a country against foreign aggression and for protecting sensitive information about national affairs.

tgm006974.label: National socialism
tgm006974.scope: For the subject of national socialism in general. Search under NAZIS for images that focus on real persons.

tgm006978.label: Nationalism
tgm006978.scope: Sense of national consciousness exalting one nation above all others and placing primary emphasis on promotion of its culture and interests as opposed to those of other nations or supernational groups.

tgm006990.label: Nature
tgm006990.scope: For the subject of nature in general.

tgm006993.label: Naval architecture drawings
tgm006993.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and construction (or documentation of design and construction) of ships, boats, and similar vessels.

tgm007002.label: Naval parades & ceremonies
tgm007002.scope: For civilian or military parades on water. Search under MILITARY PARADES & CEREMONIES for land parades sponsored by the navy.

tgm007003.label: Naval prints
tgm007003.scope: Prints that show the actions of a navy or its personnel, including naval battles, expeditions, and portraits.

tgm007007.label: Naval stores
tgm007007.scope: Resin-based products used historically in the manufacture of ships.

tgm007008.label: Naval warfare
tgm007008.scope: Search also under the subdivision --NAVAL OPERATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm007014.label: Nazis
tgm007014.scope: For images that focus on real persons. Search under NATIONAL SOCIALISM for the subject of national socialism in general.

tgm007028.label: Negative prints
tgm007028.scope: Photographic prints in which tones or colors are the opposite of their normal values.

tgm007029.label: Negatives
tgm007029.scope: Photographs in which the tonal values are the opposite of those in the subject to which the negative was exposed. Their purpose is to be a matrix for obtaining multiple positive images of the subject.

tgm007073.label: Niello printing plates
tgm007073.scope: Decorative metal plaques with incised lines that have been filled with niello and hence could also be used for printing. Predecessor of copperplate engraving; chiefly Italian, 1400s-1500s.

tgm007076.label: Night photographs
tgm007076.scope: Photographs taken at night; the primary subject may or may not be night; may involve special production techniques. Does not include daytime or indoor available-light photographs where the effect of darkness is due to limited lighting.

tgm007082.label: Nightclubs
tgm007082.scope: A place of entertainment open at night, usually serving food and liquor, having a floorshow, and providing music and space for dancing.

tgm007089.label: Nitrate negatives
tgm007089.scope: Negatives with a nitrocellulose film base. Manufactured from 1887 to 1950.

tgm007097.label: Nomads
tgm007097.scope: People who have no fixed residence but move from place to place usually seasonally and within a well-defined territory.

tgm007111.label: Nose art
tgm007111.scope: Painting or design near the nose of a military aircraft.

tgm007117.label: Novelty works
tgm007117.scope: Works made with materials uncommon for their format; with unusual attachments, such as feathers or buttons; with unusual shapes; or with other uncommon features. Examples include leather postcards, greeting cards with tinsel, postcards that squeak, and perfumed advertisements.

tgm007142.label: Nursery schools
tgm007142.scope: Schooling and activities prior to kindergarten education.

tgm007146.label: Nursing homes
tgm007146.scope: Privately operated establishments where maintenance and personal or nursing care are provided for persons (as the aged or chronically ill) who are unable to care for themselves. Includes activities and structures.

tgm007155.label: Oaths
tgm007155.scope: For judicial or official oaths, including ceremonies. Search under SWEARING for profane language.

tgm007172.label: Occupations
tgm007172.scope: For the general subject of types of paid employment. Search under EMPLOYMENT for the general subject of working for pay and under NTs to PEOPLE for persons in various occupations. Search also under the subdivision --EMPLOYMENT used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm007180.label: Oceanography
tgm007180.scope: For the study of the ocean and its phenomena and the activities of oceanographers.

tgm007181.label: Oceans
tgm007181.scope: For the Atlantic, Pacific, Indian, Arctic, and Antarctic oceans.

tgm007205.label: Offset lithographs
tgm007205.scope: In original printmaking, lithographs printed by transferring an image from a printing plate or stone to an intermediate surface and then to paper or another type of sheet.

tgm007206.label: Offset photomechanical prints
tgm007206.scope: Usually a lithographic process and referred to as offset lithographs. Introduced in 1906; by the 1970s, a widely used method for publishing text and illustrations.

tgm007221.label: Older people
tgm007221.scope: This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm007223.label: Oleographs
tgm007223.scope: Chromolithographs printed on a textured surface using blocks inked with oil paint; often coated with varnish. Popular as inexpensive reproductions of oil paintings in the late-1800s.

tgm007238.label: Opaline photographs
tgm007238.scope: Photographic prints mounted under bevelled glass, made to resemble opalotypes.

tgm007240.label: Opalotypes
tgm007240.scope: Photographs on opal (opaque white) glass; popular in the 1880s to early 1900s. Made either by transferring a carbon print onto the glass or by exposing a light-sensitive emulsion on the opal glass to a negative.

tgm007265.label: Opposition (Political science)
tgm007265.scope: For organized political resistance to the government in power. Search under PROTEST MOVEMENTS for opposition regarding particular issues.

tgm007270.label: Optical toys
tgm007270.scope: Toys comprised of a series of still images printed on disks or strips that engage the visual senses by creating the illusion of motion when viewed through specialized viewing devices.

tgm007289.label: Ordnance industry
tgm007289.scope: Manufacture of military supplies including weapons, ammunition, combat vehicles, and maintenance tools and equipment. Includes activities and structures.

tgm007295.label: Organ lofts
tgm007295.scope: Galleries or lofts in which an organ is located, often found in churches.

tgm007297.label: Organizations
tgm007297.scope: A group of people organized for a common social, commercial, governmental, or other purpose. Search also under the subdivision --ORGANIZATIONS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm007302.label: Organs
tgm007302.scope: Includes the activity of playing organs.

tgm007312.label: Ornithological illustrations
tgm007312.scope: Illustrations that document birds and bird habitats.

tgm007313.label: Ornithopters
tgm007313.scope: Manned or unmanned heavier-than-air craft designed to be propelled through the air by flapping wings.

tgm007315.label: Orphanages
tgm007315.scope: An institution for the care of orphans.

tgm007317.label: Orthodox churches
tgm007317.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm007319.label: Orthoptics
tgm007319.scope: The study and treatment of defects in binocular vision involving eye exercises to correct visual axes.

tgm007359.label: Oxygen masks
tgm007359.scope: Masks covering the mouth and nose and used mainly for inhaling oxygen from a bottle, tank, or other source of supply.

tgm007366.label: Pacifism
tgm007366.scope: Opposition to violence as a means of settling disputes. Search under PROTEST MOVEMENTS for opposition to particular conflicts.

tgm007367.label: Pacifists
tgm007367.scope: Search under PACIFISM for the subject of pacifism in general and the activities of pacifists.

tgm007369.label: Pack animals
tgm007369.scope: Search under PACKTRAINS for strings of pack animals.

tgm007372.label: Packaging
tgm007372.scope: Materials for the packing or protective wrapping of objects; usually contain information about the objects.

tgm007378.label: Packtrains
tgm007378.scope: Strings of animals for transporting supplies and equipment.

tgm007381.label: Paddleboats
tgm007381.scope: A boat propelled by a paddle wheel.

tgm007386.label: Pagodas
tgm007386.scope: Tower-like storied structures, usually temples or memorials, common in India, China, Indochina, and Japan.

tgm007389.label: Pain
tgm007389.scope: Search under DISTRESS for mental pain.

tgm007391.label: Painting
tgm007391.scope: Includes painting both as a trade and an artistic endeavor.

tgm007393.label: Paintings
tgm007393.scope: Narrower terms include both physical media and genre categories.

tgm007401.label: Paleontology
tgm007401.scope: For the subject of paleontology in general and the activities of paleontologists.

tgm007405.label: Palladian windows
tgm007405.scope: Large windows characteristic of neoclassic styles, divided by columns or piers resembling pilasters, into three lights, the middle one of which is usually wider than the others, and is sometimes arched.

tgm007408.label: Palladium prints
tgm007408.scope: Photographic prints on paper sensitized with palladium salts. Introduced during World War I when platinum became prohibitively expensive; not commercially available after the 1920s.

tgm007413.label: Palms
tgm007413.scope: Includes palm trees, leaves, and branches.

tgm007415.label: Pamphlets
tgm007415.scope: Printed publications issued as separate works, not stitched or bound, often with a paper cover, usually of less than 80 pages, sometimes short treatises on arguments or current events.

tgm007423.label: Panel card photographs
tgm007423.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 13 x 7.5 in. (33 x 19 cm.). Variant sizes include 17 x 10.5 in. (43 x 27 cm.) and 23 x 14 in. (59 x 35 cm.).

tgm007425.label: Paneling
tgm007425.scope: Decorative coverings for interior walls or ceilings usually consisting of wood panels and often framing.

tgm007428.label: Panoramic photographs
tgm007428.scope: Photographs which are a continuous view of a wider section of the horizon than could normally be photographed in a single exposure; ratio of width to height is usually 2:1 or more. May be separate photographs either joined (or meant to be joined) together or one long piece made with a special camera.

tgm007429.label: Panoramic views
tgm007429.scope: Views that cover more area than usually can be seen in a single glance.

tgm007430.label: Panpipes
tgm007430.scope: Includes the activity of playing panpipes.

tgm007433.label: Pantins
tgm007433.scope: Paper dolls produced in France in the 1600s and 1700s; often jointed.

tgm007438.label: Pan-Americanism
tgm007438.scope: Solidarity, actual or potential, of the Americas.

tgm007446.label: Paper dolls
tgm007446.scope: Figures on paper or cardboard with several parts or different costumes; usually issued on one sheet or in a booklet and intended to be cut out.

tgm007453.label: Paper toys
tgm007453.scope: Sheets of paper, cardboard, or other material with preprinted outlines or designs that can be cut and folded to make toys. Toys already made are included.

tgm007465.label: Paradise
tgm007465.scope: The garden of Eden or any other earthly paradise, as distinguished from a heavenly paradise.

tgm007466.label: Parapets
tgm007466.scope: Low walls or similar barriers to protect the edge of a platform, roof, or bridge.

tgm007471.label: Paravanes
tgm007471.scope: Devices for severing moorings from underwater mines.

tgm007474.label: Parish houses
tgm007474.scope: Buildings belonging to churches that serve as residences of clergymen, as well as for business, social, or extension activities.

tgm007481.label: Parkways
tgm007481.scope: A broad landscaped thoroughfare intended for only passenger cars and noncommercial traffic.

tgm007486.label: Parlors
tgm007486.scope: For rooms in hotels, clubs, or the like, reserved for guests who desire a greater degree of privacy than the public rooms provide, and for rooms in private homes reserved for the entertainment of visitors.

tgm007505.label: Passengers
tgm007505.scope: For images that focus on travellers by some conveyance, e.g., boats, railroads, etc. Search under SIGHTSEERS or TOURISTS for passengers who are clearly sightseeing and under COMMUTERS for persons who travel regularly between one place and another.

tgm007509.label: Passion-plays
tgm007509.scope: A play representing the Passion or crucifixion of Christ.

tgm007515.label: Pastels (Visual works)
tgm007515.scope: "Drawings" or "paintings" made with colored sticks of chalk in a nongreasy binder, depositing a powdery color on a surface.

tgm007518.label: Patent drawings
tgm007518.scope: Design drawings that describe something in order to obtain patent protection; often mechanical drawings or diagrams.

tgm007523.label: Patios
tgm007523.scope: Courtyards, especially an inner court, open to the sky; usually adjoins a dwelling.

tgm007524.label: Patriarchs
tgm007524.scope: High-ranking prelates in certain Catholic churches, especially Orthodox and Coptic churches.

tgm007525.label: Patriotic envelopes
tgm007525.scope: Envelopes decorated with portraits of military leaders, camp scenes, cartoons, flags, and other designs. Often in one or more colors. They came into use during the American Civil War; a smaller number were used during the Spanish American War.

tgm007527.label: Patriotism
tgm007527.scope: Search also under subjects often associated with patriotic feeling, e.g., EAGLES, FLAGS, NATIONAL SONGS, etc.

tgm007531.label: Pattern books
tgm007531.scope: Books, pamphlets, or other volumes consisting of designs intended to be used as outlines from which to make something.

tgm007532.label: Pattern sheets
tgm007532.scope: Sheets drawn or printed with designs used as outlines or guides to make something. Examples include dress making, embroidery, and carpentry patterns.

tgm007537.label: Pavilions (Facilities)
tgm007537.scope: A detached or semidetached structure used for entertainment or for special activities.

tgm007538.label: Pavilions (Building divisions)
tgm007538.scope: On a facade, a prominent portion usually central or terminal, identified by projections, height, and special roof forms.

tgm007547.label: Peace
tgm007547.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PEACE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm007548.label: Peace conferences
tgm007548.scope: For meetings on the subject of peace in general. Search under PEACE NEGOTIATIONS for diplomatic negotiations during hostilities.

tgm007549.label: Peace negotiations
tgm007549.scope: For diplomatic negotiations during hostilities. Search under PEACE CONFERENCES for meetings on the subject of peace in general. Search also under the subdivision --PEACE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm007554.label: Peace treaties
tgm007554.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PEACE used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm007559.label: Peacocks
tgm007559.scope: Male peafowl distinguished by crest of upright plumules and by greatly elongated tail covers mostly tipped with ocellated spots.

tgm007578.label: Pedestrian malls
tgm007578.scope: Open public areas, walks, or plazas, reserved for pedestrian use.

tgm007581.label: Pedigree
tgm007581.scope: Distinguished ancestry of humans or animals.

tgm007582.label: Pediments
tgm007582.scope: In classical architecture, the triangular end or gable of a low-pitched roof, sometimes filled with sculpture.

tgm007584.label: Peepshows
tgm007584.scope: Box-like optical devices with mirrors and lenses, which give the illusion of depth and action when objects are viewed through an opening.

tgm007589.label: Pellicles
tgm007589.scope: Gelatin emulsion layer removed from a photographic negative for preservation purposes.

tgm007604.label: Penstocks
tgm007604.scope: Valve or gate that regulates flow of water through a sluice; or a pipe for conveying water to a power plant.

tgm007605.label: Penthouses
tgm007605.scope: Structures or dwellings built on roofs.

tgm007607.label: People
tgm007607.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PEOPLE used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm007609.label: People associated with commercial & service activities

tgm007611.label: People associated with arts, entertainment & sports

tgm007623.label: Percussion instruments
tgm007623.scope: Includes the activity of playing percussion instruments.

tgm007624.label: Perestroika
tgm007624.scope: The restructuring of Soviet society started by Mikhail Gorbachev.

tgm007626.label: Performance art
tgm007626.scope: An art form combining elements of theater, music, and the visual arts.

tgm007632.label: Performing arts posters
tgm007632.scope: Posters issued to advertise theatrical performances and other entertainments. Also, posters generally promoting performers, without reference to specific events.

tgm007639.label: Periodical illustrations
tgm007639.scope: Detached illustrations are included as well as original drawings, photographs, and prints intended for publication or actually published as illustrations in periodicals.

tgm007641.label: Periodicals
tgm007641.scope: Serials usually issued at regular intervals and more frequently than annually.

tgm007643.label: Peristyles
tgm007643.scope: Uninterrupted rows of columns around a usually round building or courtyard.

tgm007644.label: Perpetual calendars
tgm007644.scope: Calendars based on mathematical calculations with days and weeks arranged so that the correct day of the week can be determined for any given date for a wide range of years.

tgm007650.label: Perspective
tgm007650.scope: The graphic technique of conveying an impression of depth by means of geometric projection using one or more vanishing points.

tgm007651.label: Perspective projections
tgm007651.scope: Projections in which three-dimensional subjects are represented on two-dimensional surfaces so that the effect is the same as if the actual scene were observed. That is, the projectors converge towards the eye of the observer. Frequently done without complete dimensional accuracy.

tgm007673.label: Pets
tgm007673.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ANIMALS & PETS used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm007687.label: Philanthropy
tgm007687.scope: Benevolence in support of a cause, event, or individual's or organization's activities.

tgm007690.label: Phlebotomy
tgm007690.scope: For letting of blood in treatment of disease.

tgm007702.label: Photochrom prints
tgm007702.scope: Color photomechanical prints produced lithographically from photographs. The technique was developed in Switzerland in the 1880s by Photoglob Zurich and used until the early 1900s. The caption is often in gold lettering. The prints look deceptively like color photographs unless viewed with a magnifying glass.

tgm007704.label: Photocopies
tgm007704.scope: Typically, quick copy reproductions of textual documents, photographs, or other items made through an electrostatic or other electrophotographic process. Introduced commercially in 1948. Examples include prints from office copiers and microfilm readers.

tgm007705.label: Photoengravings
tgm007705.scope: Limited here to prints made by photoglyphy, photogalvanography, or other methods of obtaining an intaglio or relief printing plate from a photograph before the commercial viability of the line and halftone photomechanical print processes in the 1880s.

tgm007708.label: Photogenic drawings
tgm007708.scope: Negatives produced by William Henry Fox Talbot using a printing-out process he invented in 1835. Some made as photograms and others with a camera. In the mid-19th century sometimes used as a synonym for photographs.

tgm007710.label: Photograms
tgm007710.scope: Photographs made by laying objects on photographic paper or film and exposing them to light.

tgm007711.label: Photograph albums
tgm007711.scope: Albums specially designed to hold photographs or albums containing photographs. Both empty and filled albums are included.

tgm007712.label: Photograph cases
tgm007712.scope: Decorative containers for one or several photographs. Primarily made from 1840s-1860s, usually of leather, paper-covered wood, gutta percha, or thermoplastic material; mostly for ambrotypes and daguerreotypes.

tgm007717.label: Photographic postcards
tgm007717.scope: Postcards that are photographs. Kodak introduced a sensitized postcard-size stock with standard postcard information printed on the back in 1902. The format remained popular through about 1920, and is still available. Commercial names include Velox and Azo (from Kodak) and Cyko (from Ansco).

tgm007718.label: Photographic prints
tgm007718.scope: Photographs produced from negatives, by transfer photo processes, or, in the case of photograms, by the direct action of light on light-sensitive paper. Tonal values are usually the same as those of the subject shown. Do not confuse with continuous tone photomechanical prints, such as COLLOTYPES and WOODBURYTYPES.

tgm007721.label: Photographs
tgm007721.scope: The word PHOTOGRAPHS is a general designation for any photographic process. The narrower terms include both physical media and genre categories.

tgm007722.label: Photography
tgm007722.scope: For the subject of photography in general and the activities of photographers.

tgm007726.label: Photogravures
tgm007726.scope: Prints that faithfully imitate photographs or other continuous tone originals. Hand-pulled prints from plates with an aquatint grain have an irregular pattern of dotting; prints from screened gravure plates have a regular pattern of dots but, unlike halftone prints, ink varies in density. Introduced in 1879.

tgm007727.label: Photojournalism
tgm007727.scope: For the subject of photojournalism in general and the activities of photojournalists.

tgm007729.label: Photolithographs
tgm007729.scope: Limited here to prints made directly from stones or zinc plates to which the image was photographically transferred. One such process was patented in the United States in 1858. For offset photolithography, search under OFFSET PHOTOMECHANICAL PRINTS.

tgm007730.label: Photomechanical prints
tgm007730.scope: Prints made from photographically prepared printing surfaces. Most have a distinctive dot or screen pattern, but some are continuous tone. Usually planographic.

tgm007752.label: Physics
tgm007752.scope: For the subject of physics in general and the activities of physicists.

tgm007756.label: Physionotrace works
tgm007756.scope: Drawings produced by tracing an image made by a physionotrace. Also, works made from such tracings, such as engraved silhouettes.

tgm007757.label: Physionotraces
tgm007757.scope: A device invented in the late 18th century for making tracings.

tgm007759.label: Pianos
tgm007759.scope: Includes the activity of playing pianos.

tgm007762.label: Pickets
tgm007762.scope: For persons posted, usually with signs, at places of business in an effort to discourage access by employees or patrons.

tgm007772.label: Pictorial envelopes
tgm007772.scope: Envelopes with printed or hand-drawn designs and illustrations. William Mulready designed the first printed cover for Great Britain in 1839. Images may be portraits, advertisements, comic scenes, city views, political, or purely decorative.

tgm007775.label: Pictorial lettersheets
tgm007775.scope: Stationery illustrated with lithographed or engraved views or other scenes. Prevalent in mid-1800s.

tgm007777.label: Picture puzzles
tgm007777.scope: Pictures in which some figures or objects are not readily apparent, for example, animal shapes hidden in trees or in a landscape.

tgm007784.label: Pier tables
tgm007784.scope: A side table, usually with a large high mirror, to be placed against a wall between two windows.

tgm007792.label: Pigeonholes
tgm007792.scope: Small open compartments (as in desks or cabinets) for keeping letters or documents.

tgm007799.label: Pilasters
tgm007799.scope: Upright architectural elements that are rectangular in plan and structurally piers but treated as columns.

tgm007809.label: Pillories
tgm007809.scope: Devices for publicly punishing offenders consisting of a wooden frame with holes in which the head and hands can be locked.

tgm007843.label: Pipelines
tgm007843.scope: Lines of pipe with pumping machinery and apparatus for conveying liquids, especially petroleum.

tgm007844.label: Pipes (Conduits)
tgm007844.scope: Conduits for conducting liquids or gases.

tgm007846.label: Pipes (Smoking)
tgm007846.scope: A long tube or hollow body for smoking tobacco or other substances.

tgm007853.label: Pitchers
tgm007853.scope: A container for holding and pouring liquids that usually has a lip or spout and a handle.

tgm007868.label: Planning drawings
tgm007868.scope: Design drawings, including master plans, for local, city, regional, and other planning projects and their components. Distinguished from architectural, engineering, and landscape architecture drawings chiefly by the designation 'planner' for the person or firm that produces or oversees them.

tgm007871.label: Plans
tgm007871.scope: Graphic delineations of a site, structure, or object in a horizontal projection. Projection lines are parallel to the picture plane rather than in perspective.

tgm007879.label: Planting drawings
tgm007879.scope: Design drawings that are plans showing the arrangement, placement, and other characteristics of plantings and remaining natural vegetation in a defined area.

tgm007882.label: Plaques
tgm007882.scope: Inscribed, usually metal tablets placed (as on a building or post) to identify a site or commemorate an individual or event.

tgm007890.label: Plastos
tgm007890.scope: Flexible thermosetting printing plates suitable for flatbed printing, stereotyping, and rotary printing; may have adhesive backing. Plastos is a commercial stock name.

tgm007897.label: Platinum prints
tgm007897.scope: Photographic prints on paper sensitized with platinum salts. Introduced commercially in 1879 as Platinotypes. Papers manufactured until World War I; revived by photographers who coat their own paper.

tgm007898.label: Plats
tgm007898.scope: Maps showing land boundaries, subdivisions, ownership, and all data essential to describe and identify units shown thereon. After about 1900, they include one or more certificates indicating due approval. They do not necessarily show relief, drainage, or cultural features.

tgm007901.label: Playbills
tgm007901.scope: Programs printed on one sheet for plays or theatrical entertainments.

tgm007902.label: Player pianos
tgm007902.scope: Includes the activity of playing player pianos.

tgm007907.label: Playing cards
tgm007907.scope: Cards made in sets of a designated number of cards and marked for use in playing one or more games or telling fortunes.

tgm007914.label: Plazas
tgm007914.scope: Open places in towns; public squares.

tgm007928.label: Plumbing systems
tgm007928.scope: Systems within buildings that supply water to the occupants and carry off liquid or liquid-suspended wastes.

tgm007931.label: Pluralism (Social sciences)
tgm007931.scope: The condition in which numerous ethnic, religious, or cultural groups exist together in one society.

tgm007932.label: Plutocracy
tgm007932.scope: For the subject of plutocracy in general.

tgm007939.label: Poaching
tgm007939.scope: Taking or killing game or fish by illegal methods.

tgm007940.label: Pochoir prints
tgm007940.scope: Prints colored by a stencil or stencil and brush technique; usually book illustrations or reproductions; extensively used in France.

tgm007942.label: Pocket doors
tgm007942.scope: Doors that slide into a recess in a wall.

tgm007946.label: Podiums
tgm007946.scope: Raised platforms in halls and large rooms.

tgm007966.label: Police
tgm007966.scope: Includes policemen, mixed groups of policemen and policewomen, as well as police departments and occasions when gender is not specified.

tgm007975.label: Police stations
tgm007975.scope: For images that focus on buildings. Search under POLICE for activities.

tgm007988.label: Political campaigns
tgm007988.scope: Activities designed to influence public opinion or voting at an election.

tgm007990.label: Political cartoons
tgm007990.scope: Cartoons that present a viewpoint on a contemporary political issue, situation, public figure, or institution. They frequently employ wit, satire, or caricature, and may use a vocabulary of symbols, types, or figures to represent political entities, bodies, or principles.

tgm007993.label: Political elections
tgm007993.scope: Activities relating to an election or for the subject of elections in general. See POLITICAL CAMPAIGNS for activities related to campaigning.

tgm007995.label: Political issues
tgm007995.scope: For political issues in general. Search also under headings for specific issues.

tgm008000.label: Political pageantry
tgm008000.scope: Public celebration of political ideals, the power of the state, or particular rulers by means of symbolic displays or spectacles. Search under POLITICAL PARADES & RALLIES for events in support of political candidates, parties, or their causes.

tgm008001.label: Political parades & rallies
tgm008001.scope: For events in support of political candidates, political parties, and/or political causes. Search under POLITICAL PAGEANTRY for public celebration of political ideals, the power of the state, or particular rulers by means of symbolic displays or spectacles.

tgm008002.label: Political participation
tgm008002.scope: Search also under the subdivision --POLITICAL ACTIVITY used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A) and with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm008006.label: Political posters
tgm008006.scope: Includes election campaign posters as well as posters about such social-political issues as the environment, health care, and civil rights. Also includes propaganda posters.

tgm008012.label: Political strategies
tgm008012.scope: Techniques for guiding or influencing government or political organization policy.

tgm008016.label: Politicians
tgm008016.scope: For persons actively engaged in politics as managed by parties; often, persons primarily interested in political offices or the profits from them as a source of private gain.

tgm008017.label: Politics & government
tgm008017.scope: For the conduct of and participation in government in the broadest sense. Search also under the subdivision --POLITICAL ACTIVITY used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm008025.label: Polychromy
tgm008025.scope: Painting or decorating in multiple colors.

tgm008026.label: Polyester negatives
tgm008026.scope: Negatives with a polyester film base; introduced in the mid-1950s.

tgm008027.label: Polygamy
tgm008027.scope: Practice of having more than one spouse. Search under BIGAMY for multiple marriage as a criminal offense.

tgm008029.label: Polyptychs
tgm008029.scope: A work (print, photograph, or painting) that consists of more than three sections or panels intended to be connected or viewed as a single unit.

tgm008036.label: Pony carts
tgm008036.scope: Small carts used to convey people, especially children.

tgm008044.label: Pools
tgm008044.scope: Still bodies of water smaller than ponds of natural formation, either permanent or temporary.

tgm008045.label: Poor boxes
tgm008045.scope: A box in a church, for alms for the poor.

tgm008050.label: Popes
tgm008050.scope: Head of the Roman Catholic church.

tgm008061.label: Porcelain enamel
tgm008061.scope: An opaque, glassy metal oxide coating fused at high tempartures to metal.

tgm008063.label: Porches
tgm008063.scope: Covered entrances to buildings, usually with a separate roof.

tgm008073.label: Portages
tgm008073.scope: Carrying of boats, goods, etc., overland between navigable waters; also, the routes over which they are carried.

tgm008075.label: Porte cocheres
tgm008075.scope: Roofs projecting at entrances to buildings, providing shelter to those getting in and out of vehicles; also, carriage entrances leading into courtyards.

tgm008077.label: Portfolios
tgm008077.scope: Graphic materials issued in unbound sets with paper or board covers to contain them. Often have a loose title page or text introduction. Refers to both the container and its contents.

tgm008079.label: Porticoes (Porches)
tgm008079.scope: Covered entrances or galleries for buildings of certain scale and importance, usually associated with classical and neoclassical architecture.

tgm008083.label: Portrait photographs
tgm008083.scope: For formal, posed studio portraits, as well as informal, candid photographs of persons in natural or spontaneous situations.

tgm008085.label: Portraits
tgm008085.scope: Graphic representations, especially of the face, of real persons, usually posed, living or dead. Pictures whose purpose is the portrayal of an individual or several people, not pictures that merely include people as part of an event or scene.

tgm008089.label: Posing
tgm008089.scope: To assume postures for the purposes of portrait or modeling sessions.

tgm008094.label: Post offices
tgm008094.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under POSTAL SERVICE for activities.

tgm008096.label: Postage stamps
tgm008096.scope: Government-authorized hand stamps, adhesive stamps, or meter markings intended as evidence of payment of postage. Also, stamps issued by private mail delivery companies to denote payment of their delivery fees.

tgm008101.label: Postal stationery
tgm008101.scope: Cards, envelopes, aerograms, and other stationery imprinted with postage indicating prepayment.

tgm008103.label: Postcards
tgm008103.scope: Cards on which a message may be written or printed for mailing without an envelope; often include a pictorial, comic, or other scene on one side.
