tgm008104.label: Posters
tgm008104.scope: Single or multi-sheet notices made to attract attention to events, activities, causes, goods, or services; also, purely decorative posters. For posting, usually in a public place; chiefly pictorial. Intended to make an immediate impression from a distance.

tgm008110.label: Postmortem photographs
tgm008110.scope: Photographs of deceased persons or pets. The corpse is usally presented in a lifelike or resting pose, sometimes in a casket. These photographs were made to be preserved as keepsakes by those in mourning, beginning as early as 1839.

tgm008117.label: Potteries
tgm008117.scope: For potteries where wares are made for private or commercial purposes but not mass-produced. Includes activities and structures. Search under POTTERY INDUSTRY for large-scale operations.

tgm008120.label: Pottery industry
tgm008120.scope: For large-scale operations. Includes activities and structures. Search under POTTERIES for private or small-scale commercial activities.

tgm008127.label: Poverty
tgm008127.scope: For the subject of the economic condition of the poor. Search under POOR PERSONS when the focus is on people.

tgm008146.label: Prayer
tgm008146.scope: The act of praying or actual addresses or petitions to a deity.

tgm008149.label: Preachers
tgm008149.scope: People who proclaim religious doctrine in public.

tgm008150.label: Preaching
tgm008150.scope: For the activity of making a religious address. Search also under the subdivision --PUBLIC APPEARANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm008161.label: Prejudice
tgm008161.scope: For the subject of prejudiced attitudes. Search under DISCRIMINATION for images relating to acts of discrimination.

tgm008162.label: Prelates
tgm008162.scope: High ranking clergy in the Christian church.

tgm008166.label: Premiums
tgm008166.scope: Items available without charge or at less than the usual price with the purchase of a product or service, or as a result of a subscription or membership. May be packaged with the product or available through a coupon. Often part of an advertising promotion. Examples include insert advertising cards and cereal box prizes.

tgm008171.label: Presbyterian churches
tgm008171.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm008172.label: Presentation albums
tgm008172.scope: Albums made to be dedicated or presented to a person or organization.

tgm008174.label: Presentation drawings (Proposals)
tgm008174.scope: Graphic representations produced to convey to a client or general audience the effect of the completed appearance and function of a project for a building, object, structure, or site. Usually comprise elevations and plans.

tgm008182.label: Presidential elections
tgm008182.scope: Includes primaries, as well as candidates who fail to be nominated at party conventions.

tgm008183.label: Presidential inaugurations
tgm008183.scope: Search also under the subdivision --INAUGURATION used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm008189.label: Presidents
tgm008189.scope: For the office of the president or for incumbents.

tgm008190.label: Presidents' spouses
tgm008190.scope: For presidents' spouses in general or for those whose spouses are incumbent presidents.

tgm008199.label: Pressbooks
tgm008199.scope: Manuals to instruct motion picture theater owners how to conduct advertising campaigns promoting particular films.

tgm008200.label: Presses
tgm008200.scope: For presses which cut, shape, stamp, or compress.

tgm008205.label: Prestige
tgm008205.scope: Reputation or influence of a person due to their success, achievement, rank or other characteristic.

tgm008210.label: Price lists
tgm008210.scope: Enumerations of costs for goods or services; usually lacking descriptive details of a catalog.

tgm008228.label: Printing
tgm008228.scope: For the act of impressing or otherwise reproducing text, design, or images onto a surface. Search under PRINTMAKING for printing as an artistic endeavor.

tgm008229.label: Printing blocks
tgm008229.scope: Wood blocks, linoleum on wood, or other materials from which relief prints are made.

tgm008231.label: Printing plates
tgm008231.scope: Metal plates; may be mounted on wood blocks.

tgm008235.label: Printmaking
tgm008235.scope: For printing as an artistic endeavor. Search under PRINTING for the act of impressing or otherwise reproducing text, design, or image onto a surface.

tgm008236.label: Printmaking equipment
tgm008236.scope: Tools and equipment used for printing.

tgm008237.label: Prints
tgm008237.scope: Images formed by transfer from one surface or source to another. Usually created with ink(s) and produced in multiple impressions.

tgm008250.label: Prisoner exchanges
tgm008250.scope: For exchanges of all types of prisoners, including prisoners of war and hostages.

tgm008251.label: Prisoners
tgm008251.scope: Search also under the subdivision --CAPTURE & IMPRISONMENT used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with names of persons (Appendix B). Search also under the subdivision --PRISONERS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm008252.label: Prisoners of war
tgm008252.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PRISONERS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm008256.label: Private camps
tgm008256.scope: For retreats, complexes of cabins, boathouses, etc., for families and friends. Includes activities and sites.

tgm008259.label: Private libraries
tgm008259.scope: For large, privately owned libraries, whether established for use by the public or by members only. Search under LIBRARIES (ROOMS) for libraries in homes.

tgm008272.label: Processes & techniques
tgm008272.scope: Actions and methods performed with materials or objects leading to a result.

tgm008293.label: Programs
tgm008293.scope: Brief, usually printed outlines of the order to be followed, of feature(s) to be presented, and of person(s) participating in a public exercise, performance, or entertainment.

tgm008295.label: Progress photographs
tgm008295.scope: Series of photographs made at intervals from generally the same vantage points showing construction, renovation, or demolition of a structure, site, or object as it progresses.

tgm008296.label: Progressive proofs
tgm008296.scope: In printmaking, sets of proofs showing color printing in successive stages from first color to finished print, with one superimposed over the other. Also, sets showing each color separately as well as in final combination.

tgm008297.label: Progressivism (United States politics)
tgm008297.scope: For the subject of the principles and beliefs of progressives.

tgm008298.label: Prohibition
tgm008298.scope: Legal prevention of the manufacture, transportation, and sale of alcoholic beverages.

tgm008300.label: Projections
tgm008300.scope: Graphic representations in which imaginary sight lines (projectors) extend from the eye of the observer to the object being depicted. The projectors create an image of the subject on an imaginary plane between the observer and the subject. Depending on the sight lines used, the subject is shown realistically or tilted or otherwise altered to emphasize particular features.

tgm008304.label: Promenade card photographs
tgm008304.scope: Card photographs; mounts measure approximately 7 x 4 or 7.5 x 4 in. (18 x 11 or 19 x 11 cm.). Introduced ca. 1874.

tgm008308.label: Promotional materials
tgm008308.scope: Printed material or products given away to promote public awareness of consumer goods or social issues.

tgm008310.label: Pronaoi
tgm008310.scope: An open vestibule before the sanctuary in a temple, may also be referred to as anticum.

tgm008313.label: Proofs
tgm008313.scope: In printmaking, impressions taken at any stage from a plate, block, or stone, but not considered part of the edition. In photography, photographic prints made as quick records of a negative or for clients to choose from, as with studio portraits.

tgm008314.label: Proofs before letters
tgm008314.scope: In printmaking, impressions complete except for a title or publication statement to be printed outside of the image area.

tgm008315.label: Propaganda
tgm008315.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COMMUNICATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm008320.label: Prophecy
tgm008320.scope: Inspired declarations of divine will and purpose.

tgm008323.label: Proposed works
tgm008323.scope: Designs for projects that have not been executed. Examples include architectural drawings for buildings that were not erected and book illustrations that were not published.

tgm008327.label: Proscenium arches
tgm008327.scope: An arch that separates the stage from the audience in a theater.

tgm008330.label: Prosperity
tgm008330.scope: Condition of being successful and thriving, especially economic well-being.

tgm008336.label: Protest movements
tgm008336.scope: For opposition in regard to particular political or social issues. Search under PACIFISM for opposition to violence. Search under OPPOSITION (POLITICAL SCIENCE) for organized political resistance to the government in power. Search also under the subdivision --PROTEST MOVEMENTS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm008337.label: Protest posters
tgm008337.scope: Posters expressing criticism, negative social commentary or dissent. Sometimes such posters were issued as propaganda or in support of a revolutionary movement.

tgm008338.label: Protest works
tgm008338.scope: Graphic works expressing political criticism, social commentary, or dissent.

tgm008339.label: Protestant churches
tgm008339.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm008347.label: Psychiatric hospitals
tgm008347.scope: For images that focus on buildings. Search under MENTALLY ILL PERSONS for activities

tgm008348.label: Psychiatry
tgm008348.scope: For the subject of psychiatry in general and the activities of psychiatrists.

tgm008351.label: Psychotherapy
tgm008351.scope: For the subject of psychotherapy in general and the activities of psychotherapists.

tgm008360.label: Public baths
tgm008360.scope: Public buildings for bathing. Includes activities and structures. Search under BATHHOUSES for public facilities containing dressing rooms.

tgm008378.label: Public service employment
tgm008378.scope: For the subject of public sector employment as a counter-cyclical policy measure intended to provide jobs for the unemployed as well as to provide economic assistance to distressed areas and state and local governments. Search under CIVIL SERVICE for government employment in general.

tgm008381.label: Public speaking
tgm008381.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PUBLIC APPEARANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm008389.label: Publicity
tgm008389.scope: Acts or devices designed to attract public attention or support. Search also under the subdivision --PUBLIC RELATIONS used with names of corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm008390.label: Publicity photographs
tgm008390.scope: Photos made for publicity or promotional purposes, unlike FASHION PHOTOGRAPHS, which emphasize the product being modeled, or GLAMOUR PHOTOGRAPHS, which focus on the physical attractiveness of the subject.

tgm008397.label: Pueblos
tgm008397.scope: Settlements of multistory, multiroom complex dwellings, often built on mesas or cliffs, common among Hopi, Pueblo, and other Native American cultures of the southwestern United States.

tgm008413.label: Pundits
tgm008413.scope: Scholars or learned people, especially those who give opinions in an authoritative manner.

tgm008416.label: Punishment & torture
tgm008416.scope: Search also under ABUSED WOMEN and ABUSED CHILDREN for punishment & torture of members of these groups. Search also under the subdivision --PUNISHMENT & TORTURE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm008422.label: Puppets
tgm008422.scope: For puppets not being used in puppet shows.

tgm008430.label: Puzzles
tgm008430.scope: Recreational devices that present difficulties to be solved.

tgm008434.label: Pyxes
tgm008434.scope: A container for the reserved host, especially a small round metal receptacle used to carry the Eucharist to the sick.

tgm008435.label: Quacks
tgm008435.scope: Persons who pretend to have medical skills.

tgm008437.label: Quadrangles (Courtyards)
tgm008437.scope: Square or oblong courtyards enclosed on all sides by buildings.

tgm008444.label: Quaker guns
tgm008444.scope: Dummy pieces of artillery, usually of wood (from the Quaker doctrine of nonresistance).

tgm008447.label: Quarantines
tgm008447.scope: Includes images related to the activity of quarantining and the places where quarantined persons are kept.

tgm008448.label: Quarreling
tgm008448.scope: Search under FIGHTING for physical fighting.

tgm008450.label: Quarrying
tgm008450.scope: Extraction of stone, marble, slate, etc., from quarries. Includes activities and sites.

tgm008455.label: Quatrefoils
tgm008455.scope: Conventionalized representations of a flower with four petals or a leaf with four leaflets; figures enclosed by four joined foils, specifically, a four-lobed foliation in Gothic tracery.

tgm008460.label: Queues
tgm008460.scope: Lines, especially of persons or vehicles.

tgm008464.label: Quillwork
tgm008464.scope: Native American embroidery using porcupine or bird quills.

tgm008487.label: Race discrimination
tgm008487.scope: For overt discriminatory behavior directed against racial or ethnic groups. Search under RACE RELATIONS for relations among races in general and under RACISM for the subject of racist attitudes.

tgm008488.label: Race horses
tgm008488.scope: For race horses away from the context of racing. Search under HORSE RACING for activities.

tgm008489.label: Race relations
tgm008489.scope: For relations among races in general. Search under RACE DISCRIMINATION for overt discriminatory behavior directed against racial or ethnic groups and under RACISM for the subject of racist attitudes.

tgm008495.label: Racetracks
tgm008495.scope: For images that focus on physical facilities. Search under RACING for activities.

tgm008504.label: Racing automobiles
tgm008504.scope: For racing automobiles away from the context of racing. Search under AUTOMOBILE RACING for activities.

tgm008508.label: Racism
tgm008508.scope: For the subject of racist attitudes. Search under RACE DISCRIMINATION for overt discriminatory behavior directed against racial or ethnic groups and under RACE RELATIONS for relations among races in general.

tgm008516.label: Radicalism
tgm008516.scope: For the subject of radicalism in general.

tgm008520.label: Radio industry
tgm008520.scope: Manufacture and trade of radios. Includes activities and structures.

tgm008521.label: Radio photographs
tgm008521.scope: Photographs scanned and converted to electrical signals, transmitted using radio waves, and then re-formed into images.

tgm008530.label: Radiographs
tgm008530.scope: Shadow images of internal structures made visible by recording the varying degrees of a subject's absorption of x-rays or gamma rays passed through it. Discovered in 1895.

tgm008534.label: Radiophones
tgm008534.scope: Transmitting or receiving sets for radiotelephony.

tgm008543.label: Ragpicking
tgm008543.scope: Picking up rags as a means of livelihood.

tgm008549.label: Railroad cabooses
tgm008549.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of cabooses.

tgm008552.label: Railroad cars
tgm008552.scope: For images that focus on the exterior and interior of railroad cars. Search under RAILROADS for general views of trains.

tgm008553.label: Railroad companies
tgm008553.scope: For companies operating passenger or freight lines. Includes activities and structures.

tgm008557.label: Railroad cuts
tgm008557.scope: Long or wide areas of land from which earth has been removed, usually by trenching or excavating for railroad construction and maintenance.

tgm008559.label: Railroad dining cars
tgm008559.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of dining cars.

tgm008564.label: Railroad freight cars
tgm008564.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of freight cars.

tgm008570.label: Railroad locomotives
tgm008570.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of locomotives.

tgm008571.label: Railroad lounge cars
tgm008571.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of lounge cars.

tgm008575.label: Railroad observation cars
tgm008575.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of observation cars.

tgm008576.label: Railroad passenger cars
tgm008576.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of passenger cars.

tgm008579.label: Railroad private cars
tgm008579.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of private cars.

tgm008581.label: Railroad refrigerator cars
tgm008581.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of refrigerator cars.

tgm008584.label: Railroad roundhouses
tgm008584.scope: A circular building for housing and repairing locomotives.

tgm008585.label: Railroad section cars
tgm008585.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of section cars.

tgm008591.label: Railroad sleeping cars
tgm008591.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of sleeping cars.

tgm008592.label: Railroad smoking cars
tgm008592.scope: For images that focus on the exterior or interior of smoking cars.

tgm008607.label: Railroads
tgm008607.scope: For the subject of railroads and general views of trains. Search under RAILROAD COMPANIES for organizations that operate railroads.

tgm008631.label: Rangers
tgm008631.scope: Persons responsible for ranging over a region for its protection.

tgm008668.label: Rebellions
tgm008668.scope: Open resistance to, or defiance of, authority by an organized group of people. Search under REBELS for images that focus on real persons.

tgm008669.label: Rebels
tgm008669.scope: Those who engage in open defiance of authority or ideology. Use REVOLUTIONARIES for those who advocate the overthrow of established government.

tgm008670.label: Rebuses
tgm008670.scope: Messages or other texts conveyed in part through words or syllables represented by pictures of objects or symbols whose names resemble the intended words in sound.

tgm008680.label: Reclamation of land
tgm008680.scope: Bringing wild, waste, or marshy land into a condition for cultivation or other use. Search under CLEARING OF LAND for removal of timber and bushes from land.

tgm008684.label: Reconstructions
tgm008684.scope: Images that propose how something may have looked at a previous time; based on historical, archaeological, or similar evidence.

tgm008686.label: Record drawings
tgm008686.scope: In the context of the modern building trade, use for drawings or copies of drawings that are kept as file records after completion of a project; may include as-built drawings, which indicate changes made during construction. In historical contexts, use for copies of architects' design drawings, often on a reduced scale, whether executed or unexecuted designs, kept as records of their work and for drawings made of existing structures.

tgm008694.label: Recorders
tgm008694.scope: Includes the activity of playing recorders.

tgm008700.label: Recreation
tgm008700.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SOCIAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A), with names of persons (Appendix B), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D). Search also under the subdivision --SPORTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm008707.label: Recruiting & enlistment
tgm008707.scope: For military recruiting and enlistment. Search under MEMBERSHIP CAMPAIGNS for other types of recruitment. Search also under the subdivision --RECRUITING & ENLISTMENT used with names of wars (Appendix C), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm008713.label: Red carpet
tgm008713.scope: Symbol of greetings or receptions marked by ceremonial courtesy.

tgm008714.label: Red tape
tgm008714.scope: Symbol of bureaucratic procedure, especially as characterized by mechanical adherence to regulations, needless duplication of records, and compilation of an excessive amount of extraneous information.

tgm008726.label: Refectories
tgm008726.scope: For the dining halls of monasteries or other religious institutions.

tgm008729.label: Referendums
tgm008729.scope: Practice of referring measures passed upon or proposed by legislative bodies to the electorate for approval or rejection.

tgm008731.label: Reflecting pools
tgm008731.scope: Artificial bodies of water designed to reflect buildings, structures, or natural features.

tgm008732.label: Reflections
tgm008732.scope: For images reflected by a surface such as water or a mirror.

tgm008736.label: Reformed churches
tgm008736.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm008742.label: Refugees
tgm008742.scope: Persons fleeing to a foreign country or power, or to another part of their country, to escape danger or persecution. Search under DISASTER VICTIMS for refugees from disasters. Search also under the subdivision --REFUGEES used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm008745.label: Regattas
tgm008745.scope: Rowing, speedboat, or sailing races, or organized series of such races.

tgm008746.label: Regionalism
tgm008746.scope: Consciousness of and loyalty to a distinct region with a homogeneous population.

tgm008747.label: Register marks
tgm008747.scope: Pinholes, cross marks, or other devices used to align prints passed through a press more than once.

tgm008756.label: Reinforced concrete construction
tgm008756.scope: Architecture and other visual works that are made of reinforced concrete.

tgm008763.label: Relief printed etchings
tgm008763.scope: Etchings (which are usually intaglio prints) printed in relief.

tgm008768.label: Religion & politics
tgm008768.scope: For images that focus on the relationship between politics and any religion.

tgm008774.label: Religious calendars
tgm008774.scope: Calendars that highlight religious activities and events for specific days.

tgm008784.label: Religious meetings
tgm008784.scope: For religious rallies and meetings of religious organizations.

tgm008785.label: Religious orders
tgm008785.scope: For groups of persons living according to a common religious discipline.

tgm008788.label: Religious retreats
tgm008788.scope: Withdrawal by members of a religious group for purposes of prayer, meditation, study, and instruction under a director. Includes activities and structures.

tgm008794.label: Remarques
tgm008794.scope: Drawn, etched, or engraved designs or sketches on the margin of a print, printing plate, or stone; sometimes removed after proofs are made.

tgm008797.label: Remodeling
tgm008797.scope: For situations in which an existing structure or its features are clearly being restructured or converted.

tgm008800.label: Renderings
tgm008800.scope: Design drawings often intended for presentation, display, or publication. Light and shadow and often color heighten the three-dimensional appearance of the subject. Usually, perspectives and highly finished, detailed representations of a site, structure, building, object, or portion thereof.

tgm008805.label: Reparations
tgm008805.scope: Compensation, either in money or in materials, commodities, equipment, etc., payable by a nation for damages and loss sustained as a result of aggression.

tgm008814.label: Reproductions
tgm008814.scope: Copies of any image, object, or document that are faithful imitations and made without the intent to deceive. Often made by a mechanical technique, such as photographic or print making processes. They can be in another medium, e.g., engraving of a painting, or of a different size from the original.

tgm008815.label: Reproductive prints
tgm008815.scope: Prints (other than photomechanical) that are either copies of or based closely on two-dimensional original works in other media, such as paintings.

tgm008818.label: Rescue work
tgm008818.scope: For the subject of rescue work in general and images that focus on the operations of rescue workers in accidents or disasters. Search under RESCUES for activities in freeing persons or animals from confinement, danger, and evil.

tgm008820.label: Rescues
tgm008820.scope: For activities involved in freeing persons or animals from confinement, danger, and evil. Search under RESCUE WORK for the subject of rescue work in general and images that focus on the operations of rescue workers in accidents or disasters.

tgm008821.label: Research
tgm008821.scope: Studious examination or collection of information on a subject area.

tgm008833.label: Residential streets
tgm008833.scope: For views of streets in residential areas. Search under DWELLINGS for images that focus on buildings.

tgm008835.label: Resignations
tgm008835.scope: Search also under the subdivisions --RESIGNATION FROM OFFICE and --ABDICATION used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm008837.label: Resin-coated paper prints
tgm008837.scope: Photographic prints on a paper base coated on both sides with plastic to reduce processing time; introduced ca. 1970.

tgm008842.label: Resolutions
tgm008842.scope: Formal expressions of opinion, will, or intent by an official body or assembled group.

tgm008849.label: Rest homes
tgm008849.scope: Establishments that provide housing and general care for the aged or convalescents.

tgm008851.label: Rest rooms
tgm008851.scope: Rooms in public facilities containing toilets and lavoratories for use by visitors or employees.

tgm008852.label: Rest stops
tgm008852.scope: For pauses in journeys and the sites where such pauses occur; includes activities and structures.

tgm008857.label: Restrikes
tgm008857.scope: In printmaking, impressions made after the original edition has been issued. Usually unsigned and unnumbered.

tgm008864.label: Retaining walls
tgm008864.scope: Walls constructed to resist lateral loads, such as banks of earth.

tgm008872.label: Reunions
tgm008872.scope: For the coming together of people to mark a former or ongoing association. Search under HOMECOMINGS for occasions when people return to their families or homeland after a long absence. Search also under COMMEMORATION used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm008876.label: Reviewing stands
tgm008876.scope: A seating area, sometimes covered, from which officials view parades and processions.

tgm008879.label: Revolutionaries
tgm008879.scope: For those who advocate fundamental change in political, economic, and/or social structures, often associated with overthrow of established government. Use REBELS for those who engage in open defiance of authority or ideology without advocating overthrow of the established government.

tgm008882.label: Revolutions
tgm008882.scope: For sudden, fundamental change in political, economic, or social structures, often associated with overthrow of established government. Search under REVOLUTIONARIES for images that focus on real persons.

tgm008888.label: Rewards of merit
tgm008888.scope: Small printed or handwritten documents awarded in schools in recognition of good behavior or scholastic achievement. Common in the 1800s.

tgm008901.label: Rice paddies
tgm008901.scope: For images that focus on rice fields.

tgm008914.label: Rifles
tgm008914.scope: For firearms that are fired from the shoulder.

tgm008929.label: Riot control
tgm008929.scope: Civil or military actions or involvement to prevent, contain, or suppress group acts of violence or civil disorders.

tgm008931.label: Riots
tgm008931.scope: Search also under the subdivision --RIOTS & DEMONSTRATIONS used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm008933.label: Rites & ceremonies
tgm008933.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SPIRITUAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivision --RITES & CEREMONIES used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm008945.label: Road cuts
tgm008945.scope: Long or wide areas of land from which earth has been removed, usually by trenching or excavating for road construction and maintenance.

tgm008950.label: Roads
tgm008950.scope: For thoroughfares outside of cities, towns, and villages. Search under STREETS for thoroughfares in cities, towns, and villages.

tgm008957.label: Robes
tgm008957.scope: Long, loose garments, which tend to be of one piece worn for ordinary wear or for ceremonial or official occasions or as a symbol of office or profession.

tgm008961.label: Rock art
tgm008961.scope: Engraved or painted designs on natural rock surfaces. Search also under subdivisions --ARTS & CRAFTS, --COMMUNICATION, and --SPIRITUAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm008970.label: Rock posters
tgm008970.scope: Posters promoting rock and other popular music concerts or musicians. Includes works from the early years of rock and roll in the 1950s, the psychedelic era of the 1960s and 1970s, and later types.

tgm008978.label: Rockets
tgm008978.scope: A vehicle or aircraft powered by a rocket engine. When rockets are used as weaponry, search under MISSILES.

tgm008982.label: Rock-cut architecture
tgm008982.scope: Structures built by cutting into a rock formation. Use CAVE DWELLINGS for structures built into existing caves.

tgm008997.label: Romances
tgm008997.scope: For images representing dramatic productions or scenes (theatrical, film, radio, or television) which focus on the love or courting relationship of couples.

tgm009004.label: Rookeries
tgm009004.scope: Breeding grounds or colonies of mammals or birds.

tgm009014.label: Roping
tgm009014.scope: Binding, fastening, or tieing with rope or cord; capturing by means of rope.

tgm009016.label: Rosettes
tgm009016.scope: Ornamental disks consisting of leafage or a floral design resembling a rose, usually in relief.

tgm009022.label: Rotogravures
tgm009022.scope: Prints in which an unobtrusive cross line screen breaks up the image, which is then printed from a rotating cylinder. Introduced ca. 1895 and commonly used for newspaper illustrations. Especially suitable for long printing runs at high speed; inks frequently brown or sepia.

tgm009023.label: Rotor ships
tgm009023.scope: Ship powered by the pressure and suction of the wind acting on revolving vertical cylinders.

tgm009024.label: Rotundas
tgm009024.scope: For round buildings, especially ones covered by domes; also, large round rooms and large central areas (as in hotels).

tgm009029.label: Round towers
tgm009029.scope: Use for circular stone towers, tapered at top, with conical stone cap and an entry door high above the ground; common in Ireland, associated with churches, and probably built between the 10th and 12th centuries.

tgm009032.label: Roundels
tgm009032.scope: Circular panels usually sculptured or otherwise decorated, set as decorative elements in an architectural context.

tgm009040.label: Rowing
tgm009040.scope: For activity of rowing where vessel is not a rowboat, or where vessel is not visible. Search under TEAM ROWING for crew or team rowing and under ROWING RACES for races or regattas involving rowing. Search under ROWERS for rowers not engaged in the activity.

tgm009043.label: Royal weddings
tgm009043.scope: Search also under the subdivision --MARRIAGE used with names of persons (Appendix B)

tgm009051.label: Rubbings
tgm009051.scope: Impressions made by rubbing charcoal, graphite, or a similar substance across a sheet of paper placed on a surface, portions of which stand out in relief.

tgm009055.label: Rugs
tgm009055.scope: Textiles with thick, heavy fabric with nap or pile, used as a floor covering.

tgm009057.label: Ruins
tgm009057.scope: For remains of structures not of ancient times that have been destroyed or are in a state of great disrepair or decay. Search under ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES for ancient structures still largely intact, remains of ancient structures, and any active excavations. Search under ABANDONED BUILDINGS for vacant, possibly dilapidated buildings. Search under DISASTERS or WAR DAMAGE for structures ruined by particular events.

tgm009067.label: Runaways
tgm009067.scope: A child or teenager who runs away from home without permission.

tgm009080.label: Rustic work
tgm009080.scope: Summerhouses or furniture for outdoor use made of rough limbs of trees.

tgm009081.label: Rustication
tgm009081.scope: Surface pattern giving the effect of large blocks with deep, wide joints.

tgm009086.label: Sabbaths
tgm009086.scope: For Saturday or Sunday observance and activities on the day of rest.

tgm009087.label: Sabotage
tgm009087.scope: For malicious waste or destruction of an employer's property by workers, as during labor troubles; and for destructive actions by civilians or enemy agents within a country, designed to impede the armed forces.

tgm009092.label: Sacristies
tgm009092.scope: Rooms in churches where vessels and vestments are kept.

tgm009102.label: Safety film negatives
tgm009102.scope: Negatives that do not have a flammable film base; first introduced for still photography in the early 1900s. The various types are often difficult to distinguish.

tgm009108.label: Sailing cards
tgm009108.scope: Printed cards made to attract freight consignments or passengers to ships preparing to depart. A picture of the vessel is often included; chiefly 1850s-1860s, though continued in use beyond the era of clipper ships; commonly 4 x 6.5 in. (10 x 16 cm.).

tgm009110.label: Sailors
tgm009110.scope: For personnel of all types of vessels. Double index under the service for military personnel.

tgm009116.label: Sales catalogs
tgm009116.scope: Catalogs issued by businesses and individuals offering products for sale to retailers or the public. Often include prices. Specialized catalogs, such as those for Christmas orders and seeds, are included.

tgm009137.label: Salted paper prints
tgm009137.scope: Limited here to photographic prints in which the silver particles are in the paper rather than on the surface in a gelatin or other matrix; introduced in 1839; in use through 1860s.

tgm009140.label: Salvage
tgm009140.scope: Saving or securing property, as well as property saved.

tgm009146.label: Sample books
tgm009146.scope: Albums or other volumes with type face specimens, paint chips, swatches of cloth, or other samples.

tgm009147.label: Samples
tgm009147.scope: Books, sheets, or packages containing samples of designs or materials that can be purchased from particular manufacturers or printers. Examples include single sheets made to exhibit the type of work a commercial printer produces and small packages of advertising samples.

tgm009149.label: Sanatoriums
tgm009149.scope: Establishments for the treatment of the sick, especially if suffering from chronic disease, e.g., alcoholism, tuberculosis, requiring protracted care. Includes activities and structures.

tgm009152.label: Sand boils
tgm009152.scope: Bubbling spring behind river levee when water at flood stage is forced through the levee.

tgm009161.label: Sandpaintings
tgm009161.scope: Search also under the subdivision --ARTS & CRAFTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm009164.label: Sandwich boards
tgm009164.scope: Two boards, usually hinged, designed to be hung from the shoulders for advertising purposes.

tgm009168.label: Sanitation
tgm009168.scope: Conditions or practices for maintaining public health and preventing disease.

tgm009171.label: Sarcophagi
tgm009171.scope: Stone coffins, often ornamented with sculpture and usually placed in a church, tomb, or vault.

tgm009179.label: Satires (Visual works)
tgm009179.scope: Graphic commentaries critical of the failings, weaknesses, and morals of the people, governments, or organizations depicted.

tgm009191.label: Sawtooth roofs
tgm009191.scope: Roofs that have parallel roof surfaces of triangular section with a profile resembling teeth in a saw.

tgm009192.label: Saxophones
tgm009192.scope: Includes the activity of playing saxophones.

tgm009193.label: Scaffold burial
tgm009193.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SPIRITUAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm009203.label: Scarcity
tgm009203.scope: For the general subject of shortages. Search under ASSISTANCE for efforts to ameliorate scarcity.

tgm009208.label: Scavenging
tgm009208.scope: Picking up refuse (as from garabage cans or public dumps) or other waste material such as ash and scrap wood as a means of livelihood.

tgm009215.label: Schedules (Architectural records)
tgm009215.scope: Detailed tabulations on architectural and similar working drawings or on separate sheets that indicate dimensions, materials, or fixtures required at various points in the design.

tgm009217.label: Schedules (Time plans)
tgm009217.scope: Plans or lists showing sequences of events and their respective times.

tgm009227.label: School children
tgm009227.scope: For students below high school age depicted in the context of school activities.

tgm009243.label: Schools
tgm009243.scope: Includes elementary and secondary educational facilities. May include activities.

tgm009246.label: Sciagraphic projections
tgm009246.scope: Two-dimensional graphic representations with shadows projected according to specific conventions in regard to the source of light. The projectors of the shadows are usually fixed as the diagonal of a cube from the top left corner to the bottom rear corner and at an angle of 45 degrees in plan and elevation.

tgm009250.label: Scientific illustrations
tgm009250.scope: Illustrations characterized by great detail and exactitude, suitable for scientific study or identification of organisms and naturally occurring objects. Component parts are often labeled.

tgm009266.label: Scrapbooks
tgm009266.scope: Albums containing or intended to contain a variety of material, especially clippings or ephemera.

tgm009268.label: Scraps (Decorations)
tgm009268.scope: Die-cut decorations, usually embossed chromolithographs printed in sheets from which each scrap can be broken off to paste on cards or album pages. Popular from mid- to late 1800s; many made in Germany.

tgm009270.label: Scratchboard drawings
tgm009270.scope: White line drawings made by scratching with a stylus or other tool through a coating of black ink on a white, clay coated cardboard. Introduced in the 1800s.

tgm009272.label: Screen color film transparencies
tgm009272.scope: Additive color process transparencies introduced commercially in the 1930s. Tradenames include Filmcolor (replaced Autochromes) and Dufaycolor, which survived into the 1950s.

tgm009273.label: Screen color glass transparencies
tgm009273.scope: Additive color process transparencies available commercially from 1895-1930s.

tgm009276.label: Screen prints
tgm009276.scope: Prints made by forcing ink through a fine screen stencil onto paper or another surface. Art applications date from the 1930s; commercial ones from the 1920s.

tgm009280.label: Scrip
tgm009280.scope: Limited here to money issued by businesses, military organizations, or local (rather than national) governments, often as payment of wages or to provide small change.

tgm009284.label: Scrolls (Visual works)
tgm009284.scope: Illustrated sheets of paper or cloth, much longer in one dimension than the other; meant to be rolled up when not in use.

tgm009291.label: Sculpture
tgm009291.scope: Primarily for representations of figures in the round, sculptured or modeled out of some solid substance, such as wood, stone, marble, or wax. Includes statues and indoor and outdoor sculpture of all kinds. Search under MODELING (SCULPTURE), STONE CARVING and WOOD CARVING for activities. Search also under the subdivision --STATUES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm009315.label: Seals (Impressions)
tgm009315.scope: Wax or embossed impressions; chiefly used to certify a signature or authenticate a document.

tgm009316.label: Seals (Insignia)
tgm009316.scope: A symbol or mark of office.

tgm009319.label: Seances
tgm009319.scope: Spiritualistic meetings to receive spirit communications.

tgm009320.label: Seaplanes
tgm009320.scope: Airplanes designed to take off from and land on the water.

tgm009322.label: Seapower
tgm009322.scope: Naval strength including weapons, installations, and ships, which allow a country to control sea and air space.

tgm009332.label: Seascapes
tgm009332.scope: Works depicting the ocean or other large body of water where the water itself dominates the scene. When lesser bodies of water are depicted, use LANDSCAPES. When ships, shipbuilding, or harbors are depicted, use MARINES (VISUAL WORKS). [AAT]

tgm009349.label: Sections
tgm009349.scope: Graphic delineations of a vertical, horizontal, or oblique slice through a site, structure, or object. They demonstrate the shape and disposition of interior spaces, chambers, and structural or other components showing their placement, proportions, and dimensions.

tgm009353.label: Security checkpoints
tgm009353.scope: Place where people, vehicles, or luggage is inspected to guard against sabotage, crime, terrorism, or escape.

tgm009378.label: Self-portraits
tgm009378.scope: Images of a person created by that same person.

tgm009387.label: Sentiment cards
tgm009387.scope: Cards printed with a word or a brief phrase of love, friendship, or other feelings. The size of visiting cards.

tgm009393.label: Separation of powers
tgm009393.scope: Division of power between the executive, legislative, and judicial branches of government.

tgm009418.label: Set design drawings
tgm009418.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and production (or documentation of design and production) of stage settings for theatrical, movie, broadcast, or other performing arts productions.

tgm009420.label: Settlement houses
tgm009420.scope: Urban institutions that provide educational, recreational, and social services to recent immigrants and the poor.

tgm009428.label: Sewerage
tgm009428.scope: Removal and disposal of sewage and surface water by sewers.

tgm009437.label: Sexism
tgm009437.scope: For the subject of sexist attitudes.

tgm009452.label: Shadoofs
tgm009452.scope: Mechanism made of a rod on a pivot, with a bucket on one end and a weight on the other. Used to raise water from a well or river to use in irrigation. A crane like tool used in irrigation.

tgm009455.label: Shamans
tgm009455.scope: Priests who use magic for the purpose of curing the sick, divining the hidden, and controlling events.

tgm009457.label: Shamisens
tgm009457.scope: Includes the activity of playing shamisens.

tgm009472.label: Sheaves
tgm009472.scope: A quantity of the stalks and ears of a cereal grass or sometimes other plant material bound together.

tgm009483.label: Sheet music covers
tgm009483.scope: Covers or first pages of unbound songs and other pieces of music on eight or fewer pages.

tgm009486.label: Shellbacks
tgm009486.scope: Sailors who have crossed the equator and been initiated in the traditional ceremony.

tgm009493.label: Shelters
tgm009493.scope: Structures that cover or provide protection from the elements.

tgm009504.label: Ship captains
tgm009504.scope: For masters and commanders of all types of vessels.

tgm009515.label: Shipping
tgm009515.scope: For activities involved in the packing, dispatch, and unloading of goods and commodities.

tgm009516.label: Ships
tgm009516.scope: For large sea-going vessels used on oceans or inland waterways.

tgm009520.label: Shipwrecks
tgm009520.scope: For the destruction or loss of a ship and the remains of destroyed or sunken vessels. Search under NAVAL WARFARE for vessels damaged as a result of war.

tgm009523.label: Shirtwaists
tgm009523.scope: Women's blouses or dresses made in the style of men's shirts.; LIV: omitted; AAT: identical

tgm009526.label: Shoe industry
tgm009526.scope: Includes all kinds of footwear. Includes activities and structures. Search under SHOEMAKING for small businesses.

tgm009535.label: Shoes
tgm009535.scope: Footwear made of leather or similar material, reaching about to the ankle and having a heel of variable height.

tgm009538.label: Shooting
tgm009538.scope: Search under HUNTING for shooting game.

tgm009539.label: Shooting galleries
tgm009539.scope: For indoor ranges or covered structures equipped with targets for practice or competition with firearms.

tgm009550.label: Short films
tgm009550.scope: Brief motion pictures with a running time of usually less than 40 minutes. Includes short documentaries, animation films and live action films.

tgm009566.label: Show windows
tgm009566.scope: For images that focus on windows as a part of mercantile facilities rather than their displays. Search under WINDOW DISPLAYS for window dressings and displays.

tgm009574.label: Showrooms
tgm009574.scope: Rooms where merchandise is exposed for sale or where samples are displayed.

tgm009578.label: Shrimp industry
tgm009578.scope: Includes activities and structures. Double index under INDUSTRIAL FACILITIES (or NTs) for images that focus on facilities.

tgm009579.label: Shrines
tgm009579.scope: For structures or sites serving as places of religious veneration or pilgrimage, often consecrated or devoted to a person or deity. Search under TOMBS & SEPULCHRAL MONUMENTS for tombs of those considered holy or of hallowed memory. Search also under the subdivision --SHRINES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm009583.label: Shucking
tgm009583.scope: Opening oyster or clam shells with a small knife.

tgm009586.label: Shut-ins
tgm009586.scope: Invalids confined to home, room, or bed.

tgm009589.label: Sibyls
tgm009589.scope: Certain women of ancient times who were thought to have powers of prophecy and divination.

tgm009590.label: Sick bays
tgm009590.scope: Section in vessels, especially a war vessel or transport, used as a dispensary and hospital.

tgm009592.label: Sick persons
tgm009592.scope: Persons affected with unspecified diseases or ill health; also, persons awaiting or under medical treatment. Search under DISEASES and NTs for specific illnesses. Search also under the subdivisions --HEALTH used with names of persons (Appendix B) and --HEALTH & WELFARE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm009599.label: Sidelights
tgm009599.scope: Narrow windows flanking doors or larger windows.

tgm009601.label: Sideshows
tgm009601.scope: Often auxiliary shows attached to a circus or an exhibition or show with a carnival or amusement park.

tgm009608.label: Sightseers
tgm009608.scope: For persons who go about seeing sights of interest on their own. Search under TOURISTS for persons who are on organized tours.

tgm009620.label: Signs (Notices)
tgm009620.scope: Lettered boards or other displays used to give directions or information, to identify a place of business or public facility, or to give warnings or directions. Textual or symbolic rather than pictorial.

tgm009622.label: Silhouettes
tgm009622.scope: Images shown in profile in a single hue against a contrasting background; cut, drawn, painted, printed, or photographic; often portraits.

tgm009629.label: Silos
tgm009629.scope: Typically cylindrical structures usually sealed when full to exclude air and used for storing silage (fodder).

tgm009642.label: Silver platinum prints
tgm009642.scope: Photographic prints on paper sensitized with iron, silver, and platinum salts. Introduced commercially around 1916 as Satista.

tgm009643.label: Silver printing-out paper prints
tgm009643.scope: Photographic prints that consist of a silver image produced without chemical development.

tgm009644.label: Silver question
tgm009644.scope: For the issue of free coinage of silver in the United States.

tgm009652.label: Singing
tgm009652.scope: Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm009657.label: Sirens (Mythology)
tgm009657.scope: A group of female, partly human creatures in Greek mythology that lured sailors to destruction by singing.

tgm009663.label: Site plans
tgm009663.scope: Design drawings, especially architectural, landscape, and planning drawings, that are plans showing the boundaries, outlines, dimensions, contours, positions, and other characteristics of a defined area and its structures, plantings, and other physical features and improvements.

tgm009677.label: Sketchbooks
tgm009677.scope: Albums of drawings or paintings on pages bound together before the images were created.

tgm009678.label: Sketches
tgm009678.scope: Rough drawings or paintings representing the chief features of objects or scenes; often made as quick records of a scene, object, or idea, or as a preliminary to a study for a larger work.

tgm009684.label: Ski troops
tgm009684.scope: Troops trained to maneuver and fight on skis.

tgm009686.label: Skid roads
tgm009686.scope: Roads along which logs are dragged to a skidway or landing, often over heavy logs partly sunken at intervals of about five feet.

tgm009706.label: Slaughtering
tgm009706.scope: For killing of domesticated animals in non-industrial contexts. Search under MEAT INDUSTRY for images of slaughter in industrial contexts; search under HUNTING for killing of non-domesticated animals.

tgm009714.label: Slavery
tgm009714.scope: For the subject of slavery in general. Search under ENSLAVED PEOPLE for images that focus on persons.

tgm009715.label: Enslaved people
tgm009715.scope: Persons who are captured, purchased, or inherited by others as property and forced into servitude.

tgm009719.label: Sleds & sleighs
tgm009719.scope: Includes the activity of sledding and riding in sleighs, and pulling of sledges for entertainment or work.

tgm009731.label: Slides
tgm009731.scope: Transparent materials on which there is a drawn image or a positive photographic image; intended to be bound or held in a mount and usually designed for use in a projector or viewer.

tgm009741.label: Sluices
tgm009741.scope: An artificial passage for water fitted with a valve or gate for stopping or regulating flow.

tgm009742.label: Slums
tgm009742.scope: Densely populated urban area of deteriorated buildings inhabited mostly by improverished people.

tgm009774.label: Snapshots
tgm009774.scope: Photographs that seem to have been made without artistic pretensions; often made quickly with amateur equipment as a remembrance of people, places, or occasions.

tgm009815.label: Social science
tgm009815.scope: For the subject of social science in general and the activities of social scientists.

tgm009821.label: Socialism
tgm009821.scope: For the subject of socialism in general.

tgm009822.label: Socialists
tgm009822.scope: Search under SOCIALISM for the subject of socialism in general and the activities of socialists.

tgm009830.label: Sociology
tgm009830.scope: For the subject of sociology in general and the activities of sociologists.

tgm009833.label: Soda fountains
tgm009833.scope: Equipment and counters for the preparation and serving of sodas, sundaes, and ice cream.

tgm009837.label: Sofas
tgm009837.scope: Long, upholstered seating furniture with a back and two ends, generally used for sitting, not reclining.

tgm009846.label: Solarization photographs
tgm009846.scope: Photographs in which negative and positive values have been reversed in some areas, usually as a result of a long exposure. For example, a bright street lamp at night appears as a black spot rather than a bright spot. Includes negatives and prints that exhibit the Sabattier effect caused by exposure to light during darkroom development.

tgm009847.label: Soldering
tgm009847.scope: Joining two pieces of metal by melting solder between them.

tgm009848.label: Soldiers
tgm009848.scope: Persons engaged in the military below officer's level. For images of soldiers and troops in the context of war, search under the names of specific wars and relevant topical subdivisions such as --MILITARY PERSONNEL (Appendix C).

tgm009849.label: Soldiers' homes
tgm009849.scope: Establishments that provide care and relief for military veterans.

tgm009853.label: Solidarity
tgm009853.scope: Unity (as of a group or class) that produces or is based on community of interests, objectives, or standards.

tgm009857.label: Songs
tgm009857.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SONGS & MUSIC used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm009867.label: Soufflés
tgm009867.scope: Entrée or dessert made with sauce, egg yolks and whipped egg whites, and seasoning.

tgm009870.label: Sound equipment & supplies
tgm009870.scope: Devices used to reproduce, record, or process sound.

tgm009871.label: Sound recording
tgm009871.scope: For activity of recording sound, including performers' sound recording sessions.

tgm009872.label: Sound recording industry
tgm009872.scope: Manufacture and trade of sound recordings. Includes activities and structures.

tgm009886.label: Souvenirs
tgm009886.scope: Objects generally associated with particular events such as visits to amusement parks; often acquired through purchase rather than received as a keepsake gift; frequently mass-produced and of little monetary value.

tgm009892.label: Space photographs
tgm009892.scope: Photographs taken from a vehicle or by a person beyond the earth's atmosphere. Photographs taken by astronauts with conventional cameras are included, as well as images made by digital scanners and transmitted to earth by radio signals for computer processing.

tgm009901.label: Spandrels
tgm009901.scope: An area roughly triangular in shape, included between the extradoses of two adjoining arches and a line approximately connecting their crowns.

tgm009906.label: Speakeasies
tgm009906.scope: Places where alcoholic beverages are illegally sold.

tgm009907.label: Speakeasy cards
tgm009907.scope: Identification cards that admitted the bearer to a speakeasy during the American prohibition era (1920-1933). Often appear to be a club membership card or contain only cryptic markings.

tgm009914.label: Special interests
tgm009914.scope: Persons or groups seeking to influence legislation or government policy to further often narrowly defined interests.

tgm009918.label: Specifications
tgm009918.scope: Textual or graphic documents, schedules, and notes that amplify working drawings and give detailed information and instruction concerning materials, finishes, and workmanship.

tgm009920.label: Specimens
tgm009920.scope: Individual samples or units that are deliberately selected for examination, display, or study, and are usually chosen as typical of their kind.

tgm009922.label: Spectators
tgm009922.scope: People looking at or witnessing particular events or activities.

tgm009924.label: Spectrographs
tgm009924.scope: Apparatus for dispersing radiation into a spectrum and then photographing or mapping the spectrum.

tgm009925.label: Speculative houses
tgm009925.scope: Use for homes built without a particular client and in hopes, but with no assurances, of sales.

tgm009932.label: Speeding
tgm009932.scope: For the act of driving at a speed which violates traffic regulations.

tgm009945.label: Spillways
tgm009945.scope: A passage for surplus water to run over or around a dam or other obstruction.

tgm009949.label: Spinning
tgm009949.scope: For spinning by hand using a spindle or spinning wheel.

tgm009950.label: Spinning apparatus
tgm009950.scope: For equipment used in hand spinning.

tgm009952.label: Spinning machinery
tgm009952.scope: For images that focus on spinning using a spinning jenny or other machinery.

tgm009956.label: Spires
tgm009956.scope: For tall pyramidal, polygonal, or conical structures that rise from towers or roofs.

tgm009957.label: Spirit photographs
tgm009957.scope: Photographs in which deliberate partial exposure of persons or objects causes them to appear like ghosts.

tgm009961.label: Spiritual leaders
tgm009961.scope: For persons who provide spiritual guidance, although they may not occupy a formal position in an organized religion. Search also under the subdivision --SPIRITUAL LIFE used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups, and with classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm009963.label: Spiritualism
tgm009963.scope: For the subject of the belief that spirits of the dead communicate with the living, usually through a medium. Search under SEANCES for scenes of people meeting to communicate with the dead.

tgm009974.label: Spontaneous shrines
tgm009974.scope: Temporary sites in public areas where assemblages of personal mementos, artifacts, and flowers are left in memory of victims of tragic events. These sites serve as places for prayer, mourning, and reflection, and develop in response to the event. They are often (but not always) in proximity to the event.

tgm009983.label: Sporting goods industry
tgm009983.scope: Manufacture and trade of sporting goods. Includes activities and structures.

tgm009985.label: Sports
tgm009985.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SPORTS used with names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A), with names of persons (Appendix B), and with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm009986.label: Sports cards
tgm009986.scope: Advertising or collecting cards issued since the 1880s to encourage or satisfy interest in sports. Examples include football, baseball, and basketball cards issued by bubble gum, bread, tobacco, and milk producers, among others. Often feature portraits of individual athletes or teams.

tgm009994.label: Sports posters
tgm009994.scope: Posters issued to announce sporting events such as football games or boxing matches. Also, posters commemorating sports figures.

tgm010003.label: Springhouses
tgm010003.scope: Buildings enclosing a natural spring; sufficiently cool for use as a storehouse of milk and other dairy products.

tgm010009.label: Spying
tgm010009.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COVERT OPERATIONS used with names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm010019.label: Stabilization prints
tgm010019.scope: Photographic prints processed rapidly in a machine that develops the image but does not provide adequate fixing and washing to prevent subsequent fading. Often found in newspaper photo morgues.

tgm010024.label: Stadiums
tgm010024.scope: Large, often unroofed structure, in which athletic events are held.

tgm010049.label: Standards (Identifying artifacts)
tgm010049.scope: Banners, flags, emblematic figures, or other objects displayed as the identifying symbol of a leader, public officer, or organization, such as the flag of a nation, the colors of a military unit, or the banner of a noble house.

tgm010051.label: Stands (Furniture)
tgm010051.scope: Small piece of furniture used for holding or displaying objects.

tgm010054.label: Stanhopes (Photographs)
tgm010054.scope: Photographs mounted under a magnifying glass about .12 in. (.3 cm.) across. Often in a ring or other jewelry; especially popular in the 1860s.

tgm010078.label: Statehood
tgm010078.scope: For states of the United States.

tgm010080.label: Staterooms
tgm010080.scope: For private rooms on ships or railroad cars designed to accommodate one or more persons.

tgm010083.label: Statesmen
tgm010083.scope: Persons who engage in conducting the business of a government or in shaping its policies but do not hold a government post.

tgm010086.label: Stationery
tgm010086.scope: Materials on which letters and similar communications are typed or written.

tgm010094.label: Stats
tgm010094.scope: Negative or positive image paper photographic reproductions made with a photostat machine. Used for art layouts or any situation in which quickly made, high-contrast copies are needed whether same size, enlarged, or reduced.

tgm010102.label: Steam donkeys
tgm010102.scope: For usually portable, auxilliary steam engines used in logging, to load at landings, move equipment, etc.

tgm010111.label: Steamboats
tgm010111.scope: For boats powered by steam used on inland waterways. Search under SHIPS for steamships.

tgm010124.label: Steeples
tgm010124.scope: For towers terminated by spires, includes tower, spire, and lantern.

tgm010125.label: Steerage
tgm010125.scope: For any section of a passenger vessel occupied by passengers paying the lowest fares.

tgm010129.label: Stelae
tgm010129.scope: Stone slab set vertically, used mainly for commemoration.

tgm010137.label: Stepping stones
tgm010137.scope: Stones on which to step (as in crossing a stream).

tgm010140.label: Stereographs
tgm010140.scope: Two nearly identical photographs or photomechanical prints, paired to produce the illusion of a single three-dimensional image; usually viewed with a stereoscope. Typically, photographic prints on card mounts, but may be daguerreotypes, glass negatives, slides or other processes. Card mounts commonly 3.5 x 7 in. (9 x 18 cm.) up to 5 x 7 in. (12 x 18 cm.). Popular in the United States 1859-1920s.

tgm010151.label: Stewards
tgm010151.scope: Employees on ships, airplanes, or trains who manage the provision of food and attend passengers.

tgm010153.label: Stickers
tgm010153.scope: Messages or designs on slips of paper that are gummed or otherwise treated to adhere to a surface.

tgm010160.label: Still lifes
tgm010160.scope: Graphic representations of inanimate objects selected and arranged by the artist or photographer for a specific pictorial effect.

tgm010162.label: Stills (Distilleries)
tgm010162.scope: For the apparatus used for the distillation of alcoholic liquor.

tgm010167.label: Stipple engravings
tgm010167.scope: Engravings in which the design consists of dots or flecks, usually in addition to line work.

tgm010170.label: Stock cards
tgm010170.scope: Advertising cards printed with an area left blank for local retailers to add their name or other information.

tgm010171.label: Stock certificates
tgm010171.scope: Documents evidencing ownership of one or more shares of the capital stock of a corporation.

tgm010175.label: Stock posters
tgm010175.scope: Posters with generic images, and blank spaces so that text for a specific event can be added at a later date to customize the poster.

tgm010180.label: Stocks (Punishment)
tgm010180.scope: Devices for publicly punishing offenders consisting of a wooden frame with holes in which the feet or feet and hands can be locked.

tgm010187.label: Stone carving
tgm010187.scope: Carving stone to make sculpture or architectural elements.

tgm010215.label: Storms
tgm010215.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm010217.label: Storyboards
tgm010217.scope: A series of images that visually outlines the sequence of action in an audio-visual work.

tgm010220.label: Stoves
tgm010220.scope: Includes both heating and cooking stoves.

tgm010225.label: Strategic planning
tgm010225.scope: Process by which an organization develops goals and plans activities to reach goals.

tgm010229.label: Straw man
tgm010229.scope: A weak or imaginary opposition set up only to be easily refuted; or, a person set up to serve as a cover for a usually questionable transaction.

tgm010235.label: Street children
tgm010235.scope: Children who, because of poverty, neglect, or abandonment, work and spend most of their time on city streets.

tgm010253.label: Street railroads
tgm010253.scope: For railroads within cities. Search under ELECTRIC RAILROADS for street railroads between cities and under CABLE RAILROADS for street railroads powered by cable.

tgm010257.label: Street vendors
tgm010257.scope: Includes people who sell goods from temporary locations on the street.

tgm010261.label: Streets
tgm010261.scope: For thoroughfares in cities, towns, and villages. Search under CITY & TOWN LIFE for images that focus on activities. Search under ROADS for thoroughfares outside of cities, towns, and villages.

tgm010265.label: Strikes
tgm010265.scope: Search also under the subdivision --STRIKES used with corporate bodies and named events (Appendix D).

tgm010267.label: Stringcourses
tgm010267.scope: Horizontal bands of masonry, narrower than other courses, running across a wall.

tgm010268.label: Stringed instruments
tgm010268.scope: Includes the activity of playing stringed instruments.

tgm010279.label: Structural drawings
tgm010279.scope: Graphic representations made for the design, construction, and assembly (or documentation of the design, construction, and assembly) of the structural support systems of a building or other structure. Features included are attributes of form (post and lintel, arch, truss) and materials (wood, masonry, and steel).

tgm010283.label: Structural systems drawings
tgm010283.scope: Graphic representations that explain or depict the design, construction, and assembly of a specialized or innovative structural support system. They show how the structural components or materials are assembled, joined, or fabricated. Examples include Frank Lloyd Wright's textile block system of construction or his reinforced concrete houses.

tgm010298.label: Student works
tgm010298.scope: Drawings, photographs, prints, or other works created by people for course assignments, or to gain a degree.

tgm010299.label: Students
tgm010299.scope: For high school and college students. Search under SCHOOL CHILDREN for younger students.

tgm010302.label: Studies (Rooms & spaces)
tgm010302.scope: Building or room furnished especially with books and devoted to work, study, or literary pursuits.

tgm010303.label: Studies (Visual works)
tgm010303.scope: Use for works in any medium of the visual arts, tending to be quite detailed, usually made in preparation for a finished composition. May also be made to explore a technique, material, or design. A more carefully detailed representation than a sketch but less finished than a completed work.

tgm010343.label: Suffragists
tgm010343.scope: People who advocate suffrage for women.

tgm010353.label: Sugar-lift aquatints
tgm010353.scope: Prints produced by an aquatint technique in which the part of the plate to be etched is exposed by dissolving the protective coating.

tgm010357.label: Suites
tgm010357.scope: Group of rooms designed for occupancy as a unit.

tgm010366.label: Summer houses
tgm010366.scope: Country homes used as summer residences.

tgm010367.label: Summit meetings
tgm010367.scope: A meeting of high-level officials, especially heads of state.

tgm010393.label: Sunspaces
tgm010393.scope: Additions to buildings which act as high performance heat collectors or provide additional solar heated living or recreational space.

tgm010394.label: Superheroes
tgm010394.scope: Fictitious characters with superhuman strength, capabilities or special means of communication. Based on comic strips and comic book heroes such as Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman.

tgm010397.label: Supermarkets
tgm010397.scope: A large, departmentalized, self-service retail market which sells a high volume of foods and household merchandise. Includes activities and structures.

tgm010418.label: Surgery
tgm010418.scope: For the subject of surgery in general and the activities of surgeons.

tgm010425.label: Surrenders
tgm010425.scope: Search also under the subdivision --SURRENDERS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm010426.label: Surveillance
tgm010426.scope: Search also under the subdivision --COVERT OPERATIONS used with the names of wars (Appendix C).

tgm010436.label: Suspension bridges
tgm010436.scope: For bridges where the roadway is suspended from two or more cables, usually passing over towers.

tgm010438.label: Sutlers
tgm010438.scope: Civilian provisioners to an army, or an army post, often with a shop on the post.

tgm010441.label: Swamis
tgm010441.scope: For Hindu ascetics or religious teachers.

tgm010443.label: Swan songs
tgm010443.scope: Farewell appearances or final acts or pronouncements.

tgm010447.label: Swearing
tgm010447.scope: For profane language. Search under OATHS for judicial or official oaths.

tgm010451.label: Sweatbaths
tgm010451.scope: For ritual (social and religious) sweatbaths as practised by Indians of North America and Eskimos.

tgm010455.label: Sweatshops
tgm010455.scope: Industrial establishments that employ workers at substandard wages, hours, and working conditions.

tgm010462.label: Swimmers
tgm010462.scope: For swimmers not engaged in swimming. Use SWIMMING for activities.

tgm010471.label: Swings
tgm010471.scope: Seats suspended from above, on which one may ride back and forth in an arc for recreation; also for single suspended ropes and other kinds of swings used for recreation.

tgm010480.label: Symbols
tgm010480.scope: Search also under terms for animals, objects, and other things which may be used as symbols, e.g., FISTS (for power) and HAWKS (for aggression).

tgm010485.label: Synagogues
tgm010485.scope: For images that focus on buildings, as well as the associated grounds.

tgm010498.label: Tableaux
tgm010498.scope: Representations of scenes, paintings or sculpture, by posing persons who remain silent and motionless in appropriate postures.

tgm010520.label: Tailors
tgm010520.scope: For tailors away from the context of their work. Search under TAILORING for activities.

tgm010548.label: Tanning
tgm010548.scope: Search under LEATHER INDUSTRY for tanning activities on a large scale.

tgm010562.label: Tarot cards
tgm010562.scope: Pictorial playing cards made specifically for forecasting the future and as trumps in tarok games. Issued in sets of 22; depict such characters and forces as the the fool and the tower.

tgm010572.label: Taverns (Inns)
tgm010572.scope: Primarily 17th to early 19th century English and American places for eating, drinking, and public accomodations. Includes activities and structures.

tgm010576.label: Tax reform
tgm010576.scope: For the subject of specific legislation for tax reform. Search under TAXES for the subject of taxes in general and criticisms of the tax system.

tgm010577.label: Tax stamps
tgm010577.scope: Revenue stamps affixed to various printed materials. Required on photographs and other graphics in the United States, 1864-1866. Also common on some playing card packs.

tgm010583.label: Tea
tgm010583.scope: Includes the activity of tea drinking.

tgm010599.label: Teahouses
tgm010599.scope: Small garden houses used for tea ceremonies, common in China and Japan.

tgm010604.label: Tear sheets
tgm010604.scope: Sheets torn or otherwise separated from publications to prove insertion of an advertisement or an image.

tgm010605.label: Tearooms
tgm010605.scope: Restaurants where tea and light meals are served.

tgm010608.label: Technical illustrations
tgm010608.scope: Illustrations used to explain how something works, particularly in reference works and technical manuals. Do not confuse with SCIENTIFIC ILLUSTRATIONS, DIAGRAMS, OR DESIGN DRAWINGS.

tgm010609.label: Technocracy
tgm010609.scope: Management of society by technical people.

tgm010613.label: Teenagers
tgm010613.scope: For persons in the general age range of thirteen to eighteen years. This heading may be further subdivided by the subdivisions used for classes of persons (Appendix A).

tgm010633.label: Telepathy
tgm010633.scope: Includes both real and theatrical telepathy.

tgm010655.label: Television industry
tgm010655.scope: Manufacture and trade of televisions. Includes activities and structures.

tgm010664.label: Television stills
tgm010664.scope: Photographs made during the production of a television program showing scenes from the program; usually for publicity purposes.

tgm010671.label: Temperance
tgm010671.scope: For the question of moderation of or abstinence from the use of intoxicating drink, as well as for the temperance movement.

tgm010673.label: Templates
tgm010673.scope: Guiding tools used for duplicating shapes. [AAT]

tgm010678.label: Temporary buildings
tgm010678.scope: For buildings erected and then dismantled after a stated period of occupancy, or structures erected for a clearly temporary purpose or event.

tgm010683.label: Tenement houses
tgm010683.scope: Low income apartment houses, generally having substandard sanitation and safety facilities, usually located in cities.

tgm010687.label: Tennis players
tgm010687.scope: For tennis players not engaged in the activity of the game. Search under TENNIS for activities.

tgm010692.label: Tents
tgm010692.scope: For tents used by soldiers, campers, nomads, etc.

tgm010703.label: Terraces
tgm010703.scope: For flat roofs or open platforms and relatively level paved or planted areas adjoining buildings.

tgm010704.label: Terraces (Land use)
tgm010704.scope: For level spaces supported in one or more places by a wall or bank and the practice of shaping the earth into this form.

tgm010717.label: Testing
tgm010717.scope: For the testing of things. Search under EXAMINATIONS for the testing of persons.

tgm010722.label: Textile block construction
tgm010722.scope: Use for a system of constructing a wall with blocks, steel and concrete bound together by means of horizontal and vertical thin rods.

tgm010723.label: Textile design drawings
tgm010723.scope: Graphic delineations made for the design and production (or documentation of the design and production) of fabrics, both woven and non-woven.

tgm010724.label: Textile industry
tgm010724.scope: For unspecified textiles or more than one kind. Search under NTs for the manufacture of specific textiles. Includes activities and structures.

tgm010727.label: Textile labels
tgm010727.scope: Paper labels meant to identify lengths of cloth goods. Usually they state yardage and sometimes cloth type and manufacturer's name.

tgm010740.label: Theater programs
tgm010740.scope: Booklets with descriptions of performances and performers.

tgm010742.label: Theaters
tgm010742.scope: For images that focus on facilities. Search under THEATRICAL PRODUCTIONS for activities.

tgm010745.label: Theatrical posters
tgm010745.scope: Includes posters for plays; minstrel, Lilliputian, burlesque, and vaudeville shows; operas and operettas; revues; musicals; magic; specialty acts, and other stage performances.

tgm010747.label: Theatrical productions
tgm010747.scope: For theater activities, including plays, monologues, etc. Search under THEATERS for images that focus on buildings. Search also under the subdivision --PERFORMANCES & PORTRAYALS used with the names of ethnic, racial, and regional groups and with classes of persons (Appendix A). Search also under the subdivisions --PORTRAYALS and --PERFORMANCES used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm010749.label: Then & now comparisons
tgm010749.scope: Single images that compare the appearance of a person, place, activity, or object by showing the subject at two or more different time periods.

tgm010750.label: Theocracy
tgm010750.scope: For the subject of theocracy in general.

tgm010752.label: Therapeutic baths
tgm010752.scope: Includes activities and sites identified as "therapeutic."

tgm010757.label: Theremins
tgm010757.scope: Electronic musical instrument invented by Leon Theremin played by varying movements of the hands near the antennae.

tgm010758.label: Thermal copies
tgm010758.scope: Heat-produced quick copy reproductions of pictorial or textual documents. Introduced commercially ca. 1950.

tgm010766.label: Third parties
tgm010766.scope: A major political party operating over a limited period of time in addition to two other major parties in a nation or state normally characterized by a two-party system.

tgm010773.label: Threats
tgm010773.scope: Expression of intention to inflict injury or damage.

tgm010779.label: Three-dimensional photographs
tgm010779.scope: Photographs that give an illusion of three-dimensionality, usually viewed with special glasses.

tgm010780.label: Three-in-one pictures
tgm010780.scope: Two different pictures drawn or painted on opposite sides of a surface that is then cut into thin strips and uniformly attached at right angles to another surface on which a third picture has been drawn or painted. As the picture is viewed or turned from side to side each separate illustration becomes visible.

tgm010791.label: Throwing
tgm010791.scope: Propelling an object through the air using the hand and arm.

tgm010792.label: Throwing sticks
tgm010792.scope: Straight or curved sticks thrown by hand as a weapon.

tgm010797.label: Ticker tape
tgm010797.scope: For ticker tape as used for printing stock quotations or news. Includes ticker tape machines.

tgm010804.label: Tickets
tgm010804.scope: Slips of paper, cardboard, or other material used for admission or passage.

tgm010807.label: Tidal waves
tgm010807.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm010823.label: Timberlines
tgm010823.scope: The line on a mountain above which no trees grow.

tgm010825.label: Time capsules
tgm010825.scope: A container holding records or objects representative of current culture, deposited for preservation and discovery by people in the future.

tgm010829.label: Timetables
tgm010829.scope: Lists showing times of departure and arrival for a particular mode of transportation.

tgm010835.label: Tintypes
tgm010835.scope: Direct-image photographs in which the collodion negative supported by a dark-lacquered thin iron sheet appears as a positive image. Popular mid-1850s through 1860s; in use through 1930s.

tgm010836.label: Tipis
tgm010836.scope: American Indian conical tents, usually consisting of skins and used especially by the Plains people.

tgm010837.label: Tipples
tgm010837.scope: A structure or apparatus by which cars of ore are loaded or emptied.

tgm010842.label: Tissue stereographs
tgm010842.scope: Photographic print stereographs on thin translucent paper mounted either between glass plates or on cards cut out to make a frame; intended for viewing as a transparency. Many were made in France; often colored.

tgm010844.label: Title pages
tgm010844.scope: Pages bearing the title and usually the names of author and publisher, and date and place of publication of a book, portfolio, or other material.

tgm010857.label: Tobacco package labels
tgm010857.scope: Slips of paper or other material affixed or meant to be attached to a tobacco plug or container for identification, description, or decoration.

tgm010880.label: Tombs & sepulchral monuments
tgm010880.scope: For constructions over or around burial sites. Search under GRAVES for excavations in the earth. Search also under the subdivision --TOMB used with names of persons (Appendix B).

tgm010892.label: Topographic maps
tgm010892.scope: Maps that portray, identify, and locate natural and man-made features as precisely as possible; usually use contour lines to show variations in surface height.

tgm010896.label: Torchères (Lamps)
tgm010896.scope: An indirect floor lamp which sends all or nearly all of its light upward.

tgm010900.label: Torii
tgm010900.scope: Gateway, or gateways, of light, skeletonlike construction, built at the approach to a Shinto temple.

tgm010901.label: Tornadoes
tgm010901.scope: Includes the event and any resulting damage.

tgm010915.label: Tourism
tgm010915.scope: For the subject of tourism in general. Search under TOURISTS for images that focus on persons.

tgm010920.label: Tourists
tgm010920.scope: For persons on organized tours. Search under SIGHTSEERS for persons who go about seeing sights of interest on their own.

tgm010921.label: Tournaments
tgm010921.scope: For knightly sports in which mounted armored combatants engage one another to exhibit their skill and courage. Search under appropriate NTs to SPORTS for modern tournaments.

tgm010949.label: Track athletics
